class _LazoVendorDashboardState extends State<LazoVendorDashboard>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  static const Color plum = Color(0xFF52284F);
  static const Color plumDeep = Color(0xFF3D1C3B);
  static const Color gold = Color(0xFFD9B77C);
  static const Color ivory = Color(0xFFFAF6F0);
  static const Color ink = Color(0xFF241E2B);
  static const Color vGreen = Color(0xFF2E8B6B);
  static const Color muted = Color(0xFF6B5F72);
  static const Color card = Color(0xFFFFFDF9);
  static const Color goldLine = Color(0xFFE6D6B8);

  static const String brandUrl = 'https://meetlazo.com/assets/brand.png';

  String? _uid;
  String _claimMetro = 'phoenix';
  final TextEditingController _searchC = TextEditingController();
  bool _submitting = false;
  bool _tplBusy = false;
  String _dashMode = 'leads';

  // ---------------- v177: FOLDABLE CARDS ----------------
  // Every card on Today folds to a one-line row that still carries its
  // headline number, so a folded card keeps earning its row. What is folded
  // lives on the vendor doc (layout.collapsed) and follows them across
  // devices. Structure - the hero, the tabs, the desk - never folds.
  Set<String> _folded = <String>{};
  String _foldsSynced = '';

  void _syncFolds(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> lay = d['layout'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(d['layout'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<String> l = ((lay['collapsed'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
        .toList()
      ..sort();
    final String sig = l.join(',');
    if (sig == _foldsSynced) return;
    _foldsSynced = sig;
    _folded = l.toSet();
  }

  Future<void> _toggleFold(String k) async {
    setState(() {
      if (!_folded.remove(k)) _folded.add(k);
      _foldsSynced = (_folded.toList()..sort()).join(',');
    });
    if (_vendorIdCache.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(_vendorIdCache)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'layout': <String, dynamic>{'collapsed': _folded.toList()}
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO fold: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _foldBtn(String k, {bool onDark = false}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    return Tooltip(
      message: folded ? 'Unfold' : 'Fold',
      child: _Press(
        scale: .88,
        tick: _Tick.select,
        onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
        child: Container(
          width: 26,
          height: 26,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.14) : plum.withOpacity(.05),
            border:
                Border.all(color: onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.3) : goldLine),
          ),
          child: Icon(
              folded ? Icons.expand_more_rounded : Icons.expand_less_rounded,
              size: 16,
              color: onDark ? ivory : muted),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The card, or its folded row. A null summary hides the folded row - a
  // card with nothing to say (no quiet couples, no consults) stays gone
  // either way. `gap` matches the spacing the card carries beneath itself.
  Widget _fold(String k, String title, String? summary, Widget card,
      {double gap = 0}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    Widget child;
    if (!folded) {
      child = card;
    } else if (summary == null) {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    } else {
      child = Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: gap),
        child: _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          tick: _Tick.select,
          onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 11, 12, 11),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              Text(title, style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(summary,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _foldBtn(k),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return AnimatedSize(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
      child: KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<bool>(folded), child: child),
    );
  }

  // The one line a folded card keeps. Reads the shared live snapshots, so a
  // card that has never been unfolded on this device still says something
  // true.
  String? _foldSummary(String k, String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
        (_leadsLatest(vendorId)?.docs ??
                <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'flagged')
            .toList();
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    switch (k) {
      case 'inbox':
        final int unread = docs
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                _isUnread(d.data()))
            .length;
        return unread == 0 ? 'All caught up' : '$unread waiting on you';
      case 'upcoming':
        String name = '';
        int nextDays = -1;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
              (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
          if (!booked) continue;
          final DateTime? wd = _weddingDateRaw(m);
          if (wd == null) continue;
          final int days =
              DateTime(wd.year, wd.month, wd.day).difference(today).inDays;
          if (days < 0) continue;
          if (nextDays < 0 || days < nextDays) {
            nextDays = days;
            name = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
          }
        }
        if (nextDays < 0) return 'No booked weddings yet';
        return '${name.isEmpty ? 'Next' : name}, ${nextDays == 0 ? 'today' : '$nextDays day${nextDays == 1 ? '' : 's'}'}';
      case 'followups':
        int quiet = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if ((m['status'] ?? '').toString() != 'responded') continue;
          if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '').toString() != 'vendor') continue;
          final dynamic ts = m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['respondedAt'];
          if (ts is! Timestamp) continue;
          if (now.difference(ts.toDate()).inDays >= 3) quiet++;
        }
        return quiet == 0 ? null : '$quiet went quiet';
      case 'activity':
        return '${docs.length} ${docs.length == 1 ? 'inquiry' : 'inquiries'}';
      case 'june':
        return 'Ask about any couple, date or dollar';
      case 'weather':
        final String metro = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
        if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) return null;
        DateTime? next;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if ((m['status'] ?? '') != 'booked') continue;
          final String raw =
              ((m['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['weddingDate'] ?? '')
                  .toString();
          final DateTime? wd = raw.isEmpty
              ? null
              : DateTime.tryParse(raw.length == 10 ? raw + 'T12:00:00' : raw);
          if (wd == null || wd.isBefore(today)) continue;
          if (next == null || wd.isBefore(next)) next = wd;
        }
        final DateTime day = next ?? today;
        WidgetsBinding.instance
            .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWx(day, metro));
        final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(day)}|$metro'];
        if (w == null) return 'Reading the sky…';
        return '${w['hi']}° · ${_wmoLabel(w['code'] as int)}${next == null ? ' today' : ''}';
      case 'consults':
        final int n = _liveQ['consults:$vendorId']?.latest?.docs.length ?? 0;
        return n == 0 ? null : '$n coming up';
      case 'hello':
        if (!_isPaid(vd)) return 'Find couples before they search · Pro';
        if (_helloCacheFor != vendorId && !_helloLoading) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance
              .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadHellos(vendorId));
        }
        final Map<String, dynamic> h = _helloCache ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        if (_helloCacheFor != vendorId) return 'Finding couples…';
        final int count = (h['count'] is num) ? (h['count'] as num).toInt() : 0;
        return count == 0
            ? 'Nobody to greet right now'
            : '$count couple${count == 1 ? '' : 's'} need you';
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u != null) {
      _uid = u.uid;
    }
    // v148: the spinner, pulse and phrase timer only run on the pending-claim
    // screen (see _startPendingMotion). They used to start here and never
    // stop - a setState every 2.4s for the life of the dashboard, which
    // resubscribed every inline Firestore stream on each repaint.
    _spinC = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1800));
    _pulseC = AnimationController(
        vsync: this,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1100),
        lowerBound: 0.92,
        upperBound: 1.06);
    // v151: a lead text links straight to its thread - /dashboard?thread=<id>.
    try {
      final String? t = Uri.base.queryParameters['thread'];
      if (t != null && t.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        _pendingThread = t.trim();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _guardRole();
      _checkAdmin();
    });
  }

  // ---------------- v148: SHARED LIVE STREAMS ----------------
  // One Firestore listener per query, handed to every StreamBuilder as the
  // same Stream object, so a repaint never resubscribes. Late subscribers
  // (the Inbox, the Account page, a Studio card opened later) get the
  // current snapshot at once instead of waiting for the next write.

  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveQuery(
      String key, Query<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveQ[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(() => build().snapshots());
      _liveQ[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveDoc(
      String key, DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveD[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          () => build().snapshots());
      _liveD[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  // v150: a ListView recycles children that scroll out of its cache extent.
  // When a card comes back, its StreamBuilder resubscribes and used to draw
  // one empty frame before the replay landed - the inbox collapsed to its
  // empty state, the layout jumped, and the scroll stuttered. initialData
  // hands every rebuilt StreamBuilder the current snapshot on its first build.
  QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _leadsLatest(String vendorId) {
    return _liveQ['leads:$vendorId']?.latest;
  }

  QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _threadLatest(
      String inquiryId, String key) {
    if (_threadLiveFor != inquiryId) {
      return null;
    }
    return _threadQ[key]?.latest;
  }

  DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _threadDocLatest(String inquiryId) {
    if (_threadLiveFor != inquiryId) {
      return null;
    }
    return _threadDoc?.latest;
  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _vendorDocStream(
      String vendorId) {
    return _liveDoc('vendor:$vendorId',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vendorId));
  }

  // Thread-scoped streams (messages, proposals, contracts, questionnaires,
  // invoices, presence) live only while that thread is open - switching
  // threads tears the old set down so listeners never pile up.
  void _threadLiveReset(String inquiryId) {
    if (_threadLiveFor == inquiryId) {
      return;
    }
    for (final _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> l
        in _threadQ.values) {
      l.dispose();
    }
    _threadQ.clear();
    _threadDoc?.dispose();
    _threadDoc = null;
    _threadLiveFor = inquiryId;
  }

  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _threadQuery(String inquiryId,
      String key, Query<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _threadLiveReset(inquiryId);
    _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _threadQ[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(() => build().snapshots());
      _threadQ[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _threadDocStream(
      String inquiryId) {
    _threadLiveReset(inquiryId);
    _threadDoc ??= _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(() =>
        FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('inquiries')
            .doc(inquiryId)
            .snapshots());
    return _threadDoc!.stream;
  }

  // ---------------- v148: PENDING-CLAIM MOTION ----------------
  // The verifying spinner, its pulse and the rotating phrases run only while
  // the pending screen is up, and stop the moment any other view takes over.
  void _startPendingMotion() {
    if (_pendingMotionOn || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    _pendingMotionOn = true;
    _spinC.repeat();
    _pulseC.repeat(reverse: true);
    _phraseT?.cancel();
    _phraseT = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 2400), (Timer t) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _phrase = _phrase + 1;
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _stopPendingMotion() {
    if (!_pendingMotionOn) {
      return;
    }
    _pendingMotionOn = false;
    _phraseT?.cancel();
    _phraseT = null;
    _spinC.stop();
    _pulseC.stop();
  }

  Future<void> _checkAdmin() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('admins').doc(_uid).get();
      if (mounted && snap.exists) {
        setState(() {
          _isAdminUser = true;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO admin check: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // JC-LAZO-VIEWSWITCH-0917-001: see the couple widget - one-shot flag so the
  // guard does not bounce a manual switch straight back.
  static const String _kViewSwitchKey = 'lazo_view_switch_at';

  Future<void> _markViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await p.setInt(_kViewSwitchKey, DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<bool> _consumeViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final int t = p.getInt(_kViewSwitchKey) ?? 0;
      if (t <= 0) {
        return false;
      }
      await p.remove(_kViewSwitchKey);
      return DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - t < 120000;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _guardRole() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    if (await _consumeViewSwitch()) {
      return; // v174: they asked to be here
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final Map<String, dynamic>? d = snap.data();
      if (d == null) {
        return;
      }
      final String role = d['role'] == null ? '' : d['role'].toString();
      if (role == 'couple') {
        if (mounted) {
          context.goNamed('CoupleHome');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO role guard error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _presenceTimer?.cancel();
    _bookingSub?.cancel();
    _chimeSub?.cancel();
    _setTabBadge(0);
    _bookingBannerT?.cancel();
    _debounceT?.cancel();
    _phraseT?.cancel();
    _spinC.dispose();
    _pulseC.dispose();
    _confettiC?.dispose();
    _searchC.dispose();
    _inboxMsgC.dispose();
    _inboxSearchC.dispose();
    for (final _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> l in _liveQ.values) {
      l.dispose();
    }
    for (final _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> l
        in _liveD.values) {
      l.dispose();
    }
    for (final _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> l
        in _threadQ.values) {
      l.dispose();
    }
    _threadDoc?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _metroLabel(String? id) {
    for (int i = 0; i < _metroIds.length; i++) {
      if (_metroIds[i] == id) {
        return _metroNames[i];
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  String _titleCase(String s) {
    final List<String> parts = s.split(' ');
    final List<String> out = [];
    for (final String w in parts) {
      if (w.isEmpty) {
        out.add(w);
      } else {
        out.add(w[0].toUpperCase() + w.substring(1));
      }
    }
    return out.join(' ');
  }

  Future<void> _logOut() async {
    await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    context.goNamed('Welcome');
  }

  void _toast(String message) {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: plumDeep,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(message, style: const TextStyle(color: ivory)),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> _runSearch() async {
    final String raw = _searchC.text.trim();
    if (raw.length < 2) {
      setState(() {
        _searched = false;
        _searchError = null;
        _searching = false;
        _results = [];
      });
      return;
    }
    final int token = _searchToken + 1;
    _searchToken = token;
    final String q = _titleCase(raw);
    setState(() {
      _searching = true;
      _searched = true;
      _searchError = null;
    });
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .orderBy('name')
          .startAt([q])
          .endAt([q + '\uf8ff'])
          .limit(50)
          .get();
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (token != _searchToken) {
        return;
      }
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> all = [];
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in snap.docs) {
        all.add(d.data());
      }
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> inMetro = [];
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in all) {
        if (v['metroId'] == _claimMetro) {
          inMetro.add(v);
        }
      }
      setState(() {
        _results = inMetro.isNotEmpty ? inMetro : all;
        _searching = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      if (token != _searchToken) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _searching = false;
        _searchError = 'Search failed - try again in a moment.';
      });
      debugPrint('LAZO claim search error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submitClaim(Map<String, dynamic> v) async {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null || _submitting) {
      return;
    }
    final String name = v['name'] == null ? '' : v['name'].toString();
    final String vendorId = v['placeId'] == null ? '' : v['placeId'].toString();
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> freshSnap =
        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('vendors')
            .doc(vendorId)
            .get();
    final Map<String, dynamic> fresh =
        freshSnap.data() == null ? <String, dynamic>{} : freshSnap.data()!;
    // v150: a vendor re-verifying their own claimed listing goes straight to
    // the form; only someone else's claimed listing is blocked here.
    if (fresh['claimStatus'] == 'claimed' && fresh['claimedBy'] != u.uid) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Already claimed',
              style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          content: Text(
            '$name has already been claimed and verified by its owner.\n\nIf you believe this is a mistake or you are the rightful owner, contact vendors@meetlazo.com and our team will review the ownership dispute.',
            style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              }),
              child: const Text('Got it'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final TextEditingController bizEmailC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController bizPhoneC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController legalEntityC = TextEditingController();
    String claimantRole = 'Owner';
    Uint8List? proofBytes;
    bool proofIsPdf = false;
    String proofExt = 'jpg';
    String proofName = '';
    String? formError;
    bool busy = false;

    InputDecoration deco(String label, String helper) {
      return InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        helperText: helper.isEmpty ? null : helper,
        labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13.5),
        helperStyle: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 11),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.white,
        contentPadding:
            const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.6)),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.4),
        ),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.6)),
        ),
      );
    }

    final bool? submitted = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
            final Uint8List? pb = proofBytes;
            final bool canSubmit = bizEmailC.text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                bizPhoneC.text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                pb != null;

            Future<void> pickProof() async {
              try {
                final FilePickerResult? res =
                    await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
                  type: FileType.custom,
                  allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'pdf'],
                  withData: true,
                );
                if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
                  return;
                }
                final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
                final Uint8List? b = f.bytes;
                if (b == null) {
                  return;
                }
                String ext = '';
                if (f.extension != null) {
                  ext = f.extension.toString().toLowerCase();
                }
                setD(() {
                  proofBytes = b;
                  proofIsPdf = ext == 'pdf';
                  proofExt = ext.isEmpty ? 'jpg' : ext;
                  proofName = f.name;
                  formError = null;
                });
              } catch (e) {
                debugPrint('LAZO proof pick error: ' + e.toString());
              }
            }

            Future<void> doSubmit() async {
              final Uint8List? bytes = proofBytes;
              if (bizEmailC.text.trim().isEmpty ||
                  bizPhoneC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                setD(() {
                  formError = 'Business email and phone are required.';
                });
                return;
              }
              if (bytes == null) {
                setD(() {
                  formError =
                      'Please attach a proof photo so we can verify you.';
                });
                return;
              }
              setD(() {
                busy = true;
                formError = null;
              });
              try {
                final String cType = proofIsPdf
                    ? 'application/pdf'
                    : (proofExt == 'png'
                        ? 'image/png'
                        : (proofExt == 'webp' ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg'));
                final String proofPath = 'verification/' +
                    u.uid +
                    '/claim_' +
                    vendorId +
                    '.' +
                    proofExt;
                final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(proofPath);
                await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: cType));
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('claimRequests')
                    .add({
                  'uid': u.uid,
                  'email': u.email,
                  'vendorId': vendorId,
                  'businessName': name,
                  'metroId': v['metroId'] == null
                      ? _claimMetro
                      : v['metroId'].toString(),
                  'status': 'pending',
                  'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                  'claimantRole': claimantRole,
                  'businessEmail': bizEmailC.text.trim(),
                  'businessPhone': bizPhoneC.text.trim(),
                  'legalEntityName': legalEntityC.text.trim(),
                  'proofPath': proofPath,
                  'reverify': fresh['claimedBy'] == u.uid,
                });
                if (ctx2.mounted) {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
                }
              } catch (e) {
                debugPrint('LAZO claim submit error: ' + e.toString());
                setD(() {
                  busy = false;
                  formError = 'Something went wrong submitting - try again.';
                });
              }
            }

            return Dialog(
              backgroundColor: ivory,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26)),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 430),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 26, 24, 20),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 44,
                            height: 44,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                  colors: [plumDeep, plum]),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(Icons.verified_user_rounded,
                                color: gold, size: 22),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),

  Future<void> _addListing() async {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) {
      return;
    }
    final TextEditingController nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: _searchC.text.trim());
    final TextEditingController phoneC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController webC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController legalEntityC = TextEditingController();
    final Set<String> picked = <String>{};
    Uint8List? proofBytes;
    bool proofIsPdf = false;
    String proofExt = 'jpg';
    String proofName = '';
    String? formError;
    bool busy = false;

    InputDecoration ldeco(String label) {
      return InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13.5),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.white,
        contentPadding:
            const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.6)),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.4),
        ),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.6)),
        ),
      );
    }

    final bool? submitted = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
            final Uint8List? pb = proofBytes;
            final bool canSubmit = nameC.text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                phoneC.text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                picked.isNotEmpty &&
                pb != null;

            Future<void> pickProof() async {
              try {
                final FilePickerResult? res =
                    await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
                  type: FileType.custom,
                  allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'pdf'],
                  withData: true,
                );
                if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
                  return;
                }
                final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
                final Uint8List? b = f.bytes;
                if (b == null) {
                  return;
                }
                String ext = '';
                if (f.extension != null) {
                  ext = f.extension.toString().toLowerCase();
                }
                setD(() {
                  proofBytes = b;
                  proofIsPdf = ext == 'pdf';
                  proofExt = ext.isEmpty ? 'jpg' : ext;
                  proofName = f.name;
                  formError = null;
                });
              } catch (e) {
                debugPrint('LAZO listing proof error: ' + e.toString());
              }
            }

            Future<void> doSubmit() async {
              final Uint8List? bytes = proofBytes;
              if (bytes == null) {
                return;
              }
              setD(() {
                busy = true;
                formError = null;
              });
              try {
                String slugish = nameC.text
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .replaceAll(RegExp('[^a-z0-9]+'), '-');
                if (slugish.length > 60) {
                  slugish = slugish.substring(0, 60);
                }
                final String cType = proofIsPdf
                    ? 'application/pdf'
                    : (proofExt == 'png'
                        ? 'image/png'
                        : (proofExt == 'webp' ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg'));
                final String proofPath = 'verification/' +
                    u.uid +
                    '/listing_' +
                    slugish +
                    '.' +
                    proofExt;
                final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(proofPath);
                await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: cType));
                String web = webC.text.trim();
                if (web.isNotEmpty && !web.startsWith('http')) {
                  web = 'https://' + web;
                }
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('listingRequests')
                    .add({
                  'uid': u.uid,
                  'email': u.email,
                  'businessName': nameC.text.trim(),
                  'phone': phoneC.text.trim(),
                  'website': web,
                  'metroId': _claimMetro,
                  'categories': picked.toList(),
                  'serviceArea': true,
                  'status': 'pending',
                  'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                  'legalEntityName': legalEntityC.text.trim(),
                  'proofPath': proofPath,
                });
                if (ctx2.mounted) {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
                }
              } catch (e) {
                debugPrint('LAZO listing submit error: ' + e.toString());
                setD(() {
                  busy = false;
                  formError = 'Something went wrong submitting - try again.';
                });
              }
            }

            final List<Widget> chips = [];
            for (int i = 0; i < _catIds.length; i++) {
              final String id = _catIds[i];
              final bool sel = picked.contains(id);
              chips.add(FilterChip(
                label: Text(_catNames[i],
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: sel ? ivory : plum)),
                selected: sel,
                selectedColor: plum,
                backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                checkmarkColor: ivory,
                side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.6)),
                onSelected: _hb(busy
                    ? null
                    : (bool val) {
                        setD(() {
                          if (val) {
                            picked.add(id);
                          } else {
                            picked.remove(id);
                          }
                        });
                      }),
              ));
            }

            return Dialog(

                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 44,

                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                  colors: [plumDeep, plum]),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(Icons.add_business_rounded,
                                color: gold, size: 22),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: const [
                                Text('JOIN LAZO',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: gold,
                                        fontSize: 10.5,
                                        letterSpacing: 2.2,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                SizedBox(height: 2),
                                Text('Add your business',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: plum,
                                        fontSize: 18,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      const Text(
                          'Free forever. We verify every business so couples can trust every profile.',
                          style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12.5)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 18),
                      TextField(
                          controller: nameC,
                          enabled: !busy,
                          onChanged: (String s) {
                            setD(() {});
                          },
                          cursorColor: plum,
                          style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 15),
                          decoration: ldeco('Business name')),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      TextField(
                          controller: phoneC,
                          enabled: !busy,
                          onChanged: (String s) {
                            setD(() {});
                          },
                          keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                          cursorColor: plum,

  Future<void> _setStatus(String id, String status) async {
    try {
      await _setStatusInner(id, status);
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not update: ' + _errText(e));
      debugPrint('LAZO setStatus: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _setStatusInner(String id, String status) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> update = {'status': status};
    if (status == 'responded') {
      update['respondedAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
    }
    if (status == 'booked') {
      update['bookedAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
    }
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .doc(id)
        .update(update);
  }

  // ---------------- v149: TYPE, RULES, SHARED MATH ----------------

  // The serif carries names, section titles and the big numbers - the same
  // voice as the Lazo brand system. Lining figures so a 1 never reads as I.
  TextStyle _serif(
      {double size = 24,
      FontWeight weight = FontWeight.w600,
      Color color = plum,
      double height = 1.05}) {
    // v175: display sizes tighten as they grow; body stays at 0.
    final double track = size >= 26 ? -0.015 * size : 0;
    try {
      return GoogleFonts.cormorantGaramond(
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: color,
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track,
          fontFeatures: const <FontFeature>[FontFeature.liningFigures()]);
    } catch (_) {
      return TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'serif',
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: color,
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track);
    }
  }

  // v175: pushed views (inbox, account, editor) slide in from the right and
  // leave the way they came. Whatever was underneath only fades. A key that
  // ends in ':root' marks "underneath".
  Widget _viewSwitch(Widget child) {
    final bool reduced = _reducedMotion(context);
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 260),
      reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 200),
      switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
      layoutBuilder: (Widget? current, List<Widget> previous) => Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: <Widget>[...previous, if (current != null) current],
      ),
      transitionBuilder: (Widget c, Animation<double> a) {
        final Key? k = c.key;
        final bool root = k is ValueKey<String> && k.value.endsWith(':root');
        final Widget faded = FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: c);
        if (reduced || root) return faded;
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(.04, 0), end: Offset.zero)
              .animate(a),
          child: faded,
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  // One rule set for profile strength. The editor's save bar, the dashboard
  // list and the completion confetti all read this; weights sum to 100.
  List<List<dynamic>> _strengthChecks({
    required int bioLen,
    required bool hasCover,
    required bool hasLogo,
    required int photos,
    required int packages,
    required bool hasSheet,
    required bool hasStartPrice,
    required bool hasVideo,
    required int faqs,
    required bool hasContact,
  }) {
    return <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>['Write a fuller bio', bioLen >= 80, 15, '80+ characters'],
      <dynamic>[
        'Add a cover photo',
        hasCover,
        10,
        'the banner behind your name'
      ],
      <dynamic>['Add your logo', hasLogo, 5, '2 min'],
      <dynamic>[
        'Six or more photos',
        photos >= 6,
        20,
        photos >= 6 ? '$photos' : '$photos of 6'
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Packages or a price sheet',
        packages >= 1 || hasSheet,
        15,
        'what couples can book'
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Set a starting price',
        hasStartPrice,
        10,
        'couples self-qualify'
      ],
      <dynamic>['Add a video', hasVideo, 10, 'motion sells emotion'],
      <dynamic>['Answer two FAQs', faqs >= 2, 10, 'stops repeat emails'],
      <dynamic>[
        'A phone or public email',
        hasContact,
        5,
        'how couples reach you'
      ],
    ];
  }

  List<List<dynamic>> _strengthFromVendor(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final int photos =
        vd['gallery'] is List ? (vd['gallery'] as List).length : 0;
    final int packages =
        vd['packages'] is List ? (vd['packages'] as List).length : 0;
    final int faqs =
        vd['vendorFaqs'] is List ? (vd['vendorFaqs'] as List).length : 0;
    final bool hasVideo = (vd['videoUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty ||
        (vd['videoSamples'] is List && (vd['videoSamples'] as List).isNotEmpty);
    return _strengthChecks(
      bioLen: (vd['bio'] ?? '').toString().trim().length,
      hasCover: (vd['coverUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty,
      hasLogo: (vd['logoUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty,
      photos: photos,
      packages: packages,
      hasSheet: (vd['priceSheetUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty,
      hasStartPrice: (vd['startingPrice'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty ||
          (vd['priceRangeDisplay'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty,
      hasVideo: hasVideo,
      faqs: faqs,
      hasContact: (vd['phone'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty ||
          (vd['publicEmail'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty,
    );
  }

  List<List<dynamic>> _epChecks() {
    return _strengthChecks(
      bioLen: _epBioC.text.trim().length,
      hasCover: _epCoverUrl.isNotEmpty,
      hasLogo: _epLogoUrl.isNotEmpty,
      photos: _epGallery.length,
      packages: _epPackages.length,
      hasSheet: _epPriceSheetUrl.isNotEmpty,
      hasStartPrice:
          _epStartPriceC.text.trim().isNotEmpty || _epPriceRange.isNotEmpty,
      hasVideo: _epVideoC.text.trim().isNotEmpty ||
          _epVidCs.any((TextEditingController c) => c.text.trim().isNotEmpty),
      faqs: _epFaqs.length,
      hasContact:
          _epPhoneC.text.trim().isNotEmpty || _epEmailC.text.trim().isNotEmpty,
    );
  }

  int _strengthPct(List<List<dynamic>> checks) {
    int pct = 0;
    for (final List<dynamic> c in checks) {
      if (c[1] == true) {
        pct = pct + (c[2] as int);
      }
    }
    return pct;
  }

  // Reply stats from the leads stream - the hero, the response-speed card
  // and the collapsed activity line all use the same numbers.
  Map<String, num> _replyStats(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) {
    int replied = 0;
    int totalMin = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final dynamic ca = m['createdAt'];
      final dynamic ra = m['respondedAt'];
      if (ca is Timestamp && ra is Timestamp) {
        replied = replied + 1;
        totalMin =
            totalMin + ra.toDate().difference(ca.toDate()).inMinutes.abs();
      }
    }
    return <String, num>{
      'total': docs.length,
      'replied': replied,
      'avgMin': replied == 0 ? 0 : (totalMin / replied).round(),
      'rate': docs.isEmpty ? 0 : replied / docs.length,
    };
  }

  String _avgLabel(int avgMin, int replied) {
    if (replied == 0) {
      return '\u2014';
    }
    if (avgMin < 60) {
      return '${avgMin}m';
    }
    if (avgMin < 60 * 24) {
      return '${(avgMin / 60).round()}h';
    }
    return '${(avgMin / 1440).round()}d';
  }

  String _shortDate(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${mo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  }

  String _initials(String name) {
    final List<String> parts = name
        .replaceAll('&', ' ')
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty && w.toLowerCase() != 'and')
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) {
      return 'C';
    }
    if (parts.length == 1) {
      return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
    }
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  }

  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _leadDocs(
      AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
    return (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'flagged')
        .toList();
  }

    double tint = .55,

      margin: margin,
      padding: padding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: card,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        border: Border.all(color: borderColor ?? goldLine, width: 1),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }

          key: const ValueKey<String>('admin'), child: _adminView());
    } else {
      body = KeyedSubtree(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('dash:root'),
        child: StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          stream: _userDocStream(),
          initialData: _liveD['user:$_uid']?.latest,
          builder: (BuildContext context,
              AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> userSnap) {
            String vendorId = '';
            if (userSnap.hasData && userSnap.data != null) {
              final Map<String, dynamic>? d = userSnap.data!.data();
              if (d != null && d['vendorId'] != null) {
                vendorId = d['vendorId'].toString();
              }

            if (vendorId.isNotEmpty) {
              return _claimedView(vendorId);

            return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
              stream: _liveQuery(
                  'claims:$_uid',

                      .collection('claimRequests')
                      .where('uid', isEqualTo: _uid)),

                  AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>

                    claimSnap.data != null &&
                    claimSnap.data!.docs.isNotEmpty) {
                  return _pendingView(claimSnap.data!.docs.first.data());

                  stream: _liveQuery(
                      'listings:$_uid',
                      () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                          .collection('listingRequests')

  Widget _resultsView() {
    if (_searching) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold));
    }
    if (!_searched) {
      return const Center(
        child: Text('Search for your business to claim it.',
            style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13)),
      );
    }
    if (_searchError != null) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Text(_searchError == null ? '' : _searchError!,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13)),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (_results.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Text('No match - check spelling.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13)),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold,
                    foregroundColor: plum,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 20, vertical: 13)),
                onPressed: _h(_addListing),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add_business_rounded, size: 18),
                label: const Text('Add my business',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 24),
      itemCount: _results.length,
      itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> v = _results[i];
        final String vName = v['name'] == null ? '' : v['name'].toString();
        final String vAddr =
            v['address'] == null ? '' : v['address'].toString();
        final String vMetro =
            v['metroId'] == null ? '' : _metroLabel(v['metroId'].toString());
        String sub = vAddr;
        if (vMetro.isNotEmpty) {
          if (sub.isNotEmpty) {
            sub = sub + ' - ' + vMetro;
          } else {
            sub = vMetro;
          }
        }
        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: gold),
          ),
          child: ListTile(
            title: Text(vName,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 15)),
            subtitle: Text(sub,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
            trailing: (v['claimStatus'] == 'claimed')
                ? Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFF1E9E0),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      border: Border.all(color: gold),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: const [
                        Icon(Icons.lock_rounded, size: 13, color: muted),
                        SizedBox(width: 5),
                        Text('Already claimed',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                color: muted,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  )
                : ElevatedButton(
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
                    onPressed: _h(_submitting
                        ? null
                        : () {
                            _submitClaim(v);
                          }),
                    child: const Text('This is me',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _pendingView(Map<String, dynamic> claim) {
    final String name = claim['businessName'] == null
        ? 'your business'
        : claim['businessName'].toString();
    final String status =
        claim['status'] == null ? 'pending' : claim['status'].toString();

    // v148: a claim the AI reviewer never finished (as happened during the
    // credit outage) used to spin on "Almost there..." forever. After three
    // minutes it tells the truth: a person will finish the review.
    final dynamic createdAt = claim['createdAt'];
    final bool stale = status == 'pending' &&
        createdAt is Timestamp &&
        DateTime.now().difference(createdAt.toDate()).inMinutes >= 3;

    if (status == 'denied') {
      _stopPendingMotion();
      final String reason =
          claim['denyReason'] == null ? '' : claim['denyReason'].toString();
      return Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
          child: Container(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(26),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: [plumDeep, plum]),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
              border: Border.all(color: gold),
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 58,
                  height: 58,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: ivory,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                      color: plum, size: 30),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                const Text('About your claim',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: ivory,
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(
                    reason.isEmpty
                        ? 'We were not able to approve this claim with the information provided.'
                        : reason,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ivory, fontSize: 13.5)),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                const Text('Think this is a mistake? vendors@meetlazo.com',
                    style: TextStyle(color: gold, fontSize: 12.5)),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (status == 'needs_review' || stale) {
      _stopPendingMotion();
      return Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
          child: Container(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(26),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: [plumDeep, plum]),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
              border: Border.all(color: gold),
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 58,
                  height: 58,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: gold,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  ),

  // ---------------- ADMIN DESK ----------------

  String _slugify(String s) {
    String out = s.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp('[^a-z0-9]+'), '-');
    while (out.contains('--')) {
      out = out.replaceAll('--', '-');
    }
    if (out.startsWith('-')) {
      out = out.substring(1);
    }
    if (out.endsWith('-')) {
      out = out.substring(0, out.length - 1);
    }
    if (out.length > 60) {
      out = out.substring(0, 60);
    }
    return out;
  }

  Future<void> _openUrl(String url) async {
    try {
      final Uri? uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
      if (uri == null) {
        return;
      }
      final bool ok = await canLaunchUrl(uri);
      if (ok) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO openUrl error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _viewProof(String proofPath) async {
    try {
      final String url =
          await FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(proofPath).getDownloadURL();
      if (proofPath.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')) {
        await _openUrl(url);
        return;
      }
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
          return Dialog(
            backgroundColor: plumDeep,
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    child: InteractiveViewer(
                      child: Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.contain),
                    ),
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: _h(() {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    }),
                    child: const Text('Close', style: TextStyle(color: gold)),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not open proof document.');
      debugPrint('LAZO admin proof error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _adminApproveClaim(
      String requestId, Map<String, dynamic> req) async {
    final String vendorId =
        req['vendorId'] == null ? '' : req['vendorId'].toString();
    final String claimantUid = req['uid'] == null ? '' : req['uid'].toString();
    if (vendorId.isEmpty || claimantUid.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Request is missing vendor or user id.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vSnap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('vendors')
              .doc(vendorId)
              .get();
      if (!vSnap.exists) {
        _toast('Vendor listing not found.');
        return;
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic>? vData = vSnap.data();
      if (vData != null &&
          vData['claimedBy'] != null &&
          vData['claimedBy'].toString().isNotEmpty &&
          vData['claimedBy'].toString() != claimantUid) {
        _toast('Conflict: vendor already claimed by another account.');
        return;
      }
      final WriteBatch batch = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      batch.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vendorId), {
        'claimedBy': claimantUid,
        'claimStatus': 'claimed',
        'verified': true,
      });
      batch.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(claimantUid), {
        'vendorId': vendorId,
      });
      batch.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('claimRequests').doc(requestId),
          {
            'status': 'approved',
            'approvedBy': 'admin',
            'actedByUid': _uid,
          });
      await batch.commit();
      _toast('Approved - their dashboard is live.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Approve failed - check rules and try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO admin approve error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _adminApproveListing(
      String requestId, Map<String, dynamic> req) async {
    final String claimantUid = req['uid'] == null ? '' : req['uid'].toString();
    final String bName =
        req['businessName'] == null ? '' : req['businessName'].toString();
    final String metroId =
        req['metroId'] == null ? 'phoenix' : req['metroId'].toString();
    if (claimantUid.isEmpty || bName.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Request is missing details.');
      return;
    }
    final String slug = _slugify(bName);
    final String vendorId = 'manual-' + metroId + '-' + slug;
    try {
      final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> vRef =
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vendorId);
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vSnap = await vRef.get();
      if (vSnap.exists) {
        final Map<String, dynamic>? vData = vSnap.data();
        if (vData != null &&
            vData['claimedBy'] != null &&
            vData['claimedBy'].toString().isNotEmpty &&
            vData['claimedBy'].toString() != claimantUid) {
          _toast('Conflict: that listing already exists and is claimed.');
          return;
        }
      }
      final List<String> cats = [];
      if (req['categories'] is List) {
        for (final dynamic c in (req['categories'] as List)) {
          cats.add(c.toString());
        }
      }
      final WriteBatch batch = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      batch.set(
          vRef,
          {
            'placeId': vendorId,
            'name': bName,
            'slug': slug,
            'address': 'Serving ' + _metroLabel(metroId),
            'phone': req['phone'] == null ? '' : req['phone'].toString(),
            'website': req['website'] == null ? '' : req['website'].toString(),
            'metroId': metroId,
            'categories': cats,
            'score': 65,
            'reviewCount': 0,
            'claimStatus': 'claimed',
            'claimedBy': claimantUid,
            'verified': true,
            'source': 'manual',
            'serviceArea': true,
            'seededAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          },
          SetOptions(merge: true));
      batch.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(claimantUid), {
        'vendorId': vendorId,
      });
      batch.update(
          FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('listingRequests')
              .doc(requestId),
          {
            'status': 'approved',
            'approvedBy': 'admin',
            'actedByUid': _uid,
          });
      await batch.commit();
      _toast('Listing created and claimed - their dashboard is live.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Approve failed - check rules and try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO admin listing approve error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _adminDeny(String collection, String requestId) async {
    final TextEditingController reasonC = TextEditingController();
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Deny this request?',
              style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          content: TextField(
            controller: reasonC,
            maxLines: 3,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Reason (shown to the vendor)',
                border: OutlineInputBorder()),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() {
                Navigator.pop(ctx, false);
              }),
              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: ink)),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFB3413A),
                  foregroundColor: ivory),
              onPressed: _h(() {
                Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
              }),
              child: const Text('Deny'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
    if (ok != true) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection(collection)
          .doc(requestId)
          .update({
        'status': 'denied',
        'denyReason': reasonC.text.trim(),
        'approvedBy': 'admin',
        'actedByUid': _uid,
      });
      _toast('Denied.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Deny failed - try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO admin deny error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _adminQueue(String collection) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'admin:$collection',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection(collection)
              .where('status', whereIn: <String>['pending', 'needs_review'])),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        if (snap.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold));
        }
        if (snap.hasError) {
          return const Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Text('Could not load queue - check admin rules.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13)),
            ),
          );
        }
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs = [];
        if (snap.hasData && snap.data != null) {
          docs.addAll(snap.data!.docs);
        }
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const Center(
            child: Text('Queue clear - nothing awaiting review.',
                style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13.5)),
          );
        }
        return ListView.builder(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 12, 18, 24),
          itemCount: docs.length,
          itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int i) {
            return _adminCard(collection, docs[i].id, docs[i].data());
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _adminCard(
      String collection, String requestId, Map<String, dynamic> req) {
    final bool isListing = collection == 'listingRequests';
    final String bName =
        req['businessName'] == null ? '' : req['businessName'].toString();
    final String status =
        req['status'] == null ? 'pending' : req['status'].toString();
    final String aiNotes =
        req['aiNotes'] == null ? '' : req['aiNotes'].toString();
    final String proofPath =
        req['proofPath'] == null ? '' : req['proofPath'].toString();

    final List<String> lines = [];
    if (req['email'] != null) {
      lines.add('Account: ' + req['email'].toString());
    }
    if (req['businessEmail'] != null) {
      lines.add('Biz email: ' + req['businessEmail'].toString());
    }
    if (req['businessPhone'] != null) {
      lines.add('Biz phone: ' + req['businessPhone'].toString());
    }
    if (req['phone'] != null) {
      lines.add('Phone: ' + req['phone'].toString());
    }
    if (req['website'] != null && req['website'].toString().isNotEmpty) {
      lines.add('Web: ' + req['website'].toString());
    }
    if (req['claimantRole'] != null) {
      lines.add('Role: ' + req['claimantRole'].toString());
    }
    if (req['metroId'] != null) {
      lines.add('Metro: ' + _metroLabel(req['metroId'].toString()));
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
            color: status == 'needs_review' ? const Color(0xFFB3413A) : gold),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(bName,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 16.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
              Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: status == 'needs_review'
                      ? const Color(0xFFF7E8E6)
                      : gold.withOpacity(0.25),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                ),
                child: Text(
                    (isListing ? 'NEW LISTING - ' : 'CLAIM - ') +
                        status.toUpperCase(),
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        letterSpacing: 1,
                        color: status == 'needs_review'
                            ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
                            : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(lines.join('  ·  '),
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
          if (aiNotes.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: ivory,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(0.5)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text('AI REVIEW',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 9.5,
                          letterSpacing: 1.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(aiNotes,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: ink)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 12),

                      side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(0.7))),
                  onPressed: _h(() {
                    _viewProof(proofPath);
                  }),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.description_rounded, size: 16),
                  label: const Text('Proof', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                ),
              const Spacer(),

                    side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFB3413A))),
                onPressed: _h(() {

                }),

              const SizedBox(width: 8),

                child: const Text('Approve',

        ],
      ),
    );
  }

        ? (v['phone'] == null ? '' : v['phone'].toString())
        : v['notifyPhone'].toString();
    final Map<String, dynamic> ar = v['autoReply'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(v['autoReply'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    _epAutoOn = ar['enabled'] == true;
    _epAutoInstantC.text =
        ar['instant'] == null ? '' : ar['instant'].toString();
    _epAutoDay3C.text = ar['day3'] == null ? '' : ar['day3'].toString();
    _epAutoDay5C.text = ar['day5'] == null ? '' : ar['day5'].toString();
    _epFaqs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    if (v['vendorFaqs'] is List) {
      for (final dynamic f in v['vendorFaqs'] as List<dynamic>) {
        if (f is Map) {
          _epFaqs.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(f));
        }
      }
    }
    _epCoverFocusY = v['coverFocusY'] is num
        ? (v['coverFocusY'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 100)
        : 50;
    for (final TextEditingController c in _epVidCs) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    _epVidCs = <TextEditingController>[];
    if (v['videoSamples'] is List) {
      for (final dynamic s in v['videoSamples'] as List<dynamic>) {
        _epVidCs.add(TextEditingController(text: s.toString()));
      }
    }
    if (_epVidCs.isEmpty) {
      _epVidCs.add(TextEditingController());
    }
    _epBaseline = _epFingerprint();
    setState(() => _editingProfile = true);
  }

  // v140: twenty minutes of bio writing must never die to a stray tap.
  String _epFingerprint() {
    return <String>[
      _epBioC.text,
      _epPhoneC.text,
      _epWebC.text,
      _epEmailC.text,
      _epStartPriceC.text,
      _epVideoC.text,
      _epServicesC.text,
      _epAnnTitleC.text,
      _epAnnTextC.text,
      _epOwnerNameC.text,
      _epOwnerTitleC.text,
      _epInstaC.text,
      _epOwnerPhotoUrl,
      _epOwnerBioC.text,
      _epPriceRange,
      _epLeadGender,
      _epLgbtqOwned.toString(),
      (_epCats.toList()..sort()).join(','),
      (_epMetros.toList()..sort()).join(','),
      _epHomeMetro,
      _epGallery.join(','),
      jsonEncode(_epPackages),
      jsonEncode(_epPreferred),
      jsonEncode(_epFaqs),
      _epPriceSheetUrl,
      _epCoverUrl,
      _epLogoUrl,
      _epCoverFocusY.toStringAsFixed(1),
      (_epUnavail.toList()..sort()).join(','),
      (_epStyles.toList()..sort()).join(','),
      _epAttrSde.toString(),
      _epAttrDrone.toString(),
      _epAttrFilm.toString(),
      _epTeamLead,
      _epCategory,
      _epAutoOn.toString(),
      _epAutoInstantC.text,
      _epAutoDay3C.text,
      _epAutoDay5C.text,
      _epNotifyPhoneC.text,
      _epVidCs.map((TextEditingController c) => c.text).join('|'),
    ].join('\u241f');
  }

  void _epTryClose() {
    if (_epFingerprint() == _epBaseline) {
      setState(() => _editingProfile = false);
      return;
    }
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,

            style: TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: const Text(
            "You've edited your profile since it was last saved. Leaving now throws those edits away.",
            style: TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(dCtx).pop()),

                    color: Color(0xFFB04343), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
