  }

  String _epContentType(String name) {
    final String n = name.toLowerCase();
    if (n.endsWith('.png')) {
      return 'image/png';
    }
    if (n.endsWith('.webp')) {
      return 'image/webp';
    }
    return 'image/jpeg';
  }

  int get _epGalleryCap => _isAdminUser ? 30 : 10;

  Future<void> _epUploadGalleryPhotos() async {
    if (_epUploading) {
      return;
    }
    final int cap = _epGalleryCap;
    final int remaining = cap - _epGallery.length;
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      _toast(_isAdminUser
          ? 'Gallery is at its $cap-photo limit.'
          : 'Free profiles include 10 photos. Unlimited gallery is coming with Lazo Pro.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        allowMultiple: true,
        withData: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
        return;
      }
      List<PlatformFile> files = res.files;
      if (files.length > remaining) {
        bool proceed = false;
        await showDialog<void>(
          context: context,
          builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: ivory,
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title: const Text('That\u2019s a lot of beautiful work',
                style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            content: Text(
                'You picked ${files.length} photos, and this gallery has room for $remaining more (of $cap). Upload the first $remaining now?',
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14)),
            actions: <Widget>[
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                }),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted)),
              ),
              FilledButton(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
                onPressed: _h(() {
                  proceed = true;
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                }),
                child: Text('Upload $remaining'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
        if (!proceed) {
          return;
        }
        files = files.sublist(0, remaining);
      }
      setState(() {
        _epUploading = true;
        _epUploadNote = 'Preparing\u2026';
      });
      int added = 0;
      int failed = 0;
      for (int i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        final PlatformFile f = files[i];
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() =>
              _epUploadNote = 'Uploading ${i + 1} of ${files.length}\u2026');
        }
        try {
          final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
          if (bytes == null) {
            failed = failed + 1;
            continue;
          }
          if (bytes.length > 20 * 1024 * 1024) {
            failed = failed + 1;
            continue;
          }
          final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
              ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.'))
              : '.jpg';
          final String path =
              'vendors/$_epVendorId/media/g${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$i$ext';
          final Uint8List slim = await _downscale(bytes, f.name);
          final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
          await ref.putData(
              slim, SettableMetadata(contentType: _epContentType(f.name)));
          final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
          final String busted =
              '$url${url.contains('?') ? '&' : '?'}v=${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';
          if (!mounted) {
            return;
          }
          setState(() => _epGallery.add(busted));
          added = added + 1;
        } catch (e) {
          failed = failed + 1;
        }
      }
      _toast(failed == 0
          ? '$added photo${added == 1 ? '' : 's'} uploaded (web-sized so pages load fast) - save profile to publish.'
          : '$added uploaded, $failed failed - you can retry the rest.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Upload failed: ' + _errText(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _epUploading = false;
          _epUploadNote = '';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _epUploadPriceSheet() async {
    if (_epUploading) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['pdf'],
        withData: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
        return;
      }
      final Uint8List? bytes = res.files.first.bytes;
      if (bytes == null) {
        return;
      }
      if (bytes.length > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        _toast('Price sheet must be under 10MB.');
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _epUploading = true);
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance
          .ref('vendors/$_epVendorId/docs/pricesheet.pdf');
      await ref.putData(
          bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: 'application/pdf'));
      final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _epPriceSheetUrl =
          '$url${url.contains('?') ? '&' : '?'}v=${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}');
      _toast('Price sheet uploaded - save profile to publish.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Upload failed: ' + _errText(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _epUploading = false);
      }
    }
  }

    }

  String _epVariantUrl(String u) {
    try {
      if (u.isEmpty || !u.contains('/o/')) {
        return u;
      }
      final int oIdx = u.indexOf('/o/');
      final String base = u.substring(0, oIdx);
      String enc = u.substring(oIdx + 3);
      final int qIdx = enc.indexOf('?');
      if (qIdx >= 0) {
        enc = enc.substring(0, qIdx);
      }
      final String path = Uri.decodeComponent(enc);
      final int dot = path.lastIndexOf('.');
      final int slash = path.lastIndexOf('/');
      final String newPath = dot > slash
          ? '${path.substring(0, dot)}_1600x1600${path.substring(dot)}'
          : '${path}_1600x1600';
      return '$base/o/${Uri.encodeComponent(newPath)}?alt=media';
    } catch (e) {
      return u;
    }
  }

  Widget _epThumb(String url,
      {double? width, double? height, BoxFit fit = BoxFit.cover}) {
    return Image(
      image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(_epVariantUrl(url)), width: 400),
      width: width,
      height: height,
      fit: fit,
      errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? s) {
        return Image(
          image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(url), width: 400),
          width: width,
          height: height,
          fit: fit,
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c2, Object e2, StackTrace? s2) {
            return Container(
                width: width,
                height: height,
                color: const Color(0xFFEFE6DA),
                child: const Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                    color: muted, size: 18));
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _epPickPreferred() async {
    if (_epPreferred.length >= 6) {
      _toast('Up to 6 preferred vendors.');
      return;
    }
    final TextEditingController searchC = TextEditingController();
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    bool searching = false;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Add a preferred vendor',
              style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 340,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                TextField(
                  controller: searchC,
                  cursorColor: plum,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14.5),
                  decoration: _epDeco('Search by business name', 'Any metro'),
                  onSubmitted: (String q) async {
                    final String raw = q.trim();
                    if (raw.length < 2) {
                      return;
                    }
                    setD(() => searching = true);
                    try {
                      final String tq = _tcV(raw);
                      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap =
                          await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                              .collection('vendors')
                              .orderBy('name')
                              .startAt(<String>[tq])
                              .endAt(<String>['$tq\uf8ff'])
                              .limit(12)
                              .get();
                      results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
                      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                          in snap.docs) {
                        final Map<String, dynamic> vd = d.data();
                        if (d.id == _epVendorId) {
                          continue;
                        }
                        results.add(<String, dynamic>{
                          'placeId': d.id,
                          'name': vd['name'] ?? '',
                          'metroId': vd['metroId'] ?? '',
                        });
                      }
                    } catch (e) {
                      results = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
                    }
                    setD(() => searching = false);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                const Text('Press enter to search',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                if (searching)
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold),
                  ),
                if (!searching)
                  SizedBox(
                    height: 220,
                    child: ListView.builder(
                      itemCount: results.length,
                      itemBuilder: (BuildContext c2, int i) {
                        final Map<String, dynamic> r = results[i];
                        return ListTile(
                          dense: true,
                          title: Text(r['name'].toString(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  fontSize: 13.5)),
                          subtitle: Text(r['metroId'].toString(),
                              style:
                                  const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
                          trailing: TextButton(
                            onPressed: _h(() {
                              setState(() {
                                _epPreferred.add(r);
                              });
                              Navigator.pop(ctx);
                            }),
                            child: const Text('Add',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              }),
              child: const Text('Close', style: TextStyle(color: muted)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _tcV(String s) => s
      .split(' ')
      .map((String w) =>
          w.isEmpty ? w : '${w[0].toUpperCase()}${w.substring(1)}')
      .join(' ');

  Future<void> _saveProfile() async {
    if (_epSaving || _epVendorId.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _epSaving = true);
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> update = <String, dynamic>{
        'bio': _epBioC.text.trim(),
        'phone': _epPhoneC.text.trim(),
        'website': _epWebC.text.trim(),
        'publicEmail': _epEmailC.text.trim(),
        'startingPrice': _epStartPriceC.text.trim(),
        'priceRangeDisplay': _epPriceRange,
        'leadGender': _epLeadGender,
        'lgbtqOwned': _epLgbtqOwned,
        'videoUrl': _epVideoC.text.trim(),
        'servicesNote': _epServicesC.text.trim(),
        'categories': _epCats.toList(),
        'serviceMetros': _epMetros.toList(),
        'coverUrl': _epCoverUrl,
        'logoUrl': _epLogoUrl,
        'ownerName': _epOwnerNameC.text.trim(),
        'ownerTitle': _epOwnerTitleC.text.trim(),
        'ownerPhotoUrl': _epOwnerPhotoUrl,
        'ownerBio': _epOwnerBioC.text.trim(),
        'instagramUrl': _epInstaC.text.trim(),
        'vendorFaqs': _epFaqs,
        'unavailableDates': (_epUnavail.toList()..sort()),
        'attributes': <String, dynamic>{
          'styles': _epStyles.toList(),
          'sameDayEdit': _epAttrSde,
          'drone': _epAttrDrone,
          'filmCapture': _epAttrFilm,
          'teamLead': _epTeamLead,
          'languages': _epLangs.toList(),
          'lgbtqFriendly': _epAttrLgbtq,
          'settings': _epSettings.toList(),
          'capacityBand': _epCapacity,
          'onSiteCatering': _epAttrCatering,
          'byoVendors': _epAttrByo,
          'ceremonyAndReception': _epAttrCerRec,
          'lodging': _epAttrLodging,
          'petFriendly': _epAttrPets,
        },
        'notifySms': _epNotifySms,
        'notifyPhone': _epNotifyPhoneC.text.trim(),
        'autoReply': <String, dynamic>{
          'enabled': _epAutoOn,
          'instant': _epAutoInstantC.text.trim(),
          'day3': _epAutoDay3C.text.trim(),
          'day5': _epAutoDay5C.text.trim(),
        },
        'coverFocusY': _epCoverFocusY.round(),
        'gallery': _epGallery,
        'packages': _epPackages,
        'preferredVendors': _epPreferred,
        'priceSheetUrl': _epPriceSheetUrl,
        'videoSamples': _epVidCs
            .map((TextEditingController c) => c.text.trim())
            .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
            .take(4)
            .toList(),
        'profileUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      if (_epAnnTitleC.text.trim().isNotEmpty ||
          _epAnnTextC.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        update['announcement'] = <String, dynamic>{
          'title': _epAnnTitleC.text.trim(),
          'text': _epAnnTextC.text.trim(),
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        };
      } else {
        update['announcement'] = null;
      }
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(_epVendorId)
          .update(update);
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _epSaving = false;
        _editingProfile = false;
      });
      _toast('Profile saved - your public page updates within a minute.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _epSaving = false);
      _toast('Could not save - check your connection and try again.');
    }
  }

  Widget _epCard(String title, String subtitle, List<Widget> children) {
    return _glass(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      tint: .6,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            Container(
              width: 7,
              height: 7,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: gold, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 9),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(title,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: plum,
                      fontSize: 15.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ]),
          if (subtitle.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 5, left: 16),
              child: Text(subtitle,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
            ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 11, bottom: 13),
            child: Container(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.3)),
          ),
          ...children,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  InputDecoration _epDeco(String label, String hint) {
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label,
      hintText: hint,
      labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13),
      floatingLabelStyle: const TextStyle(
          color: plum, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
      hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFB9AFC0), fontSize: 13),
      isDense: true,
      filled: true,
      fillColor: const Color(0xFFFFFDF8),
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 13),
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
        borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.14)),
      ),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
        borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.14)),
      ),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: gold, width: 1.7),
      ),
    );
  }

                    onPressed: _h(() {
                      setState(() => _epCalMonth =
                          DateTime(_epCalMonth.year, _epCalMonth.month + 1, 1));
                    }),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Row(
                children: const <String>['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S']
                    .map((String d) => Expanded(
                          child: Text(d,
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  color: muted,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ))
                    .toList(),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Builder(builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
                final int daysIn =
                    DateTime(_epCalMonth.year, _epCalMonth.month + 1, 0).day;
                final int lead =
                    DateTime(_epCalMonth.year, _epCalMonth.month, 1).weekday %
                        7;
                final DateTime today = DateTime.now();
                final DateTime todayD =
                    DateTime(today.year, today.month, today.day);
                final List<Widget> cells = <Widget>[];
                for (int i = 0; i < lead; i++) {
                  cells.add(const SizedBox());
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= daysIn; d++) {
                  final DateTime dt =
                      DateTime(_epCalMonth.year, _epCalMonth.month, d);
                  final String iso =
                      '${dt.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
                  final bool past = dt.isBefore(todayD);
                  final bool booked = _epUnavail.contains(iso);
                  cells.add(
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                      child: InkWell(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                        onTap: past
                            ? null
                            : () {
                                setState(() {
                                  if (booked) {
                                    _epUnavail.remove(iso);
                                  } else {
                                    _epUnavail.add(iso);
                                  }
                                });
                              },
                        child: Container(
                          height: 34,
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: booked
                                ? plumDeep
                                : (past ? Colors.transparent : ivory),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                            border: past
                                ? null
                                : Border.all(
                                    color: booked
                                        ? plumDeep
                                        : gold.withOpacity(.45)),
                          ),
                          child: Text('$d',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: booked
                                      ? ivory
                                      : (past ? muted.withOpacity(.4) : ink))),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                final List<Widget> rows = <Widget>[];
                for (int i = 0; i < cells.length; i += 7) {
                  final List<Widget> week = cells
                      .sublist(i, (i + 7) > cells.length ? cells.length : i + 7)
                      .map((Widget c) => Expanded(child: c))
                      .toList();
                  while (week.length < 7) {
                    week.add(const Expanded(child: SizedBox()));
                  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _userDocStream() {
    return _liveDoc('user:$_uid',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid));
  }

  String _errText(Object e) {
    String s = e.toString();
    if (s.contains('unauthorized') ||
        s.contains('permission') ||
        s.contains('403')) {
      return 'Permission denied - storage rules may need updating.';
    }
    if (s.length > 90) {
      s = s.substring(0, 90);
    }
    return s;
  }

  Future<void> _acctChangePhoto() async {
    if (_acctBusy) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        withData: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
        return;
      }
      final Uint8List? bytes = res.files.first.bytes;
      if (bytes == null || bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
        _toast('Photo must be under 8MB.');
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _acctBusy = true);
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(
          'users/$_uid/profile${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.jpg');
      await ref.putData(bytes,
          SettableMetadata(contentType: _epContentType(res.files.first.name)));
      final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(_uid)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'photo_url': url}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Photo updated');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Photo upload failed: ' + _errText(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _acctBusy = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _acctSaveName(String name) async {
    final String n = name.trim();
    if (n.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('users')
        .doc(_uid)
        .set(<String, dynamic>{'display_name': n}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _toast('Name updated');
  }

  // ---------------- v158: BUG REPORTS + IDEAS ----------------
  // Two doors on the Account screen. Report a bug: what happened, where, how
  // bad, an optional screenshot, and the context we always need (build,
  // plan, platform, browser, screen) captured without asking - lands in
  // supportTickets like every other ticket, category 'Report a bug', so God
  // Mode's Tickets queue shows it. Ideas: a shared board (featureRequests)
  // where vendors post what would help them and vote on each other's; we
  // mark Planned / Building / Shipped, so "you asked, we built" is visible
  // to every vendor, not just the one who asked.

  static const String kBuildId = 'JC-LAZO-VDASH-0915-177';
  static const List<String> kBugAreas = <String>[
    'Inbox & messages',
    'Profile & photos',
    'Contracts',
    'Invoices & payments',
    'Galleries',
    'Calendar & dates',
    'Pro / billing',
    'Notifications',
    'Somewhere else',
  ];
  static const List<List<String>> kBugSeverity = <List<String>>[
    <String>['blocks', 'Blocks me', 'I can\u2019t finish something'],
    <String>['annoying', 'Annoying', 'It works, but badly'],
    <String>['cosmetic', 'Cosmetic', 'Looks off, works fine'],
  ];
  static const List<String> kIdeaAreas = <String>[
    'Leads & inbox',
    'Profile',
    'Contracts & invoices',
    'Galleries',
    'Calendar',
    'June',
    'Payments',
    'Mobile app',
    'Other',
  ];

  Map<String, dynamic> _supportContext(String extraView) {
    String platform = kIsWeb ? 'web' : defaultTargetPlatform.name;
    String agent = '';
    String url = '';
    if (kIsWeb) {
      try {
        agent = html.window.navigator.userAgent;
        url = html.window.location.href;
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    final Size sz = MediaQuery.of(context).size;
    return <String, dynamic>{
      'source': 'vendor_dashboard',
      'build': kBuildId,
      'vendorId': _vendorIdCache,
      'platform': platform,
      'userAgent': agent,
      'url': url,
      'screen': '${sz.width.round()}x${sz.height.round()}',
      'view': extraView,
      'at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  InputDecoration _fbDeco(String label, {String? hint}) => InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        alignLabelWithHint: true,
        labelStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.65), fontSize: 13),
        hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFB8AEBD), fontSize: 12.5),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.25))),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum)),
        contentPadding:
            const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
      );

  Widget _fbChip(String label, bool on, VoidCallback onTap, {String? sub}) {
    return _Press(
      tick: _Tick.select,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: on ? plum : Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(color: on ? plum : plum.withOpacity(.25)),
        ),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
          Text(label,
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: on ? ivory : plum,
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          if (sub != null)
            Text(sub,
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: on ? ivory.withOpacity(.8) : muted, fontSize: 10)),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _reportBugSheet() async {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    String area = '';
    String severity = 'annoying';
    final TextEditingController whatC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController stepsC = TextEditingController();
    Uint8List? shot;
    String shotName = '';
    bool busy = false;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Icon(Icons.bug_report_rounded, color: plum, size: 22),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(child: Text('Report a bug', style: _serif(size: 26))),
          ]),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 480,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const Text(
                        'Tell us what went wrong. We read every one, and the fix usually ships within days.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    const Text('WHERE',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            color: plum,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                      for (final String a in kBugAreas)
                        _fbChip(a, area == a, () => setD(() => area = a)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    const Text('HOW BAD',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            color: plum,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                      for (final List<String> s in kBugSeverity)
                        _fbChip(s[1], severity == s[0],
                            () => setD(() => severity = s[0]),
                            sub: s[2]),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: whatC,
                      cursorColor: plum,
                      minLines: 2,
                      maxLines: 5,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                      decoration: _fbDeco('What happened?',
                          hint:
                              'The invoice reminder sent twice to the same couple.'),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    TextField(
                      controller: stepsC,
                      cursorColor: plum,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: 4,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                      decoration: _fbDeco('How can we see it too? (optional)',
                          hint:
                              'Open the thread, tap Remind, wait a minute\u2026'),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: plum,
                            side: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.35))),
                        onPressed: _h(busy
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                try {
                                  final FilePickerResult? r =
                                      await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
                                          type: FileType.image, withData: true);
                                  if (r == null ||
                                      r.files.isEmpty ||
                                      r.files.first.bytes == null) return;
                                  if (r.files.first.bytes!.length >
                                      10 * 1024 * 1024) {
                                    _toast('That screenshot is over 10MB.');
                                    return;
                                  }
                                  setD(() {
                                    shot = r.files.first.bytes;
                                    shotName = r.files.first.name;
                                  });
                                } catch (_) {
                                  _toast('Could not open files.');
                                }
                              }),
                        icon: Icon(
                            shot == null
                                ? Icons.add_photo_alternate_outlined
                                : Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                            size: 17,
                            color: shot == null ? plum : vGreen),
                        label: Text(
                            shot == null ? 'Add a screenshot' : shotName,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      if (shot != null)
                        IconButton(
                            onPressed: _h(() => setD(() => shot = null)),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                color: muted, size: 18)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                        'We attach your plan, build ${kBuildId.split('-').last}, ${kIsWeb ? 'browser' : 'device'} and screen size automatically so you don\u2019t have to.',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                  ]),
            ),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: ink))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: plum, foregroundColor: ivory),
              onPressed: _h(
                  busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          if (whatC.text.trim().length < 8) {
                            _toast(
                                'Tell us a little more about what happened.');
                            return;
                          }
                          setD(() => busy = true);
                          String shotUrl = '';
                          if (shot != null) {
                            try {
                              final String safe = shotName.replaceAll(
                                  RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
                              final String path =
                                  'support/${u.uid}/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safe';
                              final Reference ref =
                                  FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
                              await ref.putData(
                                  shot!,
                                  SettableMetadata(
                                      contentType:
                                          safe.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png')
                                              ? 'image/png'
                                              : 'image/jpeg'));
                              shotUrl = await ref.getDownloadURL();
                            } catch (e) {
                              debugPrint('LAZO bug shot: ' + e.toString());
                              // Ticket still goes; the screenshot is a bonus.
                            }
                          }
                          final String what = whatC.text.trim();
                          final String subject =
                              '${area.isEmpty ? 'Bug' : area}: ${what.length > 60 ? what.substring(0, 60) + '\u2026' : what}';
                          final Map<String, dynamic> cx = _supportContext(area);
                          cx['severity'] = severity;
                          cx['steps'] = stepsC.text.trim();
                          if (shotUrl.isNotEmpty) cx['screenshotUrl'] = shotUrl;
                          try {
                            await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                .collection('supportTickets')
                                .add(<String, dynamic>{
                              'role': 'vendor',
                              'uid': u.uid,
                              'email': u.email ?? '',
                              'category': 'Report a bug',
                              'subject': subject,
                              'message': what,
                              'vendorName': '',
                              'status': 'open',
                              'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                              'context': cx,
                            });
                            if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                            _toast(severity == 'blocks'
                                ? 'Got it - marked as blocking. We\u2019ll email you as soon as it\u2019s fixed.'
                                : 'Thanks - logged. We\u2019ll email you when it\u2019s fixed.');
                          } catch (e) {
                            setD(() => busy = false);
                            _toast('Could not send that - try again.');
                          }
                        },
                  _Tick.medium),
              child: Text(busy ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send the report'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---- ideas board ----

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _ideasRef =>
      FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('featureRequests');

  Widget _acctIdeasRow() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _ideasRef
          .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
          .limit(200)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        final int shipped = docs
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                (d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'shipped')
            .length;
        final int open = docs.length - shipped;
        final String note = docs.isEmpty
            ? 'Tell us what would make Lazo better for your business. Vote on what others asked for.'
            : '$open idea${open == 1 ? '' : 's'} on the board${shipped > 0 ? ' \u00b7 $shipped shipped' : ''}. Add yours or vote.';
        return _acctLive(Icons.lightbulb_rounded, 'Ideas & feature requests',
            note, _ideasSheet,
            badge: shipped > 0 ? '$shipped shipped' : null);
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _ideasSheet() async {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    String tab = 'top';
    bool composing = false;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: double.infinity),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setS) {
          final Size scr = MediaQuery.of(ctx).size;
          final bool wideS = scr.width >= 900;
          return Padding(
            padding:
                EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Align(
              alignment: wideS ? Alignment.center : Alignment.bottomCenter,
              child: Container(
                constraints:
                    BoxConstraints(maxWidth: wideS ? 720 : double.infinity),
                height: scr.height * (wideS ? .84 : .92),
                margin: wideS ? const EdgeInsets.all(16) : EdgeInsets.zero,
                clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: ivory,
                  borderRadius: wideS
                      ? BorderRadius.circular(24)
                      : const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26)),
                  border:
                      wideS ? Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)) : null,
                ),
                child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 12, 8),
                    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Text('Ideas', style: _serif(size: 28)),
                              const Text(
                                  'What would make Lazo better for your business? Vote for what you\u2019d use.',
                                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold,
                            foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                            elevation: 0,
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12))),
                        onPressed: _h(() => setS(() => composing = !composing)),
                        icon: Icon(
                            composing ? Icons.close_rounded : Icons.add_rounded,
                            size: 17),
                        label: Text(composing ? 'Close' : 'Suggest',
                            style:
                                const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                          onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted)),
                    ]),
                  ),
                  if (composing)
                    _ideaComposer(u, () => setS(() => composing = false))
                  else
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 6),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        for (final List<String> t in const <List<String>>[
                          <String>['top', 'Most wanted'],
                          <String>['new', 'Newest'],
                          <String>['mine', 'Mine'],
                          <String>['shipped', 'Shipped'],
                        ])
                          Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                            child: _fbChip(t[1], tab == t[0],
                                () => setS(() => tab = t[0])),
                          ),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                      stream: _ideasRef
                          .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
                          .limit(200)
                          .snapshots(),
                      builder: (BuildContext c,
                          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                              s) {
                        List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                            (s.data?.docs ??
                                    <QueryDocumentSnapshot<
                                        Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                                .toList();
                        if (tab == 'shipped') {
                          docs = docs
                              .where(
                                  (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                          d) =>
                                      (d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'shipped')
                              .toList();
                        } else if (tab == 'mine') {
                          docs = docs
                              .where(
                                  (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                          d) =>
                                      d.data()['uid'] == u.uid)
                              .toList();
                        } else {
                          docs = docs
                              .where(
                                  (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                          d) =>
                                      (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'shipped' &&
                                      (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'declined')
                              .toList();
                          if (tab == 'top') {
                            docs.sort(
                                (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
                                        QueryDocumentSnapshot<
                                                Map<String, dynamic>>
                                            b) =>
                                    (((b.data()['votes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt())
                                        .compareTo(
                                            ((a.data()['votes'] ?? 0) as num)
                                                .toInt()));
                          }
                        }
                        if (docs.isEmpty) {
                          return Center(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
                              child: Column(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    const Icon(Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded,
                                        color: gold, size: 34),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                    Text(
                                        tab == 'mine'
                                            ? 'You haven\u2019t suggested anything yet.'
                                            : tab == 'shipped'
                                                ? 'Nothing shipped from the board yet - the first ones are coming.'
                                                : 'The board is empty. Yours would be the first.',
                                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: muted,
                                            fontSize: 13,
                                            height: 1.4)),
                                  ]),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                        return ListView.builder(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 24),
                          itemCount: docs.length,
                          itemBuilder: (BuildContext c2, int i) =>
                              _ideaCard(docs[i], u.uid),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _ideaComposer(User u, VoidCallback done) {
    final TextEditingController titleC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController detailC = TextEditingController();
    String area = '';
    bool busy = false;
    return StatefulBuilder(
      builder: (BuildContext c, StateSetter setC) => Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              TextField(
                controller: titleC,
                cursorColor: plum,
                autofocus: true,
                maxLength: 90,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: ink, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                decoration: _fbDeco('In one line, what would help?',
                    hint: 'Let me send a proposal from my phone'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: detailC,
                cursorColor: plum,
                minLines: 2,
                maxLines: 5,
                maxLength: 600,
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                decoration:
                    _fbDeco('Why? What do you do today instead? (optional)'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                for (final String a in kIdeaAreas)
                  _fbChip(a, area == a, () => setC(() => area = a)),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                        'Other vendors see it and can vote. Your name isn\u2019t shown.',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted))),
                FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: plum, foregroundColor: ivory),
                  onPressed: _h(busy
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          if (titleC.text.trim().length < 6) {
                            _toast('Give it a line first.');
                            return;
                          }
                          setC(() => busy = true);
                          try {
                            await _ideasRef.add(<String, dynamic>{
                              'title': titleC.text.trim(),
                              'detail': detailC.text.trim(),
                              'area': area,
                              'uid': u.uid,
                              'vendorId': _vendorIdCache,
                              'votes': 1,
                              'voters': <String>[u.uid],
                              'status': 'new',
                              'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                            });
                            _toast(
                                'On the board \u2713 We\u2019ll let you know if it ships.');
                            done();
                          } catch (e) {
                            setC(() => busy = false);
                            _toast('Could not post that - try again.');
                          }
                        }),
                  child: Text(busy ? 'Posting\u2026' : 'Post it'),
                ),
              ]),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _ideaCard(QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d, String uid) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
    final int votes = ((m['votes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
    final List<dynamic> voters =
        m['voters'] is List ? m['voters'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    final bool voted = voters.contains(uid);
    final String status = (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
    final String area = (m['area'] ?? '').toString();
    final String detail = (m['detail'] ?? '').toString();
    final String reply = (m['adminNote'] ?? '').toString();
    Color statusColor = muted;
    String statusLabel = '';
    if (status == 'planned') {
      statusColor = const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
      statusLabel = 'Planned';
    } else if (status == 'building') {
      statusColor = plum;
      statusLabel = 'Building';
    } else if (status == 'shipped') {
      statusColor = vGreen;
      statusLabel = 'Shipped';
    }
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
              color: status == 'shipped'
                  ? vGreen.withOpacity(.5)
                  : gold.withOpacity(.45))),
      child:
          Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
        _Press(
          tick: _Tick.select,
          onTap: status == 'shipped' ? null : () => _voteIdea(d, uid, !voted),
          child: Container(
            width: 52,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: voted ? plum : const Color(0xFFF1E9E0),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(color: voted ? plum : gold.withOpacity(.5)),
            ),
            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
              Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_up_rounded,
                  color: voted ? ivory : plum, size: 20),
              Text('$votes',
                  style:
                      _serif(size: 18, color: voted ? ivory : plum, height: 1)),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text((m['title'] ?? '').toString(),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: ink,
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                  if (statusLabel.isNotEmpty)
                    Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: statusColor.withOpacity(.12),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                          border:
                              Border.all(color: statusColor.withOpacity(.5))),
                      child: Text(statusLabel,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              color: statusColor,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                ]),
                if (detail.isNotEmpty)
                  Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 3),
                      child: Text(detail,
                          maxLines: 3,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12.5, color: ink, height: 1.35))),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                  child: Text(
                      <String>[
                        if (area.isNotEmpty) area,
                        if (m['uid'] == uid) 'Yours',
                        if (m['createdAt'] is Timestamp)
                          _shortDate((m['createdAt'] as Timestamp).toDate()),
                      ].join(' \u00b7 '),
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
                ),
                if (reply.isNotEmpty)
                  Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 8, 10, 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFFF1E9E0),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                    child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          const Icon(Icons.reply_rounded,
                              color: plum, size: 14),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Expanded(
                              child: Text('Lazo: $reply',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 12, color: ink, height: 1.35))),
                        ]),
                  ),
              ]),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _voteIdea(QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d,
      String uid, bool up) async {
    try {
      await d.reference.update(<String, dynamic>{
        'votes': FieldValue.increment(up ? 1 : -1),
        'voters': up
            ? FieldValue.arrayUnion(<String>[uid])
            : FieldValue.arrayRemove(<String>[uid]),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not vote - try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO vote: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openSupportSheet(
      {String initialCategory = 'Report a couple',
      String initialSubject = ''}) async {
    final u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    String cat = initialCategory;
    final TextEditingController subjC =
        TextEditingController(text: initialSubject);
    final TextEditingController msgC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    InputDecoration deco(String label) => InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          labelStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.65), fontSize: 13),
          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.25))),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum)),
          contentPadding:
              const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
        );
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Support',
              style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 420,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: cat,
                    items: const <DropdownMenuItem<String>>[
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'Report a couple',
                          child: Text('Report a couple')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'Report a bug', child: Text('Report a bug')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'Billing question',
                          child: Text('Billing question')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'Verification', child: Text('Verification')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: 'Something else',
                          child: Text('Something else')),
                    ],
                    onChanged: (v) => setD(() => cat = v ?? cat),
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                    dropdownColor: Colors.white,
                    decoration: deco('What is this about?'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: subjC,
                    cursorColor: plum,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: deco('Subject'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: msgC,
                    cursorColor: plum,
                    maxLines: 5,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: deco('Tell us what happened'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: ink))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: plum, foregroundColor: ivory),
              onPressed: _h(busy
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      if (subjC.text.trim().isEmpty ||
                          msgC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                        _toast('Add a subject and a message first.');
                        return;
                      }
                      setD(() => busy = true);
                      try {
                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                            .collection('supportTickets')
                            .add(<String, dynamic>{
                          'role': 'vendor',
                          'uid': u.uid,
                          'email': u.email ?? '',
                          'category': cat,
                          'subject': subjC.text.trim(),
                          'message': msgC.text.trim(),
                          'vendorName': '',
                          'status': 'open',
                          'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                          'context': <String, dynamic>{
                            'source': 'vendor_dashboard',
                            'build': kBuildId,
                            'vendorId': _vendorIdCache,
                          },
                        });
                        if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        _toast(
                            'Ticket sent \u2713 We\u2019ll get back to you by email.');
                      } catch (_) {
                        setD(() => busy = false);
                        _toast('Could not send the ticket. Try again.');
                      }
                    }),
              child: Text(busy ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _acctSoon(IconData icon, String title, String note) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFF1E9E0),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          Icon(icon, color: plum, size: 20),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text(title,

  // v110: live, tier-aware Lazo Pro + Billing rows on the account page.
  Widget _acctProRows(String vendorId) {
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
      return Column(children: <Widget>[
        _acctSoon(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded, 'Lazo Pro',
            'More markets, unlimited gallery, analytics - tools that grow the business.'),
        _acctSoon(Icons.credit_card_rounded, 'Billing',
            'Payment methods and receipts - nothing to bill yet. Free stays free.'),
      ]);
    }
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _vendorDocStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> vs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> vd = vs.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final String tier = (vd['tier'] ?? '') as String;
        final bool paid = tier == 'pro' || tier == 'studio';
        String until = '';
        final dynamic exp = vd['tierExpiresAt'];
        if (exp is Timestamp) {
          final DateTime e = exp.toDate();
          until = '${e.month}/${e.day}/${e.year}';
        }
        final String proTitle = tier == 'studio'
            ? 'Lazo Pro Studio'
            : tier == 'pro'
                ? 'Lazo Pro'
                : 'Lazo Pro';
        final String proNote = paid
            ? (until.isEmpty
                ? 'Active \u2713 Manage your plan'
                : 'Active \u2713 renews or runs through $until')
            : 'More markets, contracts, invoicing, June AI \u2014 see founding plans.';
        final String billNote = paid
            ? 'Card on file, receipts, and cancellation.'
            : 'Nothing to bill yet \u2014 free stays free. Upgrading adds a card.';
        return Column(children: <Widget>[
          _acctLive(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded, proTitle, proNote, () {
            if (paid) {
              _manageProSheet(vendorId);
            } else {
              _upgradeSheet(vendorId);
            }
          }, badge: paid ? 'ACTIVE' : null),
          _acctLive(Icons.credit_card_rounded, 'Billing', billNote, () {
            if (paid) {
              _manageProSheet(vendorId);
            } else {
              _upgradeSheet(vendorId);
            }
          }),
        ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // v179: deletion runs server-side (functions-dashboard/deleteAccount.js,
  // deleteMyVendorAccount): the claim is released so the public listing goes
  // back to unclaimed, everything the owner added is removed along with their
  // uploads, templates and login, and the login is deleted LAST so a partial
  // failure is retryable rather than permanent.
  Future<void> _deleteVendorAccount() async {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    final bool? sure = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Text('Delete account?',
            style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        content: const Text(
          'This permanently deletes your login, your uploads, templates and everything you added to your profile, and releases your claim on the listing. Any active plan is cancelled. This can\u2019t be undone.',
          style: TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14, height: 1.4),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child:
                  const Text('Keep my account', style: TextStyle(color: ink))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFB3413A),
                foregroundColor: ivory),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
            child: const Text('Delete forever'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (sure != true) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable('deleteMyVendorAccount',
              options:
                  HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 300)))
          .call(<String, dynamic>{});
      try {
        await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
      } catch (_) {}
      if (!mounted) return;
      context.goNamed('Welcome');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not delete the account. Try again.');
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not delete the account. Try again.');
    }
  }

  String? _publicUrlFor(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final String metroId = v['metroId'] == null ? '' : v['metroId'].toString();
    final List<dynamic> cats = v['categories'] is List
        ? v['categories'] as List<dynamic>
        : <dynamic>[];
    final String name = v['name'] == null ? '' : v['name'].toString();
    if (metroId.isEmpty || cats.isEmpty || name.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    String slug = name
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]+'), '-')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'^-+|-+$'), '');
    if (slug.length > 80) {
      slug = slug.substring(0, 80);
    }
    if (slug.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    return 'https://meetlazo.com/$metroId/${cats.first}/$slug/';
  }

  Widget _insightsCard(String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            snap.hasData && snap.data != null
                ? snap.data!.docs
                : <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final List<int> weekly = List<int>.filled(8, 0);
        int booked = 0;
        int responded = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> q = d.data();
          final String st =
              q['status'] == null ? 'new' : q['status'].toString();
          if (st == 'booked') {
            booked = booked + 1;
          }
          if (st.isNotEmpty && st != 'new') {
            responded = responded + 1;
          }
          final dynamic ts = q['createdAt'];
          if (ts is Timestamp) {
            final int weeksAgo =
                (now.difference(ts.toDate()).inDays / 7).floor();
            if (weeksAgo >= 0 && weeksAgo < 8) {
              weekly[7 - weeksAgo] = weekly[7 - weeksAgo] + 1;
            }
          }
        }
        final int total = docs.length;
        final int maxV = weekly.fold(1, (int a, int b) => b > a ? b : a);
        final String rate =
            total == 0 ? '\u2014' : '${((responded / total) * 100).round()}%';
        final String winRate =
            total == 0 ? '\u2014' : '${((booked / total) * 100).round()}%';

        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          radius: 24,
          tint: .6,
          borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text('Inquiry activity', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                  ),
                  const Text('Last 8 weeks',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _foldBtn('activity'),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text(winRate,
                      style: _serif(
                          size: 36,
                          color: booked > 0 ? vGreen : muted,
                          height: 1)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: const <Widget>[
                          Text('WIN RATE',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  letterSpacing: 1.6,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                          Text('Inquiries you turned into bookings',
                              style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 10.5)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('lazo-insights-bars'),
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: _chartPlayed ? 1 : 0, end: 1),
                duration: Duration(milliseconds: _chartPlayed ? 1 : 1100),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                onEnd: () {
                  _chartPlayed = true;
                },
                builder: (BuildContext context, double t, Widget? _) {
                  return SizedBox(
                    height: 96,
                    child: Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                      children: List<Widget>.generate(8, (int i) {
                        final double frac = weekly[i] / maxV;
                        final double stagger = ((t * 8) - i).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        final double h = (frac * stagger * 74) + 6;
                        final bool isCurrent = i == 7;
                        return Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              if (weekly[i] > 0 && stagger > .9)
                                Text('${weekly[i]}',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 10,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        color: isCurrent ? plum : muted)),
                              const SizedBox(height: 3),
                              Container(
                                height: h,
                                margin:
                                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                                    begin: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                    end: Alignment.topCenter,
                                    colors: isCurrent
                                        ? <Color>[plumDeep, plum]
                                        : <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.55), gold],
                                  ),
                                  borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                                      top: Radius.circular(6)),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        );
                      }),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Row(
                children: const <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text('8 wks ago',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: muted))),
                  Text('This week',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: muted)),
                ],
              ),
              if (total == 0)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                  child: Text(
                      'Your first inquiry starts the graph. Complete your profile and the couples will come.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: muted,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Row(
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                      Text('$total',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 19,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      const Text('INQUIRIES',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: muted,
                              fontSize: 9,
                              letterSpacing: 1.4,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ]),
                  ),
                  Container(width: 1, height: 30, color: gold.withOpacity(.4)),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                      Text(rate,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 19,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      const Text('RESPONSE RATE',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: muted,

                  ),
                  Container(width: 1, height: 30, color: gold.withOpacity(.4)),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                      Text('$booked',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: vGreen,
                              fontSize: 19,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      const Text('BOOKED',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: muted,
