  // ---------------- v111: NEW BOOKING CELEBRATION ----------------

  void _ensureBookingWatch(String vendorId) {
    if (_bookingSubFor == vendorId) {
      return;
    }
    _bookingSubFor = vendorId;
    _bookingArmed = false;
    _bookingSub?.cancel();
    _bookingSub = _leadsStream(vendorId)
        .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      // v130: celebrate an EVENT, not a tally. Confetti belongs to a thread
      // that actually flips to booked while we are watching - never to a
      // re-read, a re-render, or a counter that drifted out of sync.
      if (!_bookingArmed) {
        _bookingArmed = true;
        return;
      }
      for (final DocumentChange<Map<String, dynamic>> ch in snap.docChanges) {
        if (ch.type == DocumentChangeType.removed) {
          continue;
        }
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = ch.doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        if ((m['status'] ?? '').toString() != 'booked') {
          continue;
        }
        final dynamic at = m['bookedAt'];
        if (at is! Timestamp) {
          continue;
        }
        if (DateTime.now().difference(at.toDate()).inSeconds > 20) {
          continue;
        }
        if (_celebratedIds.contains(ch.doc.id)) {
          continue;
        }
        _celebratedIds.add(ch.doc.id);
        if (mounted) {
          _fireBookingCelebration();
        }
        break;
      }
    });
  }

  void _fireBookingCelebration() {
    if (_confettiShowing || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    // v175: reduced motion keeps the banner, skips the confetti.
    final bool confetti = !_reducedMotion(context);
    setState(() {
      _confettiShowing = confetti;
      _bookingBannerUp = true;
    });
    if (confetti) {
      _confettiC?.dispose();
      _confettiC = AnimationController(
          vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 3600));
      _confettiC!.addListener(() {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {});
        }
      });
      _confettiC!.addStatusListener((AnimationStatus st) {
        if (st == AnimationStatus.completed && mounted) {
          setState(() => _confettiShowing = false);
        }
      });
      _confettiC!.forward();
    }
    _bookingBannerT?.cancel();
    _bookingBannerT = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 7), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _bookingBannerUp = false);
      }
    });
  }

  Widget _bookingBannerOverlay() {
    return Positioned(
      top: 54,
      left: 18,
      right: 18,
      child: IgnorePointer(
        ignoring: !_bookingBannerUp,
        // v175: overshoot on arrival only; ease in on the way out.
        child: AnimatedSlide(
          duration: Duration(milliseconds: _bookingBannerUp ? 480 : 300),
          curve: _bookingBannerUp ? Curves.easeOutBack : Curves.easeInCubic,
          offset: (_bookingBannerUp || _reducedMotion(context))
              ? Offset.zero
              : const Offset(0, -0.6),
          child: AnimatedOpacity(
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: _bookingBannerUp ? 220 : 300),
            curve: _bookingBannerUp ? Curves.easeOut : Curves.easeIn,
            opacity: _bookingBannerUp ? 1 : 0,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 14),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(color: gold, width: 1.2),
                boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: gold.withOpacity(.35),
                      blurRadius: 22,
                      spreadRadius: 1),
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.35),
                      blurRadius: 30,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                ],
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Text('\u{1F389}', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 26)),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(

                      Text('Congrats on the new booking!',

                      Text('A couple just chose you. Their thread is waiting.',

                    ],

  Future<void> _celebrateChecklist(String vendorId) async {
    if (_confettiShowing || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final bool confetti = !_reducedMotion(context);
    setState(() => _confettiShowing = confetti);
    // Persist the one-shot flag first so rebuilds don't refire
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vendorId).set(
          <String, dynamic>{'strengthCelebrated': true},
          SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {}
    _toast('Profile complete! Couples see your best self now. \u{1F389}');
    if (!confetti || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    _confettiC?.dispose();
    _confettiC = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 3600));
    _confettiC!.addListener(() {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {});
      }
    });
    _confettiC!.addStatusListener((AnimationStatus st) {
      if (st == AnimationStatus.completed && mounted) {
        setState(() => _confettiShowing = false);
      }
    });
    _confettiC!.forward();
  }

  Widget _confettiOverlay() {
    if (!_confettiShowing || _confettiC == null) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: IgnorePointer(
        child: CustomPaint(
          painter: _ConfettiPainter(progress: _confettiC!.value),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static const List<List<String>> kCoupleShares = <List<String>>[
    <String>['seating_chart', 'Seating chart', 'table_restaurant'],
    <String>['day_of_timeline', 'Day-of timeline', 'schedule'],
    <String>['music', 'Music plan', 'music_note'],

  IconData _shareIcon(String key) {
    switch (key) {

        return Icons.table_restaurant_rounded;
      case 'schedule':

  Widget _fromCoupleStrip(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> mdocs) {
    final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> latest =
        <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in mdocs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      if (m['senderRole'] != 'couple' || m['attachment'] is! Map) continue;
      final Map<String, dynamic> a =
          Map<String, dynamic>.from(m['attachment'] as Map);
      if ((a['type'] ?? '') != 'text/html') continue;
      final String n = (a['name'] ?? '')
          .toString()
          .toLowerCase()
          .replaceAll('.html', '')
          .replaceAll('-', '_')
          .replaceAll(' ', '_')
          .replaceAll('&', '')
          .replaceAll('__', '_');
      String key = '';
      for (final List<String> k in kCoupleShares) {
        if (n.contains(k[0])) {
          key = k[0];
          break;
        }
      }
      if (key.isEmpty) continue;
      latest[key] = <String, dynamic>{
        'url': (a['url'] ?? '').toString(),
        'at': m['at'],
        'label': kCoupleShares.firstWhere((List<String> k) => k[0] == key)[1],
        'icon': kCoupleShares.firstWhere((List<String> k) => k[0] == key)[2],
      };
    }
    if (latest.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final List<MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>>> items = latest.entries
        .toList()
      ..sort((MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> a,
          MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
        final int ia =
            kCoupleShares.indexWhere((List<String> k) => k[0] == a.key);
        final int ib =
            kCoupleShares.indexWhere((List<String> k) => k[0] == b.key);
        return ia.compareTo(ib);
      });
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 8, 14, 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: gold.withOpacity(.12),
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.35))),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        const Text('FROM THE COUPLE',
            style: TextStyle(
                color: plum,
                fontSize: 9.5,
                letterSpacing: 1.8,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: 30,
            child: ListView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> e in items)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                    child: _Press(
                      onTap: () => _openUrl(e.value['url'].toString()),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Icon(_shareIcon(e.value['icon'].toString()),
                                  color: plum, size: 14),
                              const SizedBox(width: 5),
                              Text(e.value['label'].toString(),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              if (e.value['at'] is Timestamp) ...<Widget>[
                                const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                Text(
                                    _shortDate(
                                        (e.value['at'] as Timestamp).toDate()),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
                              ],
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  String _delta(num d) {
    if (d > 0) {
      return '+${d.round()}';
    }
    if (d < 0) {
      return '${d.round()}';
    }
    return '';
  }

  Widget _twoUp(List<Widget> tiles) {
    final List<Widget> rows = <Widget>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 2) {
      rows.add(IntrinsicHeight(
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
                child: i + 1 < tiles.length
                    ? tiles[i + 1]
                    : const SizedBox.shrink()),
          ],
        ),
      ));
      if (i + 2 < tiles.length) {
        rows.add(const SizedBox(height: 10));
      }
    }
    return Column(children: rows);
  }

  // The hero is the day: name in the serif, the claim state with a way
  // forward, and the numbers that change - waiting, reply, next wedding, and
  // views once the site beacon writes them. A zero never leads.
  Widget _heroToday(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd, bool wide) {
    final String name = (vd['name'] ?? 'Your business').toString();
    final bool verified = vd['verified'] == true;
    final String cover = (vd['coverUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final double focusY = vd['coverFocusY'] is num
        ? (vd['coverFocusY'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 100).toDouble()
        : 50;
    final Map<String, dynamic> views = vd['views'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(vd['views'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final bool hasViews = views['d7'] is num;
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            _leadDocs(s);
        int unread = 0;
        String oldestName = '';
        String oldestAgo = '';
        Timestamp? oldestTs;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if (!_isUnread(m)) {
            continue;
          }
          unread = unread + 1;
          final dynamic ts = m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['createdAt'];
          if (ts is! Timestamp) {
            continue;
          }
          final Timestamp? cur = oldestTs;
          if (cur == null || ts.compareTo(cur) < 0) {
            oldestTs = ts;
            final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
            oldestName = nm.isEmpty ? 'A verified couple' : nm;
            final String raw = _ago(ts);
            oldestAgo = raw == 'now'
                ? 'just now'
                : (raw.contains(' ') ? raw : '$raw ago');
          }
        }
        final Map<String, num> rs = _replyStats(docs);
        final int replied = (rs['replied'] ?? 0).toInt();
        final int avgMin = (rs['avgMin'] ?? 0).toInt();
        final double rate = (rs['rate'] ?? 0).toDouble();
        String nextName = '';
        String nextWhen = '';
        int nextDays = -1;
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final DateTime t0 = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
              (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
          if (!booked) {
            continue;
          }
          final DateTime? wd = _weddingDateRaw(m);
          if (wd == null) {
            continue;
          }
          final int days =
              DateTime(wd.year, wd.month, wd.day).difference(t0).inDays;
          if (days < 0) {
            continue;
          }
          if (nextDays < 0 || days < nextDays) {
            nextDays = days;
            final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
            nextName = nm.isEmpty ? 'A couple' : nm;
            nextWhen = _shortDate(wd);
          }
        }
        final List<Widget> tiles = <Widget>[
          _heroTile('Waiting on you', '$unread', unread == 0 ? '' : 'new',
              unread == 0 ? 'All caught up' : '$oldestName, $oldestAgo'),
          _heroTile(
              'Average reply',
              _avgLabel(avgMin, replied),
              '',
              replied == 0
                  ? 'Timed from your first reply'
                  : '${(rate * 100).round()}% of inquiries answered'),
          _heroTile(
              'Next wedding',
              nextDays < 0 ? '\u2014' : '$nextDays',
              nextDays < 0 ? '' : (nextDays == 1 ? 'day' : 'days'),
              nextDays < 0
                  ? 'Mark a couple booked in their thread'
                  : (nextDays == 0
                      ? '$nextName, today'
                      : '$nextName, $nextWhen')),
          if (hasViews)
            _heroTile(
                'Profile views, 7 days',
                '${(views['d7'] as num).round()}',
                views['d7Prev'] is num
                    ? _delta((views['d7'] as num) - (views['d7Prev'] as num))
                    : '',
                views['saves'] is num
                    ? '${(views['saves'] as num).round()} couples saved you'
                    : 'From your public page'),
        ];
        final Widget nameBlock = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(name,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: _serif(
                    size: wide ? 34 : 28,
                    weight: FontWeight.w500,
                    color: ivory)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 10,
              runSpacing: 6,
              crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
              children: <Widget>[
                _heroPill(verified ? 'Lazo verified' : 'Claimed', verified),
                for (final String b in _badgeKeys(vd))
                  _heroPill(_badgeLabel(b), false),
                if (!verified) _verifyState(vendorId, vd),
                if (verified)
                  Text(
                      'Verified reviews drive your ranking - and only verified reviews.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13, color: ivory.withOpacity(.85))),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        );
        final Widget grid = wide
            ? IntrinsicHeight(
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                      if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      SizedBox(width: 158, child: tiles[i]),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              )
            : _twoUp(tiles);
        return Container(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: wide ? 176 : 0),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: gold),
          ),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          child: Stack(
            children: <Widget>[
              Positioned.fill(
                child: cover.isEmpty
                    ? Container(
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          gradient: LinearGradient(
                              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                              colors: <Color>[
                                Color(0xFF6A3A66),
                                plum,
                                plumDeep
                              ]),
                        ),
                      )
                    : Image(
                        image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(cover), width: 1400),
                        fit: BoxFit.cover,
                        alignment: Alignment(0, (focusY / 50) - 1),
                        errorBuilder:
                            (BuildContext c2, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                                Container(color: plumDeep),
                      ),
              ),
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Container(
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                      colors: <Color>[
                        Color(0x333D1C3B),
                        Color(0xC63D1C3B),
                        Color(0xF23D1C3B)
                      ],
                      stops: <double>[0, .55, 1],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(wide ? 28 : 20, wide ? 30 : 22,
                    wide ? 28 : 20, wide ? 26 : 20),
                child: wide
                    ? Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(child: nameBlock),
                          const SizedBox(width: 20),
                          grid,
                        ],
                      )
                    : Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          nameBlock,
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          grid,
                        ],
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // v150: the verification path is the ownership form itself - the same
  // proof-of-ownership dialog a new claim uses, filed against this vendor.
  // While a request is open the hero says so instead of offering the button.
  Widget _verifyState(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final TextStyle line =
        TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: ivory.withOpacity(.88));
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'claims:$_uid',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('claimRequests')
              .where('uid', isEqualTo: _uid)),
      initialData: _liveQ['claims:$_uid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        String st = '';
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
            in s.data?.docs ??
                <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if ((m['vendorId'] ?? '').toString() != vendorId) {
            continue;
          }
          final String x = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
          if (x == 'pending' || x == 'needs_review') {
            st = 'review';
            break;
          }
          if (x == 'denied') {
            st = 'denied';
          }
        }
        if (st == 'review') {
          return Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            const Icon(Icons.hourglass_top_rounded, color: gold, size: 14),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text('Verification in review - usually within a day', style: line),
          ]);
        }
        return Wrap(
          spacing: 10,
          runSpacing: 6,
          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
                st == 'denied'
                    ? 'Verification needs another look'
                    : 'Verification pending',
                style: line),
            _Press(
              onTap: () => _submitClaim(vd),
              child: Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: gold, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                child: Text(
                    st == 'denied' ? 'Try again' : 'Finish verification',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plumDeep,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ---------------- MAIN COLUMN ----------------

  // Booked couples in date order, with the countdown and where the paperwork
  // stands. Deliveries and review requests start from here.
  // Each step is a tool that already exists; the card just knows which one
  // is next. [label, done, action]
  List<List<dynamic>> _weddingSteps(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    final String cs = (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    final String qs = (inq['questionnaireStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    final String isx = (inq['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    void openThread() {
      setState(() {
        _setInboxThread(inquiryId);
        _showInbox = true;
      });
    }

    final List<List<dynamic>> steps = <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>[
        'Contract signed',
        cs == 'signed',
        cs == 'sent' ? openThread : () => _startContractFlow(inquiryId, inq),
        cs == 'sent'
            ? 'Contract is out - waiting on their signature'
            : 'Send the contract',
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Questionnaire back',
        qs == 'completed',
        qs == 'sent'
            ? openThread
            : () => _sendQuestionnaireSheet(inquiryId, inq),
        qs == 'sent'
            ? 'Questionnaire is out - waiting on them'
            : 'Send the questionnaire',
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Balance paid',
        isx == 'paid',
        (isx == 'sent' || isx == 'due')
            ? openThread
            : () => _invoiceComposeSheet(inquiryId, inq),
        (isx == 'sent' || isx == 'due')
            ? 'Invoice is out - waiting on payment'
            : 'Send the invoice',
      ],
    ];
    if (_delivers()) {
      final bool teaserOnly = _isVideo() && !_isPhoto();
      steps.add(<dynamic>[
        teaserOnly ? 'Teaser sent' : 'Sneak peek sent',
        inq['sneakPeekSentAt'] != null || inq['teaserSentAt'] != null,
        teaserOnly
            ? () => _teaserSheet(inquiryId, inq)
            : () => _sneakPeekSheet(inquiryId, inq),
        teaserOnly ? 'Send the teaser film' : 'Send a sneak peek',
      ]);
      steps.add(<dynamic>[
        teaserOnly ? 'Film delivered' : 'Gallery delivered',
        inq['deliveredAt'] != null,
        () => _markDelivered(inquiryId),
        teaserOnly ? 'Mark the film delivered' : 'Mark the gallery delivered',
      ]);
    }
    return steps;
  }

  // Booked couples in date order, with the countdown and where the paperwork
  // stands. Every step is one tap away.
  Widget _upcomingCard(String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            _leadDocs(s);
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final DateTime t0 = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
        final List<List<dynamic>> rows = <List<dynamic>>[];
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
              (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
          if (!booked) {
            continue;
          }
          final DateTime? wd = _weddingDateRaw(m);
          if (wd == null) {
            continue;
          }
          final int days =
              DateTime(wd.year, wd.month, wd.day).difference(t0).inDays;
          if (days < -30) {
            continue;
          }
          rows.add(<dynamic>[days, wd, d]);
        }
        rows.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
            (a[0] as int).compareTo(b[0] as int));
        final List<List<dynamic>> show = rows.take(5).toList();
        const List<String> mo = <String>[
          'JAN',
          'FEB',
          'MAR',
          'APR',
          'MAY',
          'JUN',
          'JUL',
          'AUG',
          'SEP',
          'OCT',
          'NOV',
          'DEC'
        ];
        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 14),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                    child: Text('Upcoming weddings', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                _foldBtn('upcoming'),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              const Text(
                  'Booked couples, in order. Contract, questionnaire, balance, delivery - the next step is one tap.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              if (show.isEmpty)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  child: Text(
                      'Mark a couple booked in their thread and their wedding lands here, with the countdown and every step to the day.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
                ),
              for (int i = 0; i < show.length; i++)
                Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                  final int days = show[i][0] as int;
                  final DateTime wd = show[i][1] as DateTime;
                  final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d =
                      show[i][2] as QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>;
                  final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
                  final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                      ? 'A couple'
                      : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
                  final List<List<dynamic>> steps = _weddingSteps(d.id, m);
                  final int done =
                      steps.where((List<dynamic> st) => st[1] == true).length;
                  List<dynamic>? next;
                  for (final List<dynamic> st in steps) {
                    if (st[1] != true) {
                      next = st;
                      break;
                    }
                  }
                  return Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        border: Border(
                            top: BorderSide(
                                color: i == 0
                                    ? Colors.transparent
                                    : const Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
                    child: Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        InkWell(
                          onTap: () {
                            setState(() {
                              _setInboxThread(d.id);
                              _showInbox = true;
                            });
                          },
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          child: Container(
                            width: 62,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: ivory,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(color: goldLine),
                            ),
                            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                              Text('${wd.day}',
                                  style: _serif(size: 22, height: 1)),
                              Text(mo[wd.month - 1],
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                      color: muted,
                                      letterSpacing: .6,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 14),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Row(children: <Widget>[
                                Expanded(
                                  child: InkWell(
                                    onTap: () {
                                      setState(() {
                                        _setInboxThread(d.id);
                                        _showInbox = true;
                                      });
                                    },
                                    child: Text(nm,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: ink,
                                            fontSize: 14.5,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Text('$done of ${steps.length}',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        color: done == steps.length
                                            ? vGreen
                                            : muted,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              ]),
                              const SizedBox(height: 5),
                              Wrap(
                                  spacing: 6,
                                  runSpacing: 4,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    for (final List<dynamic> st in steps)
                                      _inboxPill(st[0] as String,
                                          st[1] == true ? vGreen : muted),
                                  ]),
                              if (next != null)
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                  child: InkWell(
                                    onTap: next[2] as VoidCallback,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    child: Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          vertical: 3),
                                      child: Row(
                                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                          children: <Widget>[
                                            const Icon(
                                                Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                                                size: 14,
                                                color: plum),
                                            const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                            Flexible(
                                              child: Text(next[3] as String,
                                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                                      color: plum,
                                                      fontSize: 12.5,
                                                      fontWeight:
                                                          FontWeight.w800)),
                                            ),
                                          ]),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            Text(
                                days < 0
                                    ? '${-days}'
                                    : (days == 0 ? 'Today' : '$days'),
                                style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
                            if (days != 0)
                              Text(
                                  days < 0
                                      ? (days == -1 ? 'day ago' : 'days ago')
                                      : (days == 1 ? 'day' : 'days'),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                }),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // Under five inquiries there is no shape to chart - say what happened in a
  // sentence. The chart and win rate come back at five.
  Widget _activityCard(String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            _leadDocs(s);
        if (docs.length >= 5) {
          return _insightsCard(vendorId);
        }
        final Map<String, num> rs = _replyStats(docs);
        final int total = docs.length;
        final int replied = (rs['replied'] ?? 0).toInt();
        final int avgMin = (rs['avgMin'] ?? 0).toInt();
        String line;
        if (total == 0) {
          line =
              'Your first inquiry starts the activity chart. Complete your profile and the couples will come.';
        } else {
          line =
              '$total ${total == 1 ? 'inquiry' : 'inquiries'} so far, $replied answered${replied > 0 ? ', average reply ${_avgLabel(avgMin, replied)}' : ''}. The trend chart and win rate appear after your fifth inquiry.';
        }
        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 16, 22, 16),
          child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: Text.rich(
                    TextSpan(children: <InlineSpan>[
                      const TextSpan(
                          text: 'Inquiry activity',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      TextSpan(text: '  \u00b7  $line'),
                    ]),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14, color: muted, height: 1.5),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                _foldBtn('activity'),
              ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _responseSpeedCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String metroId = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    final String catId =
        vd['categories'] is List && (vd['categories'] as List).isNotEmpty
            ? (vd['categories'] as List).first.toString()
            : '';
    final String msKey = '${metroId}__$catId';
    final String bucket = metroId.isEmpty || catId.isEmpty
        ? ''
        : '${_metroLabel(metroId)} ${_catLabelFor(catId).toLowerCase()}s';
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc('ms:$msKey',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('metroStats').doc(msKey)),
      initialData: _liveD['ms:$msKey']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c0,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> mss) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> ms = mss.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
          initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
          builder: (BuildContext c,
              AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
            final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                _leadDocs(s);
            final Map<String, num> rs = _replyStats(docs);
            final int replied = (rs['replied'] ?? 0).toInt();
            final int avgMin = (rs['avgMin'] ?? 0).toInt();
            final double rate = (rs['rate'] ?? 0).toDouble();
            // Same bar The Knot sets for its badge: 80% answered within a day.
            final bool quick = replied > 0 && rate >= .8 && avgMin <= 24 * 60;
            _quickResponderCached = quick;
            final int pctRate = (rate * 100).round();
            final bool hasBench =
                ms['medianReplyMin'] is num && bucket.isNotEmpty;
            final int benchMin =
                hasBench ? (ms['medianReplyMin'] as num).round() : 0;
            return _glass(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    const Expanded(
                        child: Text('Response speed',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted))),
                    if (quick)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: gold,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                        child: const Text('Quick responder',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: plumDeep,
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                      textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(_avgLabel(avgMin, replied),
                            style: _serif(size: 32, height: 1)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                            replied == 0
                                ? 'no replies timed yet'
                                : 'average reply',
                            style:
                                const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
                      ]),
                  if (hasBench) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                        '$bucket average ${_avgLabel(benchMin, 1)}${replied > 0 && avgMin < benchMin ? ' - you are faster' : ''}',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                      quick
                          ? 'Earned: under a day on average, $pctRate% answered. Keep it.'
                          : replied == 0
                              ? 'Reply to 80% of inquiries within a day and you earn the Quick responder badge.'
                              : '$pctRate% answered. Reply to 80% within a day to earn the Quick responder badge.',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
                ],
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v151: badges, signals, merges ----------------

  List<String> _badgeKeys(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    if (vd['badges'] is! List) {
      return <String>[];
    }
    return (vd['badges'] as List)
        .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
        .where((String b) => b != 'verified' && b != 'offer')
        .toList();
  }

  String _badgeLabel(String key) {
    switch (key) {
      case 'quick_responder':
        return 'Quick responder';
      case 'recently_updated':
        return 'Recently updated';
      case 'popular':
        return 'Popular this week';
      case 'verified':
        return 'Lazo verified';
      case 'offer':
        return 'Offer';
    }
    return key.replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }

  String _weddingIso(Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    final DateTime? d = _weddingDateRaw(inq);
    if (d == null) {
      return '';
    }
    return '${d.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  List<num> _numbersIn(dynamic v) {
    final List<num> out = <num>[];
    for (final RegExpMatch m
        in RegExp(r'\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?').allMatches((v ?? '').toString())) {
      final num? n = num.tryParse(m.group(0)!.replaceAll(',', ''));
      if (n != null) {
        out.add(n);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  // "$3,000-$5,000" against "Packages from $1,200": the top of what they said
  // covers the bottom of what you charge.
  bool _budgetFits(dynamic budget, dynamic startingPrice) {
    final List<num> b = _numbersIn(budget);
    final List<num> p = _numbersIn(startingPrice);
    if (b.isEmpty || p.isEmpty) {
      return false;
    }
    num bMax = b.first;
    for (final num x in b) {
      if (x > bMax) bMax = x;
    }
    num pMin = p.first;
    for (final num x in p) {
      if (x < pMin) pMin = x;
    }
    return bMax >= pMin;
  }

  String _mergeReply(
      String text, Map<String, dynamic> inq, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> intent = inq['structuredIntent'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(inq['structuredIntent'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final String couple = (inq['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final String date = _weddingDateOf(inq);
    final String venue =
        (intent['venue'] ?? intent['venueName'] ?? '').toString();
    return text
        .replaceAll('{couple}', couple.isEmpty ? 'there' : couple)
        .replaceAll('{date}', date.isEmpty ? 'your date' : date)
        .replaceAll('{venue}', venue.isEmpty ? 'your venue' : venue)
        .replaceAll('{vendor}', (vd['name'] ?? '').toString());
  }

  String _randomCode(int n) {
    const String alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final math.Random r = math.Random.secure();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      b.write(alphabet[r.nextInt(alphabet.length)]);
    }
    return b.toString();
  }

  // ---------------- v151: money on the front page ----------------

  Widget _moneyMini(String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _invoicesAllStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _liveQ['invoices:$vendorId']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (snap.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    d.data()['demo'] != true)
                .toList();
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final DateTime monthStart = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
        final DateTime soon = now.add(const Duration(days: 14));
        num month = 0;
        num outstanding = 0;
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> due =
            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final String st = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
          if (st == 'void') {
            continue;
          }
          final num total = m['total'] is num ? m['total'] as num : 0;
          if (st == 'paid') {
            final dynamic pa = m['paidAt'];
            if (pa is Timestamp && !pa.toDate().isBefore(monthStart)) {
              month = month + total;
            }
          } else {
            outstanding = outstanding + total;
            final dynamic dd = m['dueDate'];
            if (dd is Timestamp && dd.toDate().isBefore(soon)) {
              due.add(d);
            }
          }
        }
        due.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
            QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
          final dynamic ta = a.data()['dueDate'];
          final dynamic tb = b.data()['dueDate'];
          if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) return ta.compareTo(tb);
          return 0;
        });
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Text('Money',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                    textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(_pMoney(month), style: _serif(size: 32, height: 1)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Text('collected this month',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
                    ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                    outstanding > 0
                        ? '${_pMoney(outstanding)} outstanding'
                        : 'Nothing outstanding',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        color:
                            outstanding > 0 ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : vGreen,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                if (due.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  const Text('Due within two weeks',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                  for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                      in due.take(3))
                    Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
                      final DateTime dt = (m['dueDate'] as Timestamp).toDate();
                      final bool late = dt.isBefore(now);
                      final String inquiryId =
                          d.reference.parent.parent?.id ?? '';
                      return Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            border: Border(
                                top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
                        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Text(
                                      '${(m['title'] ?? 'Invoice').toString()} \u00b7 ${_pMoney(m['total'] is num ? m['total'] as num : 0)}',
                                      maxLines: 1,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 13,
                                          color: ink,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                  Text(
                                      late
                                          ? 'Was due ${_shortDate(dt)}'
                                          : 'Due ${_shortDate(dt)}',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 12,
                                          color: late
                                              ? const Color(0xFFB04343)
                                              : muted)),
                                ]),
                          ),
                          if (inquiryId.isNotEmpty)
                            TextButton(
                              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                  padding:
                                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                                  minimumSize: const Size(0, 30)),
                              onPressed: _h(() =>
                                  _sendInvoiceReminder(inquiryId, m, late)),
                              child: const Text('Remind',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 12.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                        ]),
                      );
                    }),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _sendInvoiceReminder(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inv, bool late) async {
    final String title = (inv['title'] ?? 'your invoice').toString();
    final String amt = _pMoney(inv['total'] is num ? inv['total'] as num : 0);
    final DateTime? dt = inv['dueDate'] is Timestamp
        ? (inv['dueDate'] as Timestamp).toDate()
        : null;
    final String when =
        dt == null ? '' : ' ${late ? 'was due' : 'is due'} ${_shortDate(dt)}';
    try {
      await _sendVendorMessage(
          inquiryId,
          'Friendly reminder: "$title" ($amt)$when. The invoice is right here in this thread whenever you\u2019re ready - thank you!',
          'responded');
      _toast('Reminder sent \u2713');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  // Couples who went quiet after you replied. Silence loses more bookings
  // than price does; one tap opens the thread with a nudge already written.
  Widget _followUpCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final List<List<dynamic>> quiet = <List<dynamic>>[];
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
            in _leadDocs(s)) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final String st = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
          if (st != 'responded') {
            continue;
          }
          if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '').toString() != 'vendor') {
            continue;
          }
          final dynamic ts = m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['respondedAt'];
          if (ts is! Timestamp) {
            continue;
          }
          final int days = now.difference(ts.toDate()).inDays;
          if (days < 3) {
            continue;
          }
          quiet.add(<dynamic>[days, d]);
        }
        if (quiet.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        quiet.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
            (b[0] as int).compareTo(a[0] as int));
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 12),
            borderColor: gold,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  const Expanded(
                      child: Text('Waiting on them',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted))),
                  Text('${quiet.length}', style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _foldBtn('followups'),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                const Text(
                    'You replied, they went quiet. A nudge now beats a lost date later.',
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                for (final List<dynamic> q in quiet.take(4))
                  Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                    final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d =
                        q[1] as QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>;
                    final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
                    final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                        ? 'A couple'
                        : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
                    final String wd = _weddingDateOf(m);
                    return Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          border: Border(
                              top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Text(nm,
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 13.5,
                                        color: ink,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                Text(
                                    '${q[0]} days quiet${wd.isEmpty ? '' : ' \u00b7 $wd'}',
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                              ]),
                        ),
                        TextButton(
                          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                              minimumSize: const Size(0, 30)),
                          onPressed: _h(() => _openWithNudge(d.id, m, vd)),
                          child: const Text('Nudge',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    );
                  }),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _openWithNudge(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    String template =
        'Hi {couple}, just checking in - is {date} still the plan? Happy to hold the date while you decide, and to answer anything at all.';
    if (vd['savedReplies'] is List) {
      for (final dynamic r in vd['savedReplies'] as List) {
        if (r is Map &&
            (r['title'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase().contains('nudge')) {
          template = (r['text'] ?? template).toString();
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    final String body = _mergeReply(template, inq, vd);
    setState(() {
      _setInboxThread(inquiryId);
      _showInbox = true;
      _inboxMsgC.value = TextEditingValue(
          text: body, selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: body.length));
    });
  }

  // One list, the same one the editor uses. Replaces the checklist, the
  // swipe deck and the strength card that used to disagree with each other.
  Widget _profileTodoCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<List<dynamic>> checks = _strengthFromVendor(vd);
    final int pct = _strengthPct(checks);
    final List<List<dynamic>> done =
        checks.where((List<dynamic> c) => c[1] == true).toList();
    final List<List<dynamic>> todo =
        checks.where((List<dynamic> c) => c[1] != true).toList();
    Widget row(List<dynamic> c, bool ok) {
      return InkWell(
        onTap: ok ? null : () => _openProfileEditor(vendorId, vd),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Container(
              width: 18,
              height: 18,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: ok ? vGreen : Colors.transparent,
                border: Border.all(color: ok ? vGreen : gold, width: 1.5),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(c[0] as String,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: ok ? muted : ink,
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      decoration: ok ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null)),
            ),
            if (!ok)
              Text(c[3] as String,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
          ]),
        ),
      );
    }

    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Expanded(
                child: Text('Make your profile work harder',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted))),
            Text('$pct', style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (todo.isEmpty)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 2, bottom: 6),
              child: Text('Complete. Your profile is dressed to book.',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: vGreen,
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          for (final List<dynamic> c in todo) row(c, false),
          for (final List<dynamic> c in done.take(3)) row(c, true),
          if (done.length > 3)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
              child: Text('${done.length - 3} more done',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('Profile strength $pct. The same list the editor uses.',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // June's tip reads the leads, not just the profile. This rule set stands
  // in until her lead-aware function lands.
  Widget _vendorTipCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            _leadDocs(s);
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        String tip = '';
        String cta = '';
        VoidCallback? go;
        QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? waiting;
        Duration? waitFor;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if (!_isUnread(m)) {
            continue;
          }
          final dynamic ts = m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['createdAt'];
          if (ts is! Timestamp) {
            continue;
          }
          final Duration age = now.difference(ts.toDate());
          final Duration? curWait = waitFor;
          if (age.inHours >= 4 && (curWait == null || age > curWait)) {
            waiting = d;
            waitFor = age;
          }
        }
        final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? w = waiting;
        if (w != null) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = w.data();
          final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
              ? 'A couple'
              : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
          tip =
              '$nm has been waiting ${_ago(m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['createdAt'])}. First reply usually wins - answer them before someone else does.';
          cta = 'Open thread';
          go = () {
            setState(() {
              _setInboxThread(w.id);
              _showInbox = true;
            });
          };
        }
        if (tip.isEmpty) {
          final DateTime t0 = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
            final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
                (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
            if (!booked) {
              continue;
            }
            final DateTime? wd = _weddingDateRaw(m);
            if (wd == null) {
              continue;
            }
            final int days =
                DateTime(wd.year, wd.month, wd.day).difference(t0).inDays;
            if (days < 0 || days > 14) {
              continue;
            }
            if ((m['questionnaireStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'completed') {
              continue;
            }
            final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                ? 'A couple'
                : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
            tip =
                '$nm\u2019s wedding is in $days day${days == 1 ? '' : 's'} and the questionnaire hasn\u2019t come back. Send it, or nudge them in the thread.';
            cta = 'Open thread';
            go = () {
              setState(() {
                _setInboxThread(d.id);
                _showInbox = true;
              });
            };
            break;
          }
        }
        if (tip.isEmpty) {
          final bool hasDates = vd['unavailableDates'] is List &&
              (vd['unavailableDates'] as List).isNotEmpty;
          final bool hasVideo =
              (vd['videoUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty ||
                  (vd['videoSamples'] is List &&
                      (vd['videoSamples'] as List).isNotEmpty);
          final int faqs =
              vd['vendorFaqs'] is List ? (vd['vendorFaqs'] as List).length : 0;
          if (!hasDates) {
            tip =
                'Mark your booked dates. Couples self-filter, and every inquiry gets realer.';
            cta = 'Open calendar';
          } else if (!hasVideo) {
            tip =
                'Add a highlight film. Motion sells emotion, and couples who watch it arrive half-sold.';
            cta = 'Add a video';
          } else if (faqs < 2) {
            tip =
                'Answer the two questions couples always ask. It saves you the same email forever.';
            cta = 'Add FAQs';
          } else {
            tip =
                'Your profile is dialed. Now it is a speed game - first reply usually wins.';
          }
          if (cta.isNotEmpty) {
            go = () => _openProfileEditor(vendorId, vd);
          }
        }
        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 16),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              const Row(children: <Widget>[
                Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                    color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F), size: 15),
                SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text('June\u2019s tip',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(tip,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ink, fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.45)),
              if (cta.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: gold,
                      foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                  onPressed: _h(go),
                  child: Text(cta,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  static const Map<String, List<String>> kStarterCats = <String, List<String>>{
    'starter_photo': <String>['wedding-photographers'],
    'starter_video': <String>['wedding-videographers'],
    'starter_dj': <String>['wedding-djs', 'wedding-bands'],
    'starter_planner': <String>['wedding-planners'],
    'starter_florist': <String>['wedding-florists'],
    'starter_hmua': <String>['hair-and-makeup'],

  Future<void> _starterLibrarySheet(String vendorId) async {
    // Show only the starters written for this vendor's craft
    List<String> myCats = <String>[];
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vSnap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('vendors')
              .doc(vendorId)
              .get();
      myCats = List<String>.from(
          (vSnap.data()?['categories'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]);
    } catch (_) {}
    final List<Map<String, String>> relevant =
        kStarterTemplates.where((Map<String, String> t) {
      final List<String> cats = kStarterCats[t['id']] ?? const <String>[];
      if (myCats.isEmpty) {
        return true;
      }
      return cats.any((String c) => myCats.contains(c));
    }).toList();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 28),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            const Text('Lazo starter templates',
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            const Text(
                'Professional baselines written for wedding vendors. Add one, personalize it, and review with your own judgment - starters are a head start, not legal advice.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            if (relevant.isEmpty)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                child: Text(
                    'Starters for your category are on the way. Meanwhile, import the contract you already use — June converts it in about a minute.',
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
              ),
            ...relevant.map((Map<String, String> t) => ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  dense: true,
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded,
                      color: plum, size: 22),
                  title: Text(t['name'] ?? '',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: ink,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  subtitle: Text(t['blurb'] ?? '',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                  onTap: () => _starterPreviewSheet(vendorId, t),
                )),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _starterPreviewSheet(String vendorId, Map<String, String> t) {
    bool adding = false;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setP) => Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 26),
          child: SizedBox(
            height: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size.height * .8,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(t['name'] ?? '',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                ]),
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                    ),
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Text(t['body'] ?? '',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12, color: ink, height: 1.4)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plum,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(adding
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            setP(() => adding = true);
                            final String body = t['body'] ?? '';
                            final List<String> fields = <String>[];
                            for (final RegExpMatch m
                                in RegExp(r'\{([a-z0-9_]+)\}')
                                    .allMatches(body)) {
                              final String f = '{${m.group(1)!}}';
                              if (!fields.contains(f)) {
                                fields.add(f);
                              }
                            }
                            try {
                              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                  .collection('vendors')
                                  .doc(vendorId)
                                  .collection('contractTemplates')
                                  .add(<String, dynamic>{
                                'name': t['name'] ?? 'Starter template',
                                'status': 'draft',
                                'source': 'starter',
                                'body': body,
                                'fieldsDetected': fields,
                                'notes': <String>[
                                  'Lazo starter template - personalize the details and review with your own judgment before first use.',
                                ],
                                'version': 1,
                                'createdBy': _uid,
                                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                              });
                              if (ctx2.mounted) {
                                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                              }
                              if (mounted) {
                                Navigator.pop(context);
                              }
                              _toast(
                                  'Added \u2713 Review & activate it in Contract templates.');
                            } catch (_) {
                              setP(() => adding = false);
                              _toast('Could not add - try again.');
                            }
                          }),
                    icon: adding
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 16,
                            height: 16,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                strokeWidth: 2, color: plum))
                        : const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 19),
                    label: const Text('Add to my templates',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _cardIconChip(IconData icon) {
    return Container(
      width: 34,
      height: 34,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.28), gold.withOpacity(.12)]),
        shape: BoxShape.circle,

      ),
