    );
  }

  // v149: a small left-aligned switch, not a full-width bar.
  static const List<List<dynamic>> _kModes = <List<dynamic>>[
    <dynamic>['leads', 'Today', Icons.wb_sunny_rounded],
    <dynamic>['pipeline', 'Pipeline', Icons.view_kanban_rounded],
    <dynamic>['money', 'Money', Icons.payments_rounded],
    <dynamic>['studio', 'Studio', Icons.business_center_rounded],
    <dynamic>['profile', 'Profile', Icons.storefront_rounded],
  ];
  static const double _kSegW = 116;
  static const double _kSegH = 38;

  // v175: one plum pill glides between positions; the labels stay put.
  Widget _dashModeToggle() {
    int idx = _kModes.indexWhere((List<dynamic> m) => m[0] == _dashMode);
    if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
    final bool reduced = _reducedMotion(context);
    return Align(
      key: _kTourModes,
      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFFF1E9E1),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: goldLine),
          ),
          child: SizedBox(
            width: _kSegW * _kModes.length,
            height: _kSegH,
            child: Stack(children: <Widget>[
              AnimatedPositioned(
                duration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 0 : 280),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                left: idx * _kSegW,
                top: 0,
                bottom: 0,
                width: _kSegW,
                child: DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: plum, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9)),
                ),
              ),
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                for (int i = 0; i < _kModes.length; i++) _modeSeg(i),
              ]),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _modeSeg(int i) {
    final String mode = _kModes[i][0] as String;
    final bool sel = _dashMode == mode;
    final bool locked = mode == 'studio' && _studioLocked;
    return _Press(
      scale: .96,
      tick: _Tick.select,
      onTap: sel ? null : () => setState(() => _dashMode = mode),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: _kSegW,
        height: _kSegH,
        child:
            Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: <Widget>[
          Icon(_kModes[i][2] as IconData, size: 15, color: sel ? gold : muted),
          const SizedBox(width: 7),
          AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
            curve: Curves.easeOut,
            style: TextStyle(
                color: sel ? ivory : muted,
                fontSize: 13.5,
                fontWeight: sel ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w600),
            child: Text(_kModes[i][1] as String),
          ),
          if (locked) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Icon(Icons.lock_rounded,
                size: 12, color: sel ? gold : muted.withOpacity(.7)),
          ],
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _studioPreviewBanner(String vendorId) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),

  Widget _allContractsCard(String vendorId) {
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.55),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            _cardIconChip(Icons.folder_special_rounded),
            const Text('All contracts',
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 16.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          const Text('Every contract across all your couples, newest first.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: _contractsAllStream(vendorId),
            builder: (BuildContext context,
                AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
              if (snap.hasError) {
                return const Text(
                    'Almost ready - contracts index is still building. Check back in a minute.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted));
              }
              final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                  (snap.data?.docs ??
                          <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                      .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                final String st = (d.data()['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
                return st != 'rescinded' && st != 'archived';
              }).toList();
              docs.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
                  QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
                final dynamic ta = a.data()['createdAt'];
                final dynamic tb = b.data()['createdAt'];
                if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) {
                  return tb.compareTo(ta);
                }
                return 0;
              });
              if (docs.isEmpty) {
                return const Text(
                    'No contracts yet - open a lead thread and tap the contract icon to send your first.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted));
              }
              return Column(
                children:
                    docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> ct = d.data();
                  final String status = (ct['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
                  final String signedPath =
                      (ct['signedPdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
                  final String pdfPath = (ct['pdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
                  final String openPath =
                      signedPath.isNotEmpty ? signedPath : pdfPath;
                  final Color stColor = status == 'signed'
                      ? vGreen
                      : status == 'sent'
                          ? plum
                          : status == 'declined'
                              ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
                              : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
                  return InkWell(
                    onTap: openPath.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : () => _openContractPdf(openPath),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.55),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(color: stColor.withOpacity(.45)),
                      ),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Icon(Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                            color: stColor, size: 17),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                              (ct['templateName'] ?? 'Contract') as String,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: stColor.withOpacity(.16),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                          ),
                          child: Text(status.toUpperCase(),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: stColor,
                                  fontSize: 8.5,
                                  letterSpacing: 1.2,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static const String _kBadgeBase = 'https://meetlazo.com/badges';

  String _badgeAssetUrl() => '$_kBadgeBase/lazo-verified-$_badgeVariant.png';

  String _badgeProfileUrl(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String metro = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    final String cat = (vd['category'] ?? '').toString();
    final String slug = (vd['slug'] ?? '').toString();
    if (metro.isNotEmpty && cat.isNotEmpty && slug.isNotEmpty) {
      return 'https://meetlazo.com/$metro/$cat/$slug/';
    }
    return 'https://meetlazo.com';
  }

  String _badgeEmbedCode(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String name = (vd['name'] ?? 'Lazo Verified Vendor').toString();
    return '<a href="${_badgeProfileUrl(vd)}" target="_blank" '
        'rel="noopener" title="$name on Lazo">'
        '<img src="${_badgeAssetUrl()}" '
        'alt="Lazo Verified \u2014 $name" width="140" height="140" '
        'style="border:0;max-width:100%;height:auto"/></a>';
  }

  // v126: reviews arrive on their own. The vendor should know exactly when
  // and be able to stop it - surprises about outreach to their couples are
  // the fastest way to lose their trust.
  Widget _reviewsCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final bool on = vd['reviewRequestsEnabled'] != false;
    final dynamic rawCount = vd['reviewCount'];
    final int count =
        rawCount is int ? rawCount : (rawCount is num ? rawCount.toInt() : 0);
    final num avg = (vd['reviewAverage'] ?? 0) as num;
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.55),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            _cardIconChip(Icons.star_rounded),
            const Expanded(
              child: Text('Reviews',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: plum,
                      fontSize: 16.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
            if (count > 0)
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: gold, size: 15),
                const SizedBox(width: 3),
                Text('${avg.toStringAsFixed(1)} \u00b7 $count',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ]),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: on ? gold.withOpacity(.12) : const Color(0xFFF1E9E0),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              border: Border.all(
                  color: on ? gold.withOpacity(.6) : muted.withOpacity(.35)),
            ),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              Icon(on ? Icons.schedule_send_rounded : Icons.pause_rounded,
                  color: on ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : muted, size: 17),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(
                          on
                              ? 'We ask your couples for you'
                              : 'Automatic requests are off',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: on ? plum : muted,
                              fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      Text(
                          on
                              ? 'Three days after each wedding we send a review request in your name, then two gentle nudges (day 10 and day 21). We stop the moment they review \u2014 or if they ask us to.'
                              : 'Nothing goes out. You can still ask a couple yourself in their thread.',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                    ]),
              ),
              Switch(
                value: on,
                activeColor: plum,
                activeTrackColor: gold,
                onChanged: _hb((bool v2) {
                  FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('vendors')
                      .doc(vendorId)
                      .set(<String, dynamic>{'reviewRequestsEnabled': v2},
                          SetOptions(merge: true));
                  _toast(v2
                      ? 'On \u2014 we\u2019ll ask after each wedding.'
                      : 'Off \u2014 no automatic requests.');
                }),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: _liveQuery(
                'reviews:$vendorId',
                () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('reviews')
                    .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId)
                    .limit(5)),
            builder: (BuildContext c,
                AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
              final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                  s.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
              if (docs.isEmpty) {
                return const Text(
                    'No reviews yet. They only come from couples who actually booked you here \u2014 which is exactly why they carry weight.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4));
              }
              return Column(
                children:
                    docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> r = d.data();
                  final dynamic rawRating = r['rating'];
                  final int rating = rawRating is int
                      ? rawRating
                      : (rawRating is num ? rawRating.toInt() : 0);
                  return Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.6),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.4)),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Row(children: <Widget>[
                            ...List<Widget>.generate(
                                5,
                                (int i) => Icon(
                                    i < rating
                                        ? Icons.star_rounded
                                        : Icons.star_outline_rounded,
                                    color: gold,
                                    size: 14)),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                  (r['coupleName'] ?? 'A couple').toString(),

                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                            ),
                          ]),
                          if ((r['text'] ?? '')
                              .toString()
                              .isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                            const SizedBox(height: 5),
                            Text((r['text'] ?? '').toString(),
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12, color: ink, height: 1.4)),

                        ]),
                  );
                }).toList(),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // v111: shown when the subscription is past_due (card declined; access
  // locked until a retry succeeds or the vendor re-checks-out with a new card).

      stream: _liveQuery(

              .collection('proSubscriptions')

              .where('status', isEqualTo: 'past_due')

      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ps) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =

  // v114: GET PAID — the vendor's money rails. Stripe (auto-confirming) plus
  // any payment link they already use. Lazo never holds a cent of it.
  // v136: the money, plainly. Collected today, this month, this year, and
  // what is still outstanding - counted from the invoices themselves.
  String _pMoney(num v) {
    final String s = v.round().toString();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) {
        b.write(',');
      }
      b.write(s[i]);
    }
    return '\u0024$b';
  }

  Widget _payStat(String label, num value, Color c, {bool big = false}) {
    return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(label.toUpperCase(),
              style: const TextStyle(
                  color: muted,
                  fontSize: 8.5,
                  letterSpacing: 1.4,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          const SizedBox(height: 3),
          Text(_pMoney(value),
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: c,
                  fontSize: big ? 27 : 18,
                  height: 1.05,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ]);
  }

  // v138: build streams once per vendor, not once per rebuild.
  // v148: routed through _Live so a card that mounts later (toggling into
  // Studio) gets the current snapshot instead of waiting for the next write.
  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _invoicesAllStream(
      String vendorId) {
    return _liveQuery(
        'invoices:$vendorId',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collectionGroup('invoices')
            .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId));
  }

  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _contractsAllStream(
      String vendorId) {
    return _liveQuery(
        'contracts:$vendorId',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collectionGroup('contracts')
            .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId)
            .limit(25));
  }

  Widget _paymentsCard(String vendorId) {
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.55),
      child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _invoicesAllStream(vendorId),
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
          if (snap.hasError) {
            return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    _cardIconChip(Icons.payments_rounded),
                    const Text('Payments',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 16.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Text(
                      'Almost ready \u2014 Firestore is still building the index for this view. Check back in a minute or two.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                ]);
          }
          final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
              (snap.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                  .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                      d.data()['demo'] != true)
                  .toList();
          final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
          final DateTime dayStart = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
          final DateTime monthStart = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
          final DateTime yearStart = DateTime(now.year, 1, 1);
          num day = 0, month = 0, year = 0, all = 0, outstanding = 0;
          int paidCount = 0, openCount = 0;
          final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> recent =
              <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
            final String st = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
            final num total = (m['total'] is num) ? m['total'] as num : 0;
            if (st == 'void') {
              continue;
            }
            if (st == 'paid') {
              paidCount++;
              all += total;
              recent.add(d);
              final dynamic pa = m['paidAt'];
              if (pa is Timestamp) {
                final DateTime t2 = pa.toDate();
                if (!t2.isBefore(dayStart)) day += total;
                if (!t2.isBefore(monthStart)) month += total;
                if (!t2.isBefore(yearStart)) year += total;
              }
            } else {
              openCount++;
              outstanding += total;
            }
          }
          recent.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
              QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
            final dynamic ta = a.data()['paidAt'];
            final dynamic tb = b.data()['paidAt'];
            if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) return tb.compareTo(ta);
            return 0;
          });

          return Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                _cardIconChip(Icons.payments_rounded),
                const Expanded(
                  child: Text('Payments',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 16.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                if (paidCount > 0)
                  Text('$paidCount paid',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: vGreen,
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                      colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                ),
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const Text('COLLECTED THIS YEAR',
                          style: TextStyle(

                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10.5,
                      color: muted.withOpacity(.9),
                      height: 1.4)),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

  Future<void> _connectStripe(String vendorId) async {
    _showJuneVeil('Opening Stripe\u2026',
        'You\u2019ll connect the account you already use \u2014 or make one in about a minute.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'stripeConnectStart',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 40)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      _popJuneVeil();
      final String url = (r['url'] ?? '') as String;
      if (url.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Could not reach Stripe \u2014 try again.');
        return;
      }
      await _openUrl(url);
      _toast('Finish in the Stripe tab \u2014 this card updates itself.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not start Stripe onboarding.');
    } catch (_) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not start Stripe onboarding.');
    }
  }

  // v137: Square OAuth connect - callable mints the authorize URL server-side
  // (state nonce lives in vendors/{id}/private/square, never in the client).
  Future<void> _connectSquare(String vendorId) async {
    _showJuneVeil('Opening Square\u2026',
        'Approve once and the account you already run takes cards here too.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'squareOAuthStart',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 40)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      _popJuneVeil();
      final String url = (r['url'] ?? '') as String;
      if (url.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Could not reach Square \u2014 try again.');
        return;
      }
      await _openUrl(url);
      _toast('Approve in the Square tab \u2014 this card updates itself.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not start Square connect.');
    } catch (_) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not start Square connect.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _disconnectSquare(String vendorId) async {
    final bool? sure = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Text('Disconnect Square?',
            style: TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: const Text(
            'New invoices will stop offering Square card payments. Anything couples already paid stays exactly where it is \u2014 in your Square account.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: ink, height: 1.4)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false)),
            child: const Text('Keep it',
                style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: plum, foregroundColor: ivory),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true)),
            child: const Text('Disconnect',
                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (sure != true) {
      return;
    }
    _showJuneVeil('Disconnecting\u2026', 'One moment.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'squareDisconnect',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 40)));
      await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Square disconnected.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not disconnect Square.');
    } catch (_) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not disconnect Square.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addPaymentLink(String vendorId, List<dynamic> existing) async {
    final List<String> brands = <String>[
      'Venmo',
      'Cash App',
      'PayPal',
      'Authorize.net',
      'Zelle',
      'Other'
    ];
    String brand = brands.first;
    final TextEditingController urlC = TextEditingController();
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Add a payment method',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          content: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            Wrap(
              spacing: 6,
              runSpacing: 6,
              children: brands.map((String b) {
                final bool sel = brand == b;
                return ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(b,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          color: sel ? ivory : plum,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  selected: sel,
                  selectedColor: plum,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                  side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                  onSelected: _hb((_) => setD(() => brand = b)),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: urlC,
              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
              decoration: _epDeco(
                  'Link or handle', 'venmo.com/u/yourname or \u0040yourhandle'),
            ),
          ]),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final String u = urlC.text.trim();
                if (u.isEmpty) {
                  return;
                }
                final List<dynamic> next = List<dynamic>.from(existing)
                  ..add(<String, dynamic>{'label': brand, 'url': u});
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('vendors')
                    .doc(vendorId)
                    .set(<String, dynamic>{'paymentLinks': next},
                        SetOptions(merge: true));
                if (ctx2.mounted) {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                }
                _toast('Added \u2713');
              }),
              child: const Text('Add'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _retainerBlurb(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String m = (vd['retainerMode'] ?? 'contract').toString();
    if (m == 'off') {
      return 'Off \u2014 you send invoices yourself.';
    }
    if (m == 'percent') {
      final num p = (vd['retainerPercent'] ?? 50) as num;
      return 'Signed contract \u2192 we invoice ${p.round()}% of the total on the spot.';
    }
    if (m == 'flat') {
      final num f = (vd['defaultRetainer'] ?? 0) as num;
      return f > 0
          ? 'Signed contract \u2192 we invoice \u0024${f.round()} on the spot.'
          : 'Set an amount and it goes out the second a contract is signed.';
    }
    return 'Signed contract \u2192 we invoice the retainer your contract states.';
  }

  String _retainerBadge(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String m = (vd['retainerMode'] ?? 'contract').toString();
    if (m == 'off') return 'Off';
    if (m == 'percent') {
      return '${((vd['retainerPercent'] ?? 50) as num).round()}%';
    }
    if (m == 'flat') {
      final num f = (vd['defaultRetainer'] ?? 0) as num;
      return f > 0 ? '\u0024${f.round()}' : 'Set';
    }
    return 'Contract';
  }

  Future<void> _setDefaultRetainer(String vendorId, num current) async {
    // v131: never let a bad field or a slow read swallow the tap.
    Map<String, dynamic> vd0 = <String, dynamic>{};
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .get();
      vd0 = vs.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO retainer read: ' + e.toString());
      _toast('Could not open that: ' + _errText(e));
      return;
    }
    String mode = (vd0['retainerMode'] ?? 'contract').toString();
    num pct = 50;
    final dynamic rawPct = vd0['retainerPercent'];
    if (rawPct is num) {
      pct = rawPct;
    } else if (rawPct != null) {
      pct = num.tryParse(rawPct.toString()) ?? 50;
    }
    final TextEditingController flatC = TextEditingController(
        text: current > 0 ? current.round().toString() : '');
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Automatic retainer',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
              const Text(
                  'When a couple signs and you haven\u2019t already sent an invoice, Lazo bills them right away \u2014 while they\u2019re still celebrating.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ...<List<String>>[
                <String>[
                  'contract',
                  'Follow my contract',
                  'Whatever retainer your signed contract states \u2014 recommended.'
                ],
                <String>[
                  'percent',
                  'Percent of the total',
                  'Half down is the industry norm; set your own.'
                ],
                <String>[
                  'flat',
                  'A flat amount',
                  'Same retainer on every booking.'
                ],
                <String>[
                  'off',
                  'Don\u2019t invoice automatically',
                  'You\u2019ll send invoices yourself.'
                ],
              ].map((List<String> o) {
                final bool sel = mode == o[0];
                return InkWell(
                  onTap: () => setD(() => mode = o[0]),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(11),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: sel ? plum.withOpacity(.07) : Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(
                          color: sel ? plum : gold.withOpacity(.5),
                          width: sel ? 1.4 : 1),
                    ),
                    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Icon(
                          sel
                              ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded
                              : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
                          color: sel ? plum : muted,
                          size: 18),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Text(o[1],
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: sel ? plum : ink,
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              Text(o[2],
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11, color: muted, height: 1.3)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ),
                );
              }),
              if (mode == 'percent') ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  children: <num>[25, 30, 50].map((num p) {
                    final bool sel = pct == p;
                    return ChoiceChip(
                      label: Text('${p.round()}%',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              color: sel ? ivory : plum,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      selected: sel,
                      selectedColor: plum,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                      side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                      onSelected: _hb((_) => setD(() => pct = p)),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                    'On a \u00244,000 contract, that\u2019s \u0024${(4000 * pct / 100).round()}.',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
              ],
              if (mode == 'flat') ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                TextField(
                  controller: flatC,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 15),
                  decoration: _epDeco('Amount', 'e.g. 500'),
                ),
              ],
            ]),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final num flat = num.tryParse(flatC.text.trim()) ?? 0;
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('vendors')
                    .doc(vendorId)
                    .set(<String, dynamic>{
                  'retainerMode': mode,
                  'retainerPercent': pct,
                  'defaultRetainer': mode == 'flat' ? flat : 0,
                }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                if (ctx2.mounted) {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                }
                _toast(mode == 'off'
                    ? 'Automatic invoicing off.'
                    : mode == 'contract'
                        ? 'Saved \u2014 we\u2019ll follow each contract.'
                        : mode == 'percent'
                            ? 'Saved \u2014 ${pct.round()}% at signing.'
                            : 'Saved \u2014 \u0024${flat.round()} at signing.');
              }),
              child: const Text('Save'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v140: the sheet must know what the vendor already owns - a Pro owner
  // was shown a live "Choose Pro" button (double-subscription trap).
  void _upgradeSheet(String vendorId) {
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .doc(vendorId)
        .get()
        .then((DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final String currentTier =
          ((vs.data() ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['tier'] ?? '').toString();
      if (!kIsWeb) {
        // v179: App Store 3.1.1 - no purchase flow in the native apps. The
        // status sheet says what the plan is and where plans are managed.
        _mobilePlanSheet(currentTier, '', false);
        return;
      }
      _showUpgradeSheet(vendorId, currentTier);
    }).catchError((Object e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (!kIsWeb) {
        _mobilePlanSheet('', '', false);
        return;
      }
      _showUpgradeSheet(vendorId, '');
    });
  }

  Widget _tierCard({
    required BuildContext ctx,
    required StateSetter setU,
    required bool busy,
    required void Function(bool) onBusy,
    required String vendorId,
    required String tier,
    required String title,
    required String price,
    required String note,
    required List<String> bullets,
    required bool pif,
    bool featured = false,
    String currentTier = '',
  }) {
    final bool isCurrent = tier == currentTier;
    final bool included = tier == 'pro' && currentTier == 'studio';
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: featured
            ? const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum])
            : null,
        color: featured ? null : Colors.white.withOpacity(.75),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
            color: featured ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.55),
            width: featured ? 1.4 : 1),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Flexible(
                  child: Text(title,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: featured ? gold : plum,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
                if (isCurrent) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: gold,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('YOUR PLAN',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: plumDeep,
                            fontSize: 8.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.4,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ],
              ]),
            ),
            Text(price,
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: featured ? ivory : plum,
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ]),
          Text(note,
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: featured ? ivory.withOpacity(.8) : muted,
                  fontSize: 11)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ...bullets.map((String b) => Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 3),
                child: Text('\u2022 $b',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: featured ? ivory : ink,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        height: 1.3)),
              )),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: featured ? gold : plum,
                  foregroundColor: featured ? plum : ivory,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12)),
              onPressed: _h(
                  (busy || isCurrent || included)
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          setU(() => onBusy(true));
                          try {
                            final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                .httpsCallable('createProIntent',
                                    options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                        timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30)));
                            final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
                                await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                              'vendorId': vendorId,
                              'tier': tier,
                              'cadence': pif ? 'pif' : 'monthly',
                            });
                            final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
                            final String url =
                                (r['checkoutUrl'] ?? '') as String;
                            if (ctx.mounted) {
                              Navigator.pop(ctx);
                            }
                            if (url.isNotEmpty) {
                              await _openUrl(url);
                              _toast(
                                  'Finish payment in the new tab - your dashboard updates automatically.');
                            }
                          } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                            setU(() => onBusy(false));
                            _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not start checkout.');
                          } catch (_) {
                            setU(() => onBusy(false));
                            _toast('Could not start checkout.');
                          }
                        },
                  _Tick.medium),
              child: Text(
                  isCurrent
                      ? 'Your current plan'
                      : included
                          ? 'Included in Studio'
                          : 'Choose $title',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // v157: what the native apps show instead of the purchase sheet.
  Future<void> _mobilePlanSheet(
      String tier, String status, bool canceling) async {
    final String plan = tier == 'studio'
        ? 'Lazo Pro Studio'
        : tier == 'pro'
            ? 'Lazo Pro'
            : 'Free listing';
    final String line = tier.isEmpty
        ? 'Pro and Pro Studio unlock June, contracts, invoices, galleries and more.'
        : status == 'past_due'
            ? 'Your last renewal didn\u2019t go through.'
            : canceling
                ? 'Cancels at the end of the current period.'
                : 'Active.';
    // v179: Apple permits a link out to the browser for purchases on the US
    // storefront only, so the button appears for US-region devices; everywhere
    // else the sheet is text only. The web build never reaches this sheet.
    final bool usDevice =
        (WidgetsBinding.instance.platformDispatcher.locale.countryCode ?? '')
                .toUpperCase() ==
            'US';
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 20, 22),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: card,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
          border: Border.all(color: goldLine),
        ),
        child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(plan, style: _serif(size: 26)),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(line,
                  style:
                      const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13, height: 1.4)),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: ivory,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                child: const Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(Icons.language_rounded, color: plum, size: 18),
                  SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                        'Plans, upgrades and card details are managed on meetlazo.com from any browser. Changes show here within a minute.',
                        style:
                            TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13, height: 1.4)),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
              if (usDevice) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: plum,
                        foregroundColor: ivory,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(() {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      _openUrl('https://meetlazo.com/for-vendors/#pricing');
                    }),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded, size: 18),
                    label: const Text('Manage your plan on meetlazo.com',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v140: declined renewals must be self-serve fixable - card update rides
  // the same intent -> hosted checkout rail as purchases.
  Future<void> _startCardUpdate(String vendorId) async {
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'createCardUpdateIntent',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      final String url = (r['checkoutUrl'] ?? '') as String;
      if (url.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Could not start the card update - try again.');
        return;
      }
      await _openUrl(url);
      _toast(
          'Add your new card in the secure tab - renewals use it automatically.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not start the card update.');
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not start the card update.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _manageProSheet(String vendorId) async {
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> sSnap = await FirebaseFirestore
        .instance
        .collection('proSubscriptions')
        .doc(vendorId)
        .get();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> s = sSnap.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final String tier = (s['tier'] ?? '') as String;
    final String status = (s['status'] ?? '') as String;
    final bool canceling = s['cancelAtPeriodEnd'] == true;
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      // v157: App Store / Play rules - no purchase or card flow inside the
      // native apps. Show the plan, point at the website.
      await _mobilePlanSheet(tier, status, canceling);
      return;
    }
    String until = '';
    if (s['currentPeriodEnd'] is Timestamp) {
      final DateTime e = (s['currentPeriodEnd'] as Timestamp).toDate();
      const List<String> mo = <String>[
        'January',
        'February',
        'March',
        'April',
        'May',
        'June',
        'July',
        'August',
        'September',
        'October',
        'November',
        'December'
      ];
      until = '${mo[e.month - 1]} ${e.day}, ${e.year}';
    }
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 30),
        child: Column(

  Future<void> _uploadContractTemplate(String vendorId) async {
    FilePickerResult? res;
    try {
      res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['pdf', 'docx', 'txt'],
        withData: true,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not open files.');
      return;
    }
    if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
    final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
    if (bytes == null) {
      _toast('Could not read that file.');
      return;
    }
    if (bytes.length > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      _toast('File too large - 10MB max.');
      return;
    }
    final String lower = f.name.toLowerCase();
    String cType = 'application/octet-stream';
    if (lower.endsWith('.pdf')) {
      cType = 'application/pdf';
    } else if (lower.endsWith('.docx')) {
      cType =
          'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';
    } else if (lower.endsWith('.txt')) {
      cType = 'text/plain';
    }
    final String safeName = f.name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
    final String path =
        'vendors/$vendorId/templates/uploads/t${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safeName';
    setState(() => _tplBusy = true);
    try {
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
      await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: cType));
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
        'parseContractTemplate',
        options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 300)),
      );
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'storagePath': path,
        'filename': f.name,
      });
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _tplBusy = false);
      _showParseResult(vendorId, r);
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _tplBusy = false);
      }
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Template analysis failed - try again.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _tplBusy = false);
      }
      _toast('Upload failed - try again.');
    }
  }

  void _showTemplateSheet(String vendorId, String tid, Map<String, dynamic> t) {
    final String name = (t['name'] ?? 'Template') as String;
    final String status = (t['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
    final String body = (t['body'] ?? '') as String;
    final List<String> notes = t['notes'] is List
        ? (t['notes'] as List).map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).toList()
        : <String>[];
    final bool active = status == 'active';
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 30),
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .78,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(name,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
                IconButton(

              ]),

                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),

  Future<void> _templateEditorSheet(String vendorId, String tid) async {
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref = FirebaseFirestore
        .instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .doc(vendorId)
        .collection('contractTemplates')
        .doc(tid);
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap = await ref.get();
    if (!snap.exists || !mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> t = snap.data()!;
    final TextEditingController nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: (t['name'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController bodyC =
        TextEditingController(text: (t['body'] ?? '').toString());
    bool saving = false;
    await showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setE) {
          return Padding(
            padding:
                EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SafeArea(
              child: Center(
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: BoxConstraints(
                      maxWidth: 820,
                      maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size.height * .92),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 18),
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Row(children: <Widget>[
                            const Expanded(
                              child: Text('Edit template',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 18,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                            IconButton(
                                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2)),
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                    color: muted)),
                          ]),
                          const Text(
                              'Your wording, your attorney\u2019s wording \u2014 change anything. Fields in {{double_braces}} fill automatically; keep the braces. Changes apply to contracts you send from now on \u2014 anything already sent keeps the wording it was signed with.',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          TextField(
                            controller: nameC,
                            style: const TextStyle(color: ink),
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelStyle: TextStyle(color: muted),
                                labelText: 'Template name',
                                isDense: true,
                                border: OutlineInputBorder()),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Container(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                              ),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                              child: TextField(
                                controller: bodyC,
                                maxLines: null,
                                expands: true,
                                textAlignVertical: TextAlignVertical.top,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: ink,
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    height: 1.5,
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace'),
                                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                    border: InputBorder.none),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          SizedBox(
                            width: double.infinity,
                            child: FilledButton(
                              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                  backgroundColor: gold,
                                  foregroundColor: plum,
                                  padding:
                                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14)),
                              onPressed: _h(saving
                                  ? null
                                  : () async {
                                      final String body = bodyC.text;
                                      if (body.trim().length < 40) {
                                        _toast(
                                            'That looks too short to be a contract.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      setE(() => saving = true);
                                      final RegExp tokRe = RegExp(
                                          r'\{\{\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}');
                                      final List<String> fields = <String>[];
                                      for (final RegExpMatch m
                                          in tokRe.allMatches(body)) {
                                        final String f = m.group(1)!;
                                        if (!fields.contains(f)) {
                                          fields.add(f);
                                        }
                                      }
                                      try {
                                        await ref.set(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'name': nameC.text.trim().isEmpty
                                              ? (t['name'] ?? 'Template')
                                              : nameC.text.trim(),
                                          'body': body,
                                          'fields': fields,
                                          'editedAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                          'updatedAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                        if (ctx2.mounted) {
                                          Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                        }
                                        _toast(
                                            'Template saved \u2014 ${fields.length} auto-fill fields \u2713');
                                      } catch (e) {
                                        setE(() => saving = false);
                                        _toast('Could not save: $e');
                                      }
                                    }),
                              child: Text(
                                  saving ? 'Saving\u2026' : 'Save changes',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 14.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ]),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _setTemplateStatus(
      String vendorId, String tid, String status) async {
    if (tid.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .doc(vendorId)

        .doc(tid)
        .set(<String, dynamic>{
      'status': status,
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  // ---------------- v153: THE NOTIFICATION ASK ----------------
  // The OS prompt is one-shot: a No at launch can never be taken back from
  // inside the app. So we never ask on a cold open, when nothing has
  // happened and there is no reason to say yes. We ask here, right after a
  // vendor has answered a couple - the moment the value is obvious, because
  // the whole pitch is answering the next one fast. And we ask ourselves
  // first, so a No costs nothing and the next reply can ask again.
  // ---------------- v154: PUSH REGISTRATION, IN THE WIDGET ----------------
  // FlutterFlow only registers a token at startup, so granting permission
  // mid-session used to leave the device with no token until the next cold
  // launch. We do it here instead: ask, then fetch the token and write it in
  // FlutterFlow's own shape so its sender finds it.
  static const String kVapidKey =
      'BL9OflCUn1UyDwhFzdWQfsm_4yG5x7urzYbWGNvGhCbQgmsh5cNx-FX-VRRd4Q8dQpuWz04UG47Spu9VBj6CYdo';

  String get _pushDeviceType => kIsWeb
      ? 'web'
      : (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ? 'ios' : 'android');

  Future<void> _writePushToken(String token) async {
    final String? uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null || token.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('fcm_tokens')
          .doc(token)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'fcm_token': token,
        'device_type': _pushDeviceType,
        'created_at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push token write: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // Returns true only when permission was granted AND a token was written.
  Future<bool> _registerPush() async {
    try {
      final FirebaseMessaging fm = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
      final NotificationSettings st =
          await fm.requestPermission(alert: true, badge: true, sound: true);
      if (st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.authorized &&
          st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.provisional) {
        return false;
      }
      String? token;
      if (kIsWeb) {
        token = await fm.getToken(vapidKey: kVapidKey);
      } else {
        // iOS hands back the APNs token a beat after the grant; asking for
        // the FCM token before it lands throws.
        if (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS) {
          for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            final String? apns = await fm.getAPNSToken();
            if (apns != null && apns.isNotEmpty) break;
            await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
          }
        }
        token = await fm.getToken();
      }
      if (token == null || token.isEmpty) return false;
      await _writePushToken(token);
      fm.onTokenRefresh.listen(_writePushToken);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push register: ' + e.toString());
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _maybeAskPush() async {
    if (_vendorIdCache.isEmpty) return;
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> vref =
        FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(_vendorIdCache);
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> v = await vref.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> d = v.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      if ((d['pushAskAnswer'] ?? '') == 'yes') return;
      final dynamic asked = d['pushAskedAt'];
      if (asked is Timestamp &&
          DateTime.now().difference(asked.toDate()).inDays < 30) return;
    } catch (_) {
      return;
    }
    // Let the sent message land in the thread before anything covers it.
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1400));
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool? yes = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 22),
          child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                    width: 38,
                    height: 38,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: plumDeep,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.notifications_active_rounded,
                        color: gold, size: 19),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text('Want the next lead the moment it lands?',
                          style: _serif(size: 23))),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                const Text(
                    'Couples message three or four vendors at once, and the first real reply usually wins the booking. We\u2019ll ping you when one writes - and for nothing else.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
                    child: const Text('Yes, notify me',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Center(
                  child: TextButton(
                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
                    child: const Text('Not now',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (yes != true) {
      await _stampPushAsk('no');
      return;
    }
    final bool ok = await _registerPush();
    // 'blocked' means they said yes to us and the OS said no - asking again
    // can't help, only a trip to system settings can.
    await _stampPushAsk(ok ? 'yes' : 'blocked');
    if (ok) _toast('Done - we\u2019ll let you know.');
  }

  Future<void> _stampPushAsk(String answer) async {
    if (_vendorIdCache.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(_vendorIdCache)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'pushAskedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'pushAskAnswer': answer,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push ask stamp: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sendVendorMessage(
      String inquiryId, String text, String status) async {
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref =
        FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').doc(inquiryId);
    await ref.collection('messages').add(<String, dynamic>{
      'senderRole': 'vendor',
      'text': text,
      'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
    await ref.update(<String, dynamic>{
      'status': status,
      'vendorReply': text,
      'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
    _maybeAskPush();
  }

  String _catLabelFor(String catId) {
    for (int k = 0; k < _catIds.length; k++) {
      if (_catIds[k] == catId) return _catNames[k];
    }
    return '';
  }

  List<String> _starterFor(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<dynamic> cats = (vd['categories'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    for (final dynamic c in cats) {
      final List<String>? s = kQStarters[c.toString()];
      if (s != null) return s;
    }
    return kQGeneric;
  }

  // v125: send a questionnaire - the vendor's own templates first, with a
  // craft-specific starter always available.
  Future<void> _sendQuestionnaireSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vendorId = (inq['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Vendor profile not found on this inquiry.');
      return;
    }
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs = await FirebaseFirestore
        .instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .doc(vendorId)
        .get();
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd = vs.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final String bizName = (vd['name'] ?? 'Your vendor').toString();
    if (!mounted) return;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 26),
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .7,
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Text('Send a questionnaire',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                ]),
                Text(
                    'They answer in their thread and it arrives branded as $bizName. Your answers stay in the conversation forever.',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                    stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                        .collection('vendors')
                        .doc(vendorId)
                        .collection('questionnaireTemplates')
                        .snapshots(),
                    builder: (BuildContext c2,
                        AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
                      final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                          tpl = s.data?.docs ??

                      return ListView(children: <Widget>[
