  // Build or edit a reusable questionnaire template.
  // v129: June drafts or tightens a questionnaire. Results land in the
  // editor - she never saves or sends anything herself.
  Future<List<String>?> _juneQuestions(String vendorId,
      {required String mode, List<String> existing = const <String>[]}) async {
    String brief = '';
    if (mode == 'draft') {
      final TextEditingController b = TextEditingController();
      final bool? go = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('What is this questionnaire for?',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 16.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          content: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            const Text(
                'Optional - a word or two is plenty. June already knows your craft, packages, and how you work.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: b,
              autofocus: true,
              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14.5),
              decoration: _epDeco(
                  'For example', 'wedding day, elopement, engagement session'),
            ),
          ]),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
              child: const Text('Draft it'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      if (go != true) return null;
      brief = b.text.trim();
    }
    _showJuneVeil(
        mode == 'tighten'
            ? 'June is tightening it\u2026'
            : 'June is writing your questions\u2026',
        'She is reading your packages, your services, and the way you work.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneQuestionnaire',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 120)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'mode': mode,
        'brief': brief,
        'questions': existing,
      });
      _popJuneVeil();
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      final List<String> qs = (r['questions'] as List?)
              ?.map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
              .where((String s) => s.trim().isNotEmpty)
              .toList() ??
          <String>[];
      if (qs.isEmpty) {
        _toast('June came back empty \u2014 try again.');
        return null;
      }
      _toast('${qs.length} questions ready \u2014 edit anything, then save.');
      return qs;
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      if ((e.message ?? '').contains('studio-required')) {
        _toast('June for Studio is a Pro Studio feature.');
        _upgradeSheet(vendorId);
      } else {
        _toast(e.message ?? 'June could not draft that one.');
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('June could not draft that one \u2014 try again.');
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _questionnaireEditor(
      String vendorId, String? templateId, Map<String, dynamic> seed) async {
    final TextEditingController titleC =
        TextEditingController(text: (seed['title'] ?? '').toString());
    final List<TextEditingController> qcs =
        ((seed['questions'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .map((dynamic e) => TextEditingController(text: e.toString()))
            .toList();
    if (qcs.isEmpty) qcs.add(TextEditingController());
    bool saving = false;
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setE) => Padding(
          padding:
              EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: SizedBox(
            height: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size.height * .86,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 18),
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                            templateId == null
                                ? 'New questionnaire'
                                : 'Edit questionnaire',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: plum,
                                fontSize: 18,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                      if (templateId != null)
                        IconButton(
                          tooltip: 'Delete template',
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                              color: Color(0xFFB3413A), size: 20),
                          onPressed: _h(() async {
                            await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                .collection('vendors')
                                .doc(vendorId)
                                .collection('questionnaireTemplates')
                                .doc(templateId)
                                .delete();
                            if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                            _toast('Template deleted');
                          }),
                        ),
                      IconButton(
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                          onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2))),
                    ]),
                    const Text(
                        'Reorder, reword, delete - make it sound like you. Couples see it under your name.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    TextField(
                      controller: titleC,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 15),
                      decoration: _epDeco('Title', 'e.g. Wedding Day Details'),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10)),
                          onPressed: _h(() async {
                            final List<String>? out = await _juneQuestions(
                                vendorId,
                                mode: 'draft',
                                existing: qcs
                                    .map((TextEditingController x) =>
                                        x.text.trim())
                                    .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
                                    .toList());
                            if (out == null) return;
                            setE(() {
                              qcs.clear();
                              for (final String q in out) {
                                qcs.add(TextEditingController(text: q));
                              }
                              if (titleC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                                titleC.text = 'Wedding Day Details';
                              }
                            });
                          }),
                          icon:
                              const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, size: 15),
                          label: const Text('June, draft this',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10)),
                          onPressed: _h(() async {
                            final List<String> cur = qcs
                                .map((TextEditingController x) => x.text.trim())
                                .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
                                .toList();
                            if (cur.length < 2) {
                              _toast(
                                  'Add a few questions first and June will tidy them.');
                              return;
                            }
                            final List<String>? out = await _juneQuestions(
                                vendorId,
                                mode: 'tighten',
                                existing: cur);
                            if (out == null) return;
                            setE(() {
                              qcs.clear();
                              for (final String q in out) {
                                qcs.add(TextEditingController(text: q));
                              }
                            });
                          }),
                          icon:
                              const Icon(Icons.auto_fix_high_rounded, size: 15),
                          label: const Text('June, tighten it',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ]),
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 6, bottom: 2),
                      child: Text(
                          'She reads your packages and how you work, then drafts \u2014 nothing sends until you save.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ReorderableListView.builder(
                        buildDefaultDragHandles: false,
                        itemCount: qcs.length,
                        onReorder: (int a, int b) {
                          setE(() {
                            if (b > a) b -= 1;
                            final TextEditingController m = qcs.removeAt(a);
                            qcs.insert(b, m);
                          });
                        },
                        itemBuilder: (BuildContext c3, int i) {
                          return Padding(
                            key: ValueKey<int>(qcs[i].hashCode),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                              ReorderableDragStartListener(
                                index: i,
                                child: const Padding(
                                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                                  child: Icon(Icons.drag_indicator_rounded,
                                      color: muted, size: 18),
                                ),
                              ),
                              Expanded(
                                child: TextField(
                                  controller: qcs[i],
                                  maxLines: null,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                  decoration: _epDeco('Question ${i + 1}', ''),
                                ),
                              ),
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                    color: muted, size: 17),
                                onPressed:
                                    _h(() => setE(() => qcs.removeAt(i))),
                              ),
                            ]),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                    TextButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _h(
                          () => setE(() => qcs.add(TextEditingController()))),
                      icon:
                          const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, color: plum, size: 17),
                      label: const Text('Add a question',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold,
                            foregroundColor: plum,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14)),
                        onPressed: _h(saving
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                final List<String> qs = qcs
                                    .map((TextEditingController c4) =>
                                        c4.text.trim())
                                    .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
                                    .toList();
                                if (qs.isEmpty) {
                                  _toast('Add at least one question.');
                                  return;
                                }
                                setE(() => saving = true);
                                final Map<String, dynamic> data =
                                    <String, dynamic>{
                                  'title': titleC.text.trim().isEmpty
                                      ? 'Wedding Day Details'
                                      : titleC.text.trim(),
                                  'questions': qs,
                                  'type': 'custom',
                                  'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                };
                                final CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                    col = FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                        .collection('vendors')
                                        .doc(vendorId)
                                        .collection('questionnaireTemplates');
                                if (templateId == null) {
                                  data['createdAt'] =
                                      FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
                                  await col.add(data);
                                } else {
                                  await col
                                      .doc(templateId)
                                      .set(data, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                }
                                if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                _toast('Saved \u2713 Send it from any thread.');
                              }),
                        child: Text(saving ? 'Saving\u2026' : 'Save template',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _createQuestionnaire(String inquiryId, String type, String title,
      List<String> qs, String bizName) async {
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('questionnaires')
          .add(<String, dynamic>{
        'type': type,
        'title': title,
        'vendorName': bizName,
        'questions': qs,
        'answers': <String, dynamic>{},
        'status': 'sent',
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'questionnaireStatus': 'sent',
        'questionnaireUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Questionnaire sent \u2713');
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not send - try again.');
    }
  }

  Widget _questionnaireStrip(String inquiryId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'questionnaires'),
      stream: _threadQuery(
          inquiryId,
          'questionnaires',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .doc(inquiryId)
              .collection('questionnaires')
              .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
              .limit(3)),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            snap.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox(height: 0);
        }
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 0, 18, 2),
          child: Column(
            children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
              final Map<String, dynamic> qn = d.data();
              final String title = (qn['title'] ?? 'Questionnaire') as String;
              final bool done = (qn['status'] ?? '') == 'completed';
              return InkWell(
                onTap: done
                    ? () => _questionnaireAnswersSheet(qn)
                    : () =>
                        _toast('Waiting on the couple - answers appear here.'),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: (done ? vGreen : plum).withOpacity(.06),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(
                        color: (done ? vGreen : gold).withOpacity(.5)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(Icons.fact_check_outlined,
                        color: done ? vGreen : plum, size: 17),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(title,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: (done ? vGreen : gold).withOpacity(.16),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      ),
                      child: Text(done ? 'COMPLETED' : 'WAITING',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: done ? vGreen : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                              fontSize: 8.5,
                              letterSpacing: 1.2,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _questionnaireAnswersSheet(Map<String, dynamic> qn) {
    final List<dynamic> qs = qn['questions'] is List
        ? qn['questions'] as List<dynamic>
        : <dynamic>[];
    final Map<String, dynamic> ans = qn['answers'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(qn['answers'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 26),
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .8,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: Text((qn['title'] ?? 'Responses') as String,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
                IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
              ]),
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.builder(
                  itemCount: qs.length,
                  itemBuilder: (BuildContext c2, int i) {
                    final String a = (ans['$i'] ?? '').toString();
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(qs[i].toString(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Container(
                            width: double.infinity,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.45)),
                            ),
                            child: Text(a.isEmpty ? '\u2014' : a,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12.5, color: ink, height: 1.35)),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _contractsStrip(String inquiryId, String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'contracts'),
      stream: _threadQuery(
          inquiryId,
          'contracts',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .doc(inquiryId)
              .collection('contracts')
              .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
              .limit(3)),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (snap.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          final String st = (d.data()['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
          return st != 'rescinded' && st != 'archived';
        }).toList();
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox(height: 0);
        }
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 4, 18, 2),
          child: Column(
            children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
              final Map<String, dynamic> ct = d.data();
              final String tName = (ct['templateName'] ?? 'Contract') as String;
              final String status = (ct['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
              final String pdfPath = (ct['pdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
              final int nMiss = ct['missingFields'] is List
                  ? (ct['missingFields'] as List).length
                  : 0;
              final String signedPath = (ct['signedPdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
              final String openPath =
                  signedPath.isNotEmpty ? signedPath : pdfPath;
              final Color stColor = status == 'signed'
                  ? vGreen
                  : status == 'sent'
                      ? plum
                      : status == 'declined'
                          ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
                          : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
              return InkWell(
                onTap:
                    openPath.isEmpty ? null : () => _openContractPdf(openPath),
                onLongPress: () =>
                    _contractActionsSheet(vendorId, inquiryId, d.id, ct),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.06),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                        color: plum, size: 17),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                          nMiss > 0 ? '$tName \u00b7 $nMiss blanks' : tName,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: stColor.withOpacity(.16),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      ),
                      child: Text(status.toUpperCase(),
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: stColor,
                              fontSize: 8.5,
                              letterSpacing: 1.2,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                    if (status == 'draft' && nMiss == 0) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Send for signature',
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        constraints:
                            const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded,
                            color: plum, size: 17),
                        onPressed: _h(
                            () => _sendForSignature(vendorId, inquiryId, d.id)),
                      ),
                    ] else ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                          color: muted, size: 14),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    InkWell(
                      onTap: () =>
                          _contractActionsSheet(vendorId, inquiryId, d.id, ct),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.75),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.65)),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded,
                                  color: plum, size: 13),
                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                              Text(status == 'sent' ? 'Manage' : 'Options',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 10.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _contractActionsSheet(String vendorId, String inquiryId,
      String contractId, Map<String, dynamic> ct) {
    final String status = (ct['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
    final String pdfPath = (ct['pdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
    final String signedPath = (ct['signedPdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
    final String openPath = signedPath.isNotEmpty ? signedPath : pdfPath;
    final int nMiss =
        ct['missingFields'] is List ? (ct['missingFields'] as List).length : 0;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text((ct['templateName'] ?? 'Contract') as String,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            Text(status.toUpperCase(),
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: muted,
                    fontSize: 10,
                    letterSpacing: 1.4,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            if (openPath.isNotEmpty)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded, color: plum),
                title: const Text('View PDF'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _openContractPdf(openPath);
                },
              ),
            if (status == 'draft' && nMiss == 0)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: vGreen),
                title: const Text('Send for signature'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _sendForSignature(vendorId, inquiryId, contractId);
                },
              ),
            if (status == 'draft')
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                    color: Color(0xFFB3413A)),
                title: const Text('Delete draft',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFB3413A))),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _rescindContract(
                      vendorId,
                      inquiryId,
                      contractId,
                      'Delete this draft?',
                      'The draft and its PDF are permanently removed.');
                },
              ),
            if (status == 'sent')
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 2, 24, 10),
                child: Text(
                    'Need to change the terms? A sent contract can\u2019t be edited in place \u2014 rescind it, adjust, and send a fresh one. June refills everything.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
              ),
            if (status == 'sent')
              ListTile(
                leading:
                    const Icon(Icons.undo_rounded, color: Color(0xFFB3413A)),
                title: const Text('Rescind & send a new one',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFFB3413A), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                subtitle: const Text(
                    'Voids their signing link and clears it from the thread',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _rescindContract(
                      vendorId,
                      inquiryId,
                      contractId,
                      'Rescind this contract?',
                      'The couple\u2019s signing link is voided and the contract disappears from their thread. You can generate and send a new one anytime.');
                },
              ),
            if (status == 'declined')
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.archive_outlined, color: muted),
                title: const Text('Remove from thread'),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _rescindContract(
                      vendorId,
                      inquiryId,
                      contractId,
                      'Remove this declined contract?',
                      'It\u2019s hidden from the thread - the record is kept.');
                },
              ),
            if (status == 'signed')
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 4, 24, 10),
                child: Text(
                    'Signed contracts are executed legal records and can\u2019t be removed.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _rescindContract(String vendorId, String inquiryId,
      String contractId, String title, String message) async {
    final bool? go = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text(title,
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content:
            Text(message, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: ink)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFB3413A),
                  foregroundColor: ivory),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
              child: const Text('Confirm')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (go != true) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'rescindContract',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 60)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'contractId': contractId,
      });
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      final String res = (r['result'] ?? '') as String;
      _toast(res == 'deleted'
          ? 'Draft deleted'
          : res == 'rescinded'
              ? 'Contract rescinded'
              : 'Removed');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not complete - try again.');
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not complete - try again.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openContractPdf(String pdfPath) async {
    try {
      final String url =
          await FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(pdfPath).getDownloadURL();
      await _openUrl(url);
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not open the PDF.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _startContractFlow(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vendorId = (inq['vendorId'] ?? '') as String;
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Vendor profile not found on this inquiry.');
      return;
    }
    _showJuneVeil('Opening your contract studio…',
        'June is gathering what she already knows — names, dates, venue, pricing.');
    final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> allT = await FirebaseFirestore
        .instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .doc(vendorId)
        .collection('contractTemplates')
        .get();
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> actives = allT.docs
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['status'] ?? 'draft') == 'active')
        .toList();
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> drafts = allT.docs
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['status'] ?? 'draft') != 'active')
        .toList();
    if (actives.isEmpty) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _noActiveTemplateSheet(vendorId, inquiryId, inq, drafts);
      return;
    }
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ts0 = actives;
    if (ts0.length == 1) {
      _contractValuesForm(
          vendorId, inquiryId, inq, ts0.first.id, ts0.first.data());
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      return;
    }
    _popJuneVeil();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 30),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            const Text('Which template?',
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            ...ts0.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.description_rounded, color: plum),
                  title: Text((d.data()['name'] ?? 'Template') as String,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: ink,
                          fontSize: 14.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _contractValuesForm(
                        vendorId, inquiryId, inq, d.id, d.data());
                  },
                )),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _venueSearchSheet(TextEditingController target) async {
    final TextEditingController q =
        TextEditingController(text: target.text.split(',').first.trim());
    List<Map<String, String>> results = <Map<String, String>>[];
    bool busy = false;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setV) => Padding(
          padding:
              EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 26),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Text('Find the venue',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: q,
                      autofocus: true,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
                      onSubmitted: (String _) => setV(() {}),
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: ink),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Venue name or city\u2026',
                        isDense: true,
                        filled: true,
                        fillColor: Colors.white,
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                        ),
                        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plum,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16, vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(busy
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            if (q.text.trim().length < 3) {
                              return;
                            }
                            setV(() => busy = true);
                            try {
                              final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions
                                  .instance
                                  .httpsCallable('venueSearch',
                                      options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                          timeout:
                                              const Duration(seconds: 20)));
                              final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn
                                  .call(<String, dynamic>{
                                'query': q.text.trim()
                              });
                              final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                  Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
                              results = <Map<String, String>>[];
                              if (r['results'] is List) {
                                for (final dynamic e in r['results'] as List) {
                                  if (e is Map) {
                                    results.add(<String, String>{
                                      'name': (e['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      'address':
                                          (e['address'] ?? '').toString(),
                                    });
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            } catch (_) {
                              _toast('Search failed - try again.');
                            }
                            setV(() => busy = false);
                          }),
                    child: busy
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 16,
                            height: 16,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                strokeWidth: 2, color: plum))
                        : const Text('Search',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                ...results.map((Map<String, String> v) => ListTile(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      dense: true,
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.location_on_rounded,
                          color: plum, size: 20),
                      title: Text(v['name'] ?? '',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: ink,
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      subtitle: Text(v['address'] ?? '',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                      onTap: () {
                        target.text = '${v['name']}, ${v['address']}';
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      },
                    )),
                if (results.isEmpty && !busy)
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 6),
                    child: Text(
                        'Search by venue name - tap a result to fill name and address.',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _pickContractDate(TextEditingController c) async {
    DateTime initial = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime? parsed = DateTime.tryParse(c.text.trim());
    if (parsed != null) {
      initial = parsed;
    }
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: initial,
      firstDate: DateTime(DateTime.now().year - 1),
      lastDate: DateTime(DateTime.now().year + 5),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx, Widget? child) => Theme(
        data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
          colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
            primary: plum,
            onPrimary: ivory,
            onSurface: ink,
          ),
        ),
        child: child!,
      ),
    );
    if (picked == null) {
      return;
    }
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December'
    ];
    c.text = '${mo[picked.month - 1]} ${picked.day}, ${picked.year}';
  }

  String _fmtTodayLong() {
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December'
    ];
    final DateTime n = DateTime.now();
    return '${mo[n.month - 1]} ${n.day}, ${n.year}';
  }

  String _fmtMoney(dynamic v) {
    if (v == null) {
      return '';
    }
    final num? n = v is num ? v : num.tryParse(v.toString());
    if (n == null) {
      return v.toString();
    }
    final String s = n.round().toString();
    return '\u0024' +
        s.replaceAllMapped(
            RegExp(r'(\d)(?=(\d{3})+$)'), (Match m) => '${m[1]},');
  }

  static const Map<String, String> _kFieldLabels = <String, String>{
    '__venue': 'Venue (name and address)',
    'couple_names': 'Couple',
    'partner1_name': 'Partner 1',
    'partner2_name': 'Partner 2',
    'event_date': 'Wedding date',
    'signing_date': 'Signing date',
    'balance_due_date': 'Balance due',
    'coverage_hours': 'Hours of coverage',
    'coverage_start_time': 'Start time',
    'package_name': 'Package',
    'package_description': "What's included",
    'total_price': 'Total',
    'retainer_amount': 'Retainer',
    'balance_amount': 'Balance',
    'late_fee_amount': 'Late fee',
    'vendor_business_name': 'Your business',
    'vendor_signer_name': 'Who signs for you',
    'governing_state': 'Governing state',
    'venue_name': 'Venue',
    'venue_address': 'Venue address',
  };

  String _fieldLabel(String f) {
    final String? known = _kFieldLabels[f];
    if (known != null) return known;
    final String s = f.replaceAll('_', ' ').trim();
    if (s.isEmpty) return f;
    return s[0].toUpperCase() + s.substring(1);
  }

  Future<void> _contractValuesForm(
      String vendorId,
      String inquiryId,
      Map<String, dynamic> inq,
      String templateId,
      Map<String, dynamic> t) async {
    final String body = (t['body'] ?? '') as String;
    final List<String> fields = <String>[];
    for (final RegExpMatch m in RegExp(r'\{([a-z0-9_]+)\}').allMatches(body)) {
      final String f = m.group(1)!;
      if (!fields.contains(f)) {
        fields.add(f);
      }
    }
    // Combine venue_name + venue_address into ONE field when both exist
    final bool hasVenuePair =
        fields.contains('venue_name') && fields.contains('venue_address');
    if (hasVenuePair) {
      final int vi = fields.indexOf('venue_name');
      fields
          .removeWhere((String f) => f == 'venue_name' || f == 'venue_address');
      fields.insert(vi, '__venue');
    }
    // Server-side prefill: June assembles everything the platform knows
    // (couple names + venue from their wedding website, dates, proposal
    // pricing) plus the vendor's package list for one-tap fills.
    Map<String, String> serverPre = <String, String>{};
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> vendorPackages = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    _showJuneVeil('June is prefilling the contract…',
        'Names, dates, venue, and pricing — pulled from everything the thread already knows.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable pf = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'contractPrefill',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await pf.call(
          <String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId, 'inquiryId': inquiryId});
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      if (r['values'] is Map) {
        (r['values'] as Map).forEach((dynamic k, dynamic v) {
          serverPre[k.toString()] = (v ?? '').toString();
        });
      }
      if (r['packages'] is List) {
        for (final dynamic p in r['packages'] as List) {
          if (p is Map) {
            vendorPackages.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(p));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    _popJuneVeil();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    final Map<String, TextEditingController> cs =
        <String, TextEditingController>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> intent = inq['structuredIntent'] is Map
        ? inq['structuredIntent'] as Map<String, dynamic>
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    for (final String f in fields) {
      String pre = serverPre[f] ?? '';
      if (f == '__venue') {
        final String vn = serverPre['venue_name'] ?? '';
        final String va = serverPre['venue_address'] ?? '';
        pre = vn.isNotEmpty && va.isNotEmpty
            ? '$vn, $va'
            : vn.isNotEmpty
                ? vn
                : va;
      }
      if (pre.isEmpty) {
        if (f == 'couple_names' || f == 'partner1_name') {
          pre = (inq['coupleName'] ?? '') as String;
        } else if (f == 'event_date') {
          final String wd = (intent['weddingDate'] ?? '').toString();
          if (wd.isNotEmpty && wd != 'Date TBD') {
            pre = wd;
          }
        } else if (f == 'vendor_business_name' || f == 'vendor_signer_name') {
          pre = (inq['vendorName'] ?? '') as String;
        } else if (f == 'signing_date') {
          pre = _fmtTodayLong();
        }
      }
      cs[f] = TextEditingController(text: pre);
    }
    final bool showPkgPicker = vendorPackages.isNotEmpty &&
        fields.any((String f) =>
            f == 'package_name' ||
            f == 'package_description' ||
            f == 'total_price' ||
            f == 'coverage_hours');
    bool generating = false;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setSheet) => Padding(
          padding:
              EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 760),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size.height * .82,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(26, 20, 26, 24),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text((t['name'] ?? 'Contract') as String,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 18,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                      ]),
                      const Text(
                          'June pre-fills what she knows from the inquiry and proposal. Complete the rest - every field appears in the contract, so nothing can be left blank.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      if (showPkgPicker) ...<Widget>[
                        const Text('FILL FROM A PACKAGE',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: muted,
                                fontSize: 9.5,
                                letterSpacing: 1.6,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        SizedBox(
                          height: 34,
                          child: ListView(
                            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                            children: vendorPackages
                                .map((Map<String, dynamic> p) => Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                                      child: ActionChip(
                                        backgroundColor:
                                            Colors.white.withOpacity(.85),
                                        side: BorderSide(
                                            color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                                        label: Text((p['name'] ?? '') as String,
                                            style: const TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 12, color: plum)),
                                        onPressed: _h(() {
                                          final String nm =
                                              (p['name'] ?? '') as String;
                                          final String pr =
                                              (p['price'] ?? '') as String;
                                          final String hrs =
                                              (p['hours'] ?? '') as String;
                                          final String inc =
                                              (p['includes'] ?? '') as String;
                                          if (cs.containsKey('package_name') &&
                                              nm.isNotEmpty) {
                                            cs['package_name']!.text = nm;
                                          }
                                          if (cs.containsKey('total_price') &&
                                              pr.isNotEmpty) {
                                            cs['total_price']!.text =
                                                _fmtMoney(pr);
                                          }
                                          if (cs.containsKey(
                                                  'coverage_hours') &&
                                              hrs.isNotEmpty) {
                                            cs['coverage_hours']!.text = hrs;
                                          }
                                          if (cs.containsKey(
                                                  'package_description') &&
                                              inc.isNotEmpty) {
                                            cs['package_description']!.text =
                                                inc;
                                          }
                                          setSheet(() {});
                                        }),
                                      ),
                                    ))
                                .toList(),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      ],
                      Expanded(
                        child: LayoutBuilder(
                            builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints lb) {
                          final bool two = lb.maxWidth >= 560;
                          return SingleChildScrollView(
                            child: Wrap(
                              spacing: 12,
                              runSpacing: 12,
                              children: fields.map((String f) {
                                final bool isDate = f.endsWith('_date');
                                final bool wide = f == '__venue' ||
                                    f.contains('description') ||
                                    f.contains('includes') ||
                                    f.contains('address') ||
                                    f.contains('notes');
                                final bool money = f.contains('price') ||
                                    f.contains('amount') ||
                                    f.contains('fee');
                                return SizedBox(
                                  width: (two && !wide)
                                      ? (lb.maxWidth - 12) / 2
                                      : lb.maxWidth,
                                  child: TextField(
                                    controller: cs[f],
                                    readOnly: isDate,
                                    minLines: wide && !isDate ? 4 : 1,
                                    maxLines: wide && !isDate ? 10 : 1,
                                    keyboardType: wide && !isDate
                                        ? TextInputType.multiline
                                        : TextInputType.text,
                                    textCapitalization:
                                        TextCapitalization.sentences,
                                    onChanged: (String _) => setSheet(() {}),
                                    onTap: isDate
                                        ? () async {
                                            await _pickContractDate(cs[f]!);
                                            setSheet(() {});
                                          }
                                        : null,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 13.5, color: ink),
                                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                                      labelText: _fieldLabel(f),
                                      alignLabelWithHint: wide,
                                      helperText: (f.contains('description') ||
                                              f.contains('includes'))
                                          ? 'One item per line \u2014 they appear as a list in the contract'
                                          : null,
                                      helperStyle: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 10.5, color: muted),
                                      helperMaxLines: 2,
                                      prefixText: money ? '\u0024 ' : null,
                                      prefixStyle: const TextStyle(
                                          color: plum,
                                          fontSize: 13.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                                      hintText: f == '__venue'
                                          ? 'The Wrigley Mansion, 2501 E Telawa Trl, Phoenix, AZ'
                                          : (f.contains('description') ||
                                                  f.contains('includes'))
                                              ? '8 hours of coverage\nTwo photographers\n300+ edited images\nOnline gallery\nPrint release'
                                              : null,
                                      hintStyle: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11.5,
                                          color: Color(0xFFB9AEC0)),
                                      labelStyle: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 12, color: muted),
                                      isDense: true,
                                      filled: true,
                                      fillColor: Colors.white,
                                      suffixIcon: isDate
                                          ? const Icon(
                                              Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                                              color: plum,
                                              size: 18)
                                          : f == '__venue'
                                              ? IconButton(
                                                  tooltip: 'Search venues',
                                                  icon: const Icon(
                                                      Icons.search_rounded,
                                                      color: plum,
                                                      size: 19),
                                                  onPressed: _h(() async {
                                                    await _venueSearchSheet(
                                                        cs[f]!);
                                                    setSheet(() {});
                                                  }),
                                                )
                                              : null,
                                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                        borderSide: BorderSide(
                                            color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                                      ),
                                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                        borderSide: BorderSide(
                                            color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }).toList(),
                            ),
                          );
                        }),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Builder(builder: (BuildContext bctx) {
                        final int remaining = cs.values
                            .where((TextEditingController c2) =>
                                c2.text.trim().isEmpty)
                            .length;
                        final bool ready = remaining == 0;
                        return SizedBox(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          child: FilledButton.icon(
                            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                backgroundColor:
                                    ready ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.45),
                                foregroundColor: plum,
                                padding:
                                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14))),
                            onPressed: _h((generating || !ready)
                                ? null
                                : () async {
                                    setSheet(() => generating = true);
                                    final Map<String, String> vals =
                                        <String, String>{};
                                    cs.forEach(
                                        (String k, TextEditingController c2) {
                                      final String tv = c2.text.trim();
                                      if (tv.isEmpty) {
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      if (k == '__venue') {
                                        final int ci = tv.indexOf(',');
                                        if (ci > 0) {
                                          vals['venue_name'] =
                                              tv.substring(0, ci).trim();
                                          vals['venue_address'] =
                                              tv.substring(ci + 1).trim();
                                        } else {
                                          vals['venue_name'] = tv;
                                          vals['venue_address'] = tv;
                                        }
                                      } else {
                                        vals[k] = tv;
                                      }
                                    });
                                    try {
                                      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions
                                          .instance
                                          .httpsCallable('generateContract',
                                              options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                                  timeout: const Duration(
                                                      seconds: 120)));
                                      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
                                          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                                        'vendorId': vendorId,
                                        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                                        'templateId': templateId,
                                        'values': vals,
                                      });
                                      final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                          Map<String, dynamic>.from(
                                              out.data as Map);
                                      if (!ctx2.mounted) {
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                      _contractDraftedSheet(
                                          vendorId, inquiryId, r);
                                    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                      setSheet(() => generating = false);
                                      _toast(e.message ??
                                          'Could not generate - try again.');
                                    } catch (_) {
                                      setSheet(() => generating = false);
                                      _toast('Could not generate - try again.');
                                    }
                                  }),
                            icon: generating
                                ? const SizedBox(
                                    width: 16,
                                    height: 16,
                                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                        strokeWidth: 2, color: plum))
                                : const Icon(Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                                    size: 18),
                            label: Text(
                                generating
                                    ? 'Generating\u2026'
                                    : ready
                                        ? 'Generate contract'
                                        : remaining == 1
                                            ? '1 field left'
                                            : '$remaining fields left',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          ),
                        );
                      }),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _sendForSignature(
      String vendorId, String inquiryId, String contractId) async {
    if (contractId.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final bool? go = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Text('Send for signature?',
            style: TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: const Text(
            'The couple gets the contract in their thread and by email, and signs electronically. You\u2019ll see it flip to SIGNED here the moment they do.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: ink)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: vGreen, foregroundColor: ivory),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), _Tick.medium),
              child: const Text('Send')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (go != true) {
      return;
    }
    _toast('Sending for signature\u2026');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'sendContractForSignature',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 120)));
      await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'contractId': contractId,
      });
      _toast('Sent \u2713 The couple can now review and sign.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not send - try again.');
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not send - try again.');
    }
  }

  void _contractDraftedSheet(
      String vendorId, String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> r) {
    final String pdfPath = (r['pdfPath'] ?? '') as String;
    final List<String> missing = r['missingFields'] is List
        ? (r['missingFields'] as List).map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).toList()
        : <String>[];
    final bool usedProposal = r['usedProposal'] == true;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 22, 22, 30),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(children: const <Widget>[
              Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: vGreen, size: 22),
              SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text('Contract drafted',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: plum, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
                usedProposal
                    ? 'Package and price pulled from your proposal in this thread.'
                    : 'No proposal found - package details came from what you entered.',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
            if (missing.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                  '${missing.length} unfilled: ${missing.join(', ')} - these appear as blank lines in the PDF.',
                  style:
                      const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F))),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            if (missing.isEmpty)
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: FilledButton.icon(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: vGreen,
                      foregroundColor: ivory,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                  onPressed: _h(() {
                    final String cid = (r['contractId'] ?? '') as String;
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _sendForSignature(vendorId, inquiryId, cid);
                  }, _Tick.medium),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 18),
                  label: const Text('Send for signature',
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              ),
            if (missing.isEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 8),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: plum,
                    side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                onPressed: _h(
                    pdfPath.isEmpty ? null : () => _openContractPdf(pdfPath)),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded, size: 18),
                label: const Text('View PDF',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
              ),
            ),
            if (missing.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                  'Fill the blank fields and generate again to enable sending.',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Timer? _presenceTimer;
  int _lastTypingStampMs = 0;

  void _stampPresence(String inquiryId, String field) {
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .doc(inquiryId)
        .set(<String, dynamic>{
      field: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  void _stampTyping(String inquiryId, String field) {
    final int now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    if (now - _lastTypingStampMs < 3000) {
      return;
    }
    _lastTypingStampMs = now;
    _stampPresence(inquiryId, field);
  }

  Widget _presenceLine(String inquiryId, String otherRole) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadDocLatest(inquiryId),
      stream: _threadDocStream(inquiryId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final Timestamp? act = m['${otherRole}ActiveAt'] as Timestamp?;
        final Timestamp? typ = m['${otherRole}TypingAt'] as Timestamp?;
        final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
        final bool typing =
            typ != null && now.difference(typ.toDate()).inSeconds < 7;
        final bool active =
            act != null && now.difference(act.toDate()).inSeconds < 120;
        if (!typing && !active) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
          Container(
            width: 7,
            height: 7,
            decoration:
                const BoxDecoration(color: vGreen, shape: BoxShape.circle),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
          Text(typing ? 'typing…' : 'Active now',
              style: const TextStyle(
                  color: vGreen, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // v138: a proposal is the first thing a couple sees with a number on it.

            await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('vendors')
                .doc(vendorId)
