        final Map<String, dynamic> vd = vs.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        packs = (vd['packages'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
        bizName = (vd['name'] ?? '').toString();
      }
    } catch (_) {/* packages are a shortcut, never a gate */}

    final TextEditingController priceC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController incC = TextEditingController();

                                color: plum.withOpacity(.2),

                                ),
                                Text(_invMoney(price),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: gold,
                                        fontSize: 20,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              ]),
                              if (incC.text.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                ...incC.text
                                    .split('\n')
                                    .where((String l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty)
                                    .take(6)
                                    .map((String l) => Padding(
                                          padding:
                                              const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                                          child: Row(
                                              crossAxisAlignment:
                                                  CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                              children: <Widget>[
                                                Text('\u2022  ',
                                                    style: TextStyle(
                                                        color: gold
                                                            .withOpacity(.9),
                                                        fontSize: 12)),
                                                Expanded(
                                                  child: Text(l.trim(),
                                                      style: TextStyle(
                                                          color: ivory
                                                              .withOpacity(.9),
                                                          fontSize: 12,
                                                          height: 1.35)),
                                                ),
                                              ]),
                                        )),
                              ],
                              if (holdUntil != null) ...<Widget>[
                                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                Text(
                                    'Held for you through ${holdUntil!.month}/${holdUntil!.day}',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: gold.withOpacity(.9),
                                        fontSize: 10.5,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              ],
                            ]),
                      ),
                      if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Container(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFFBEAEA),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border:
                                  Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD9A0A0))),
                          child: Text(err,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFF7C2B2B), fontSize: 12)),
                        ),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: FilledButton(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold,
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14)),
                          onPressed: _h(
                              sending
                                  ? null
                                  : () async {
                                      if (titleC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                                        setS(() =>
                                            err = 'Give the proposal a name.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      if (price <= 0) {
                                        setS(() => err = 'Add a price.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      setS(() {
                                        sending = true;
                                        err = '';
                                      });
                                      try {
                                        final List<String> inc = incC.text
                                            .split('\n')
                                            .map((String s) => s.trim())
                                            .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
                                            .toList();
                                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                            .collection('inquiries')
                                            .doc(inquiryId)
                                            .collection('proposals')
                                            .add(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'title': titleC.text.trim(),
                                          'price': price,
                                          'note': noteC.text.trim(),
                                          'includes': inc,
                                          'validUntil': holdUntil == null
                                              ? null
                                              : Timestamp.fromDate(holdUntil!),
                                          'status': 'sent',
                                          'createdAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                        });
                                        await _sendVendorMessage(
                                            inquiryId,
                                            noteC.text.trim().isEmpty
                                                ? 'I\u2019ve put together a proposal for you \u2014 ${titleC.text.trim()}, ${_invMoney(price)}. It\u2019s just above.'
                                                : noteC.text.trim(),
                                            'responded');
                                        if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                        _toast('Proposal sent \u2713');
                                      } catch (e) {
                                        setS(() {
                                          sending = false;
                                          err =
                                              'Could not send: ' + _errText(e);
                                        });
                                      }
                                    },
                              _Tick.medium),
                          child: Text(
                              sending ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send proposal',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  String _invMoney(num v) {
    final String s = v.round().toString();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) {
        b.write(',');
      }
      b.write(s[i]);
    }
    return '\$$b';
  }

  // v140: only offer a tool to the crafts that actually do that work.
  // A DJ has no gallery to cull; a florist has no teaser film.
  List<String> _vendorCatsCache = const <String>[];

  bool _isPhoto() => _vendorCatsCache.contains('wedding-photographers');
  bool _isVideo() => _vendorCatsCache.contains('wedding-videographers');
  bool _delivers() => _isPhoto() || _isVideo();

  Future<void> _loadVendorCats(String vendorId) async {
    if (vendorId.isEmpty || _vendorCatsCache.isNotEmpty) return;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .get();
      final List<dynamic> cats =
          (vs.data()?['categories'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
      _vendorCatsCache =
          cats.map((dynamic c) => c.toString()).toList(growable: false);
      if (mounted && _vendorCatsCache.isNotEmpty) {
        setState(() {});
      }
    } catch (_) {/* absence just means the extra rows stay hidden */}
  }

  Future<String?> _juneStudioCall(
      String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> payload) async {
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneStudio',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 60)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId, ...payload});
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      return (r['reply'] ?? r['draft'] ?? '').toString();
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if ((e.message ?? '').contains('studio-required')) {
        return '__STUDIO_REQUIRED__';
      }
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _juneDraftReply(
      String vendorId, String inquiryId, TextEditingController msgC) async {
    _showJuneVeil('June is reading the thread\u2026',
        'She\u2019ll draft the reply \u2014 you edit and send.');
    final String? draft = await _juneStudioCall(vendorId,
        <String, dynamic>{'mode': 'draftReply', 'inquiryId': inquiryId});
    _popJuneVeil();
    if (draft == '__STUDIO_REQUIRED__') {
      _toast('June for Studio is a Pro Studio feature.');
      _upgradeSheet(vendorId);
      return;
    }
    if (draft == null || draft.isEmpty) {
      _toast('June couldn\u2019t draft that one \u2014 try again.');
      return;
    }
    msgC.text = draft;
    _toast('Draft ready \u2014 edit and send \u2713');
  }

      builder: (BuildContext ctx) {
        final TextEditingController inC = TextEditingController();
        return StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setJ) {
          Future<void> send(String text) async {
            final String t = text.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty || _juneStudioBusy) {
              return;
            }
            inC.clear();
            setJ(() {
              _juneStudioMsgs
                  .add(<String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': t});
              _juneStudioBusy = true;
            });
            final String? reply =
                await _juneStudioCall(vendorId, <String, dynamic>{
              'mode': 'chat',
              'messages': _juneStudioMsgs,
            });
            setJ(() {
              _juneStudioBusy = false;
              if (reply == '__STUDIO_REQUIRED__') {
                _juneStudioMsgs.add(<String, String>{
                  'role': 'assistant',
                  'content':
                      'June for Studio comes with the Pro Studio plan \u2014 upgrade from the Studio tab and I\u2019m all yours.'

                _juneStudioMsgs.add(<String, String>{

      },
    );
  }

  num _moneyNum(dynamic v) {
    final RegExpMatch? m =
        RegExp(r'([0-9][0-9,]*\.?[0-9]*)').firstMatch((v ?? '').toString());
    if (m == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    return num.tryParse(m.group(1)!.replaceAll(',', '')) ?? 0;
  }

  static const String _kInvoicePdfBase =
      'https://us-central1-lazo-513ec.cloudfunctions.net/invoicePdf';

  Future<void> _invoiceComposeSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    // Atavia principle: the system already knows - never ask twice.
    // A signed contract prefills the balance; the retainer chip knows too.
    String prefTitle = 'Wedding balance';
    String prefLabel = '';
    num prefBalance = 0;
    num prefRetainer = 0;
    String prefPkg = '';
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('contracts')
          .where('status', isEqualTo: 'signed')
          .get();
      if (cs.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ds =
            cs.docs.toList()
              ..sort((a, b) {
                final Timestamp ta = a.data()['signedAt'] is Timestamp
                    ? a.data()['signedAt'] as Timestamp
                    : Timestamp(0, 0);
                final Timestamp tb = b.data()['signedAt'] is Timestamp
                    ? b.data()['signedAt'] as Timestamp
                    : Timestamp(0, 0);
                return tb.compareTo(ta);
              });
        final Map<String, dynamic> vals = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
            (ds.first.data()['values'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
        final num total = _moneyNum(
            vals['total_price'] ?? vals['total'] ?? vals['total_fee']);
        final num retainer = _moneyNum(vals['retainer'] ??
            vals['retainer_amount'] ??
            vals['deposit'] ??
            vals['deposit_amount']);
        prefPkg = (vals['package_name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (total > 0) {
          prefRetainer = retainer;
          prefBalance =
              (retainer > 0 && retainer < total) ? total - retainer : total;
          prefLabel = prefPkg.isEmpty
              ? 'Remaining balance'
              : '$prefPkg \u2014 remaining balance';
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {/* prefill is a gift, never a gate */}

    if (!mounted) return;
    const Color ink = Color(0xFF241E2B);
    final TextEditingController titleC = TextEditingController(text: prefTitle);
    final List<Map<String, TextEditingController>> items =
        <Map<String, TextEditingController>>[
      <String, TextEditingController>{
        'label': TextEditingController(text: prefLabel),
        'amount': TextEditingController(
            text: prefBalance > 0 ? prefBalance.toString() : ''),
      }
    ];
    DateTime? due;
    bool sending = false;
    String errMsg = '';

    InputDecoration deco(String hint) => InputDecoration(
          hintText: hint,
          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13.5),
          filled: true,
          fillColor: Colors.white,
          contentPadding:
              const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 12),
          border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.4)),
        );

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx2) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
          num total = 0;
          for (final Map<String, TextEditingController> it in items) {
            total +=
                num.tryParse(it['amount']!.text.replaceAll(',', '').trim()) ??
                    0;
          }
          return Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
              child: Container(
                margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                    bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 12, 22, 24),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                  color: ivory,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26)),
                ),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Center(
                        child: Container(
                            width: 44,
                            height: 4,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: plum.withOpacity(.2),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99))),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 38,
                          height: 38,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                  colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7))),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                              color: gold, size: 19),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 11),
                        Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: const <Widget>[
                              Text('Send an invoice',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: ink,
                                      fontSize: 18,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              Text(
                                  'It lands in the thread \u2014 and as a beautiful PDF.',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: Color(0xFF8A7F90),
                                      fontSize: 11.5)),
                            ]),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                        _invChip(sc, 'Retainer', prefRetainer > 0, () {
                          setSheet(() {
                            titleC.text = 'Booking retainer';
                            items[0]['label']!.text =
                                'Retainer \u2014 due at signing';
                            items[0]['amount']!.text = prefRetainer.toString();
                          });
                        }),
                        _invChip(sc, 'Balance', prefBalance > 0, () {
                          setSheet(() {
                            titleC.text = 'Wedding balance';
                            items[0]['label']!.text = prefLabel.isEmpty
                                ? 'Remaining balance'
                                : prefLabel;
                            items[0]['amount']!.text = prefBalance.toString();
                          });
                        }),
                        _invChip(sc, 'Custom', true, () {
                          setSheet(() {
                            titleC.text = 'Invoice';
                            items[0]['label']!.text = '';
                            items[0]['amount']!.text = '';
                          });
                        }),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      TextField(
                          controller: titleC,
                          style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                          decoration: deco('Invoice title')),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      ...items.asMap().entries.map((e) {
                        final int ix = e.key;
                        return Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 9),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            Expanded(
                              flex: 5,
                              child: TextField(
                                  controller: e.value['label'],
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                  decoration: deco('What is this for?')),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Expanded(
                              flex: 2,
                              child: TextField(
                                  controller: e.value['amount'],
                                  keyboardType:
                                      const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                                          decimal: true),
                                  onChanged: (_) => setSheet(() {}),
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink,
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                                  decoration: deco('\u0024')),
                            ),
                            if (items.length > 1)
                              IconButton(
                                  onPressed: _h(
                                      () => setSheet(() => items.removeAt(ix))),
                                  icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                      color: ink.withOpacity(.4), size: 18)),
                          ]),
                        );
                      }),
                      TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _h(() => setSheet(() {
                              items.add(<String, TextEditingController>{
                                'label': TextEditingController(),
                                'amount': TextEditingController(),
                              });
                            })),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded,
                            color: plum, size: 17),
                        label: const Text('Add a line',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: plum,
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
                        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                          const Text('Total',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: ink,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          const Spacer(),
                          Text(
                              '\u0024' +
                                  total.toStringAsFixed(total % 1 == 0 ? 0 : 2),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 19,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ]),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        const Text('Due',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: ink,
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        _invChip(sc, 'Upon receipt', due == null,
                            () => setSheet(() => due = null),
                            selected: due == null),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        SizedBox(
                          width: 132,
                          child: _invChip(
                              sc,
                              due == null
                                  ? 'Pick a date'
                                  : '${due!.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${due!.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${due!.year}',
                              true, () async {
                            final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                                context: sc,
                                initialDate: due ??
                                    DateTime.now()
                                        .add(const Duration(days: 14)),
                                firstDate: DateTime.now(),
                                lastDate: DateTime.now()
                                    .add(const Duration(days: 730)));
                            if (d != null) setSheet(() => due = d);
                          }, selected: due != null),
                        ),
                      ]),
                      if (errMsg.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Container(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFFBEAEA),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border:
                                  Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD9A0A0))),
                          child: Text(errMsg,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFF7C2B2B), fontSize: 12)),
                        ),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: FilledButton(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold,
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14)),
                          onPressed: _h(
                              sending
                                  ? null

                                      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> lines =
                                          <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
                                      num t2 = 0;
                                      for (final Map<String,
                                          TextEditingController> it in items) {
                                        final String lb =
                                            it['label']!.text.trim();
                                        final num? am = num.tryParse(
                                            it['amount']!
                                                .text
                                                .replaceAll(',', '')
                                                .trim());
                                        if (lb.isEmpty || am == null) continue;
                                        lines.add(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'label': lb,
                                          'amount': am
                                        });
                                        t2 += am;
                                      }
                                      if (lines.isEmpty || t2 <= 0) {
                                        setSheet(() => errMsg =
                                            'Add at least one line with an amount.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      setSheet(() {
                                        sending = true;
                                        errMsg = '';
                                      });
                                      try {
                                        final DocumentReference<
                                                Map<String, dynamic>> ref =
                                            FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                                .collection('inquiries')
                                                .doc(inquiryId)
                                                .collection('invoices')
                                                .doc();
                                        await ref.set(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'vendorId': inq['vendorId'],
                                          'coupleUid': inq['coupleUid'],
                                          'title': titleC.text.trim().isEmpty
                                              ? 'Invoice'
                                              : titleC.text.trim(),
                                          'lineItems': lines,
                                          'total': t2,
                                          'dueDate': due == null
                                              ? null
                                              : Timestamp.fromDate(due!),
                                          'status': 'sent',
                                          'createdAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                          'sentAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                        });
                                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                            .collection('inquiries')
                                            .doc(inquiryId)
                                            .set(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'invoiceStatus': 'sent',
                                          'invoiceUpdatedAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                          'lastInvoiceId': ref.id,
                                        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                        if (ctx2.mounted) {
                                          Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                        }
                                        if (mounted) {
                                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
                                              .showSnackBar(SnackBar(
                                            backgroundColor: ivory,
                                            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                                borderRadius:
                                                    BorderRadius.circular(14),
                                                side: BorderSide(
                                                    color:
                                                        gold.withOpacity(.55))),
                                            content: const Text(
                                                'Invoice sent \u2014 it\u2019s in the thread.',
                                                style: TextStyle(
                                                    color: ink,
                                                    fontWeight:
                                                        FontWeight.w600)),
                                            action: SnackBarAction(
                                              label: 'View PDF',
                                              textColor: plum,
                                              // SnackBarAction wants a non-null callback
                                              onPressed: _h(() => _openUrl(
                                                  '$_kInvoicePdfBase?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=${ref.id}'))!,
                                            ),
                                          ));
                                        }
                                      } catch (e) {
                                        setSheet(() {
                                          sending = false;
                                          errMsg = 'Could not send \u2014 $e';
                                        });
                                      }
                                    },
                              _Tick.medium),
                          child: Text(
                              sending ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send invoice',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _invChip(
      BuildContext c, String label, bool enabled, VoidCallback onTap,
      {bool selected = false}) {
    return _Press(
      tick: _Tick.select,
      enabled: enabled,
      onTap: enabled ? onTap : null,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected ? plum : Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(
              color: selected ? plum : plum.withOpacity(enabled ? .35 : .12)),
        ),
        child: Text(label,
            style: TextStyle(
                color: selected
                    ? ivory
                    : const Color(0xFF241E2B).withOpacity(enabled ? .85 : .35),
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v138: manual settle - Venmo, Zelle, cash, whatever the couple used.
  // Writes the same fields the card rails write, so booked / review / stats
  // logic downstream treats every payment the same.
  Future<void> _markInvoicePaid(String inquiryId,
      DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> invoiceRef) async {
    final List<String> methods = <String>[
      'Venmo',
      'Cash App',
      'PayPal',
      'Zelle',
      'Authorize.net',
      'Check',
      'Cash',
      'Other'
    ];
    String method = methods.first;
    final bool? go = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('How did they pay?',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          content: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            const Text(
                'This records a payment you already received \u2014 nobody gets charged.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 6,
              runSpacing: 6,
              children: methods.map((String m2) {
                final bool sel = method == m2;
                return ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(m2,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          color: sel ? ivory : plum,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  selected: sel,
                  selectedColor: plum,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                  side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                  onSelected: _hb((_) => setD(() => method = m2)),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ]),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false)),
              child: const Text('Cancel',
                  style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true)),
              child: const Text('Mark paid',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (go != true) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await invoiceRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': 'paid',
        'paidAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'paidVia': method,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'invoiceStatus': 'paid',
        'invoiceUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Marked paid \u2713');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not mark paid: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }
