  Future<void> _connectWhopSheet(String vendorId) async {
    String installUrl = '';
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('whopVendorConnect');
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      installUrl = ((r.data as Map?)?['installUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not reach Whop: ' + _errText(e));
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    final TextEditingController bizC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx2) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
          Widget step(int n, String title, String body, Widget action) {
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55))),
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Container(
                          width: 24,
                          height: 24,
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              color: plum, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                          child: Text('$n',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: gold,
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                      const SizedBox(width: 9),
                      Text(title,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: ink,
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(body,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    action,
                  ]),
            );
          }

          return Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
              child: Container(
                margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                    bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 12, 22, 24),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: ivory,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Center(
                          child: Container(
                              width: 44,
                              height: 4,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: plum.withOpacity(.2),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99)))),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      const Text('Get paid through Whop',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ink,
                              fontSize: 18,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      const Text('Two steps. Your money never touches Lazo.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFF8A7F90), fontSize: 11.5)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      step(
                          1,
                          'Install the Lazo Payments app',
                          'Opens Whop. Sign in (or make a business - it takes a couple of minutes and Whop handles the identity check) and install the app on it.',
                          OutlinedButton.icon(
                            onPressed: _h(installUrl.isEmpty
                                ? null
                                : () => _openUrl(installUrl)),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                                size: 15, color: plum),
                            label: const Text('Open Whop',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: plum,
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                                side: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.5)),
                                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                          )),
                      step(
                          2,
                          'Paste your business id',
                          'It is in your Whop dashboard address bar and starts with biz_. We check the install and switch you over.',
                          Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                TextField(
                                  controller: bizC,
                                  style:
                                      const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                                    hintText: 'biz_xxxxxxxxxxxx',
                                    hintStyle: TextStyle(
                                        color: ink.withOpacity(.35),
                                        fontSize: 13.5),
                                    filled: true,
                                    fillColor: ivory,
                                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                        horizontal: 13, vertical: 12),
                                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                        borderSide: BorderSide(
                                            color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
                                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                        borderSide: BorderSide(
                                            color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
                                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                        borderSide: const BorderSide(
                                            color: plum, width: 1.4)),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                if (err.isNotEmpty)
                                  Padding(
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                                    child: Text(err,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                            color: Color(0xFFB04343),
                                            fontSize: 12)),
                                  ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                ElevatedButton(
                                  onPressed: _h(busy
                                      ? null
                                      : () async {
                                          final String biz = bizC.text.trim();
                                          if (!biz.startsWith('biz_')) {
                                            setSheet(() => err =
                                                'That should start with biz_');
                                            return;
                                          }
                                          setSheet(() {
                                            busy = true;
                                            err = '';
                                          });
                                          try {
                                            final HttpsCallable fn =
                                                FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                                    .httpsCallable(
                                                        'whopVendorConnect');
                                            await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                                              'vendorId': vendorId,
                                              'companyId': biz,
                                            });
                                            if (ctx2.mounted) {
                                              Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                            }
                                            _toast(
                                                'Whop is on. New invoices settle in your balance.');
                                          } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                            setSheet(() {
                                              busy = false;
                                              err = e.message ??
                                                  'Whop did not confirm the install.';
                                            });
                                          } catch (e) {
                                            setSheet(() {
                                              busy = false;
                                              err = _errText(e);
                                            });
                                          }
                                        }),
                                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                      backgroundColor: plum,
                                      elevation: 0,
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          horizontal: 18, vertical: 12),
                                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                                  child: Text(
                                      busy ? 'Checking\u2026' : 'Turn on Whop',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: Colors.white,
                                          fontSize: 13,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                ),
                              ])),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _disconnectWhop(String vendorId) async {
    _showJuneVeil(
        'Turning Whop off\u2026', 'Stripe or Square takes over if connected.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('whopVendorDisconnect');
      await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Whop is off.');
    } catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not turn Whop off: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _copyBookingLink(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    _showJuneVeil(
        'Making the link\u2026', 'One page for everything they owe you.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('fileLink');
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'vendorId': (inq['vendorId'] ?? '') as String,
      });
      final String url = ((r.data as Map?)?['url'] ?? '').toString();
      _popJuneVeil();
      if (url.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Could not make the link.');
        return;
      }
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
      _toast('Booking link copied - paste it anywhere, no login needed.');
    } catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not make the link: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  // The plan composer. Presets are built from the contract total when a
  // signed contract exists (never ask twice), otherwise from what is typed.
  Future<void> _paymentPlanSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    num prefTotal = 0;
    num prefRetainer = 0;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('contracts')
          .where('status', isEqualTo: 'signed')
          .get();
      if (cs.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> vals = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
            (cs.docs.first.data()['values'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
        prefTotal = _moneyNum(
            vals['total_price'] ?? vals['total'] ?? vals['total_fee']);
        prefRetainer = _moneyNum(vals['retainer'] ??
            vals['retainer_amount'] ??
            vals['deposit'] ??
            vals['deposit_amount']);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (prefTotal <= 0) {
      try {
        final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ps = await FirebaseFirestore
            .instance
            .collection('inquiries')
            .doc(inquiryId)
            .collection('proposals')
            .where('status', isEqualTo: 'accepted')
            .get();
        if (ps.docs.isNotEmpty) {
          prefTotal = _moneyNum(ps.docs.first.data()['price']);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    DateTime? wedding;
    try {
      final String raw =
          ((inq['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['weddingDate'] ?? '').toString();
      if (raw.isNotEmpty) wedding = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!mounted) return;

    const Color ink = Color(0xFF241E2B);
    final TextEditingController totalC = TextEditingController(
        text: prefTotal > 0 ? prefTotal.round().toString() : '');
    final TextEditingController titleC =
        TextEditingController(text: 'Payment plan');
    final TextEditingController feeC = TextEditingController(text: '25');
    final TextEditingController graceC = TextEditingController(text: '3');
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    String preset = '';
    String feeType = 'none'; // none | flat | pct
    String feeEvery = 'once';
    String autopay = 'optional';
    bool tips = true;
    bool sending = false;
    String err = '';

    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    DateTime endDate() {
      final DateTime fallback = today.add(const Duration(days: 180));
      if (wedding == null) return fallback;
      final DateTime d = wedding!.subtract(const Duration(days: 14));
      return d.isAfter(today.add(const Duration(days: 7))) ? d : fallback;
    }

    void buildPreset(String kind, num total) {
      rows.clear();
      final DateTime end = endDate();
      List<num> parts;
      List<String> labels;
      switch (kind) {
        case '50/50':
          parts = <num>[.5, .5];
          labels = <String>['Retainer', 'Final balance'];
          break;
        case '30/30/40':
          parts = <num>[.3, .3, .4];
          labels = <String>['Retainer', 'Second payment', 'Final balance'];
          break;
        case 'monthly':
          parts = <num>[];
          labels = <String>[];
          break;
        default:
          parts = <num>[1];
          labels = <String>['Payment'];
      }
      if (kind == 'monthly') {
        final int months =
            (end.difference(today).inDays / 30).floor().clamp(2, 12);
        final num ret = prefRetainer > 0 && prefRetainer < total
            ? prefRetainer
            : (total * .25).round();
        rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'label': TextEditingController(text: 'Retainer'),
          'amount': TextEditingController(text: ret.round().toString()),
          'due': today,
        });
        final num each = ((total - ret) / months).floor();
        num placed = ret;
        for (int i = 1; i <= months; i++) {
          final num amt = i == months ? (total - placed) : each;
          placed += amt;
          rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
            'label': TextEditingController(
                text: i == months ? 'Final balance' : 'Payment ${i + 1}'),
            'amount': TextEditingController(text: amt.round().toString()),
            'due': i == months
                ? end
                : DateTime(today.year, today.month + i, today.day),
          });
        }
        return;
      }
      num placed = 0;
      for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        final bool last = i == parts.length - 1;
        num amt = last ? total - placed : (total * parts[i]).round();
        if (i == 0 &&
            prefRetainer > 0 &&
            prefRetainer < total &&
            parts.length > 1) {
          amt = prefRetainer;
        }
        placed += amt;
        DateTime due;
        if (i == 0) {
          due = today;
        } else if (last) {
          due = end;
        } else {
          final int span = end.difference(today).inDays;
          due = today
              .add(Duration(days: (span * i / (parts.length - 1)).round()));
        }
        rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'label': TextEditingController(text: labels[i]),
          'amount': TextEditingController(text: amt.round().toString()),
          'due': due,
        });
      }
    }

    if (prefTotal > 0) {
      preset = '50/50';
      buildPreset(preset, prefTotal);
    }

    InputDecoration deco(String hint) => InputDecoration(
          hintText: hint,
          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13.5),
          filled: true,
          fillColor: Colors.white,
          isDense: true,
          contentPadding:
              const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
          border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.4)),
        );

    String md(DateTime d) => '${d.month}/${d.day}/${d.year}';

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx2) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
          final num total =
              num.tryParse(totalC.text.replaceAll(',', '').trim()) ?? 0;
          num sum = 0;
          for (final Map<String, dynamic> r in rows) {
            sum += num.tryParse((r['amount'] as TextEditingController)
                    .text
                    .replaceAll(',', '')
                    .trim()) ??
                0;
          }
          final num drift = total - sum;

          Widget chip(String label, bool on, VoidCallback onTap) {
            return InkWell(
              onTap: onTap,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              child: Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: on ? plum : Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    border:
                        Border.all(color: on ? plum : plum.withOpacity(.25))),
                child: Text(label,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: on ? Colors.white : plum,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            );
          }

          Widget section(String t) => Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14, bottom: 7),
                child: Text(t.toUpperCase(),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: muted,
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        letterSpacing: 1.4,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              );

          return Center(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
              child: Container(
                margin: EdgeInsets.only(
                    bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 12, 22, 24),
                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                    color: ivory,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Center(
                          child: Container(
                              width: 44,
                              height: 4,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: plum.withOpacity(.2),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99)))),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 38,
                          height: 38,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                  colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7))),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                              color: gold, size: 19),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 11),
                        const Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Text('Set up a payment plan',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: ink,
                                        fontSize: 18,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                Text(
                                    'Each payment is its own invoice with a due date. Reminders go out three days before, on the day, and weekly after.',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: Color(0xFF8A7F90),
                                        fontSize: 11.5,
                                        height: 1.3)),
                              ]),
                        ),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                            flex: 3,
                            child: TextField(
                                controller: titleC,
                                style:
                                    const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                                decoration: deco('Plan title'))),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                            flex: 2,
                            child: TextField(
                                controller: totalC,
                                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                                onChanged: (_) => setSheet(() {
                                      if (preset.isNotEmpty) {
                                        final num t = num.tryParse(totalC.text
                                                .replaceAll(',', '')
                                                .trim()) ??
                                            0;
                                        if (t > 0) buildPreset(preset, t);
                                      }
                                    }),
                                style:
                                    const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                                decoration: deco('Total \u0024'))),
                      ]),
                      section('Schedule'),
                      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                        for (final String k in <String>[
                          '50/50',
                          '30/30/40',
                          'monthly'
                        ])
                          chip(
                              k == 'monthly'
                                  ? 'Monthly to ${wedding == null ? 'the date' : md(endDate())}'
                                  : k,
                              preset == k, () {
                            if (total <= 0) {
                              setSheet(() => err = 'Enter the total first.');
                              return;
                            }
                            setSheet(() {
                              err = '';
                              preset = k;
                              buildPreset(k, total);
                            });
                          }),
                        chip('Custom', preset == 'custom', () {
                          setSheet(() {
                            preset = 'custom';
                            if (rows.isEmpty) {
                              rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
                                'label':
                                    TextEditingController(text: 'Retainer'),
                                'amount': TextEditingController(),
                                'due': today,
                              });
                            }
                          });
                        }),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      ...rows
                          .asMap()
                          .entries
                          .map((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) {
                        final int i = e.key;
                        final Map<String, dynamic> r = e.value;
                        final DateTime due = r['due'] as DateTime;
                        return Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            Expanded(
                                flex: 5,
                                child: TextField(
                                    controller:
                                        r['label'] as TextEditingController,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                    decoration: deco('Label'))),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Expanded(
                                flex: 3,
                                child: TextField(
                                    controller:
                                        r['amount'] as TextEditingController,
                                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                                    onChanged: (_) =>
                                        setSheet(() => preset = 'custom'),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                    decoration: deco('\u0024'))),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            InkWell(
                              onTap: () async {
                                final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                                    context: sc,
                                    initialDate:
                                        due.isBefore(today) ? today : due,
                                    firstDate: today,
                                    lastDate:
                                        today.add(const Duration(days: 1095)));
                                if (d != null) {
                                  setSheet(() {
                                    r['due'] = DateTime(d.year, d.month, d.day);
                                    preset = 'custom';
                                  });
                                }
                              },
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 11, vertical: 11),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.white,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        color: plum.withOpacity(.18))),
                                child: Text(
                                    i == 0 && due == today ? 'Now' : md(due),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: plum,
                                        fontSize: 12.5,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (rows.length > 1)
                              InkWell(
                                onTap: () => setSheet(() {
                                  rows.removeAt(i);
                                  preset = 'custom';
                                }),
                                child: const Padding(
                                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(6),
                                  child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                      color: muted, size: 16),
                                ),
                              ),
                          ]),
                        );
                      }),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        TextButton.icon(
                          onPressed: _h(rows.length >= 24
                              ? null
                              : () => setSheet(() {
                                    preset = 'custom';
                                    rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
                                      'label': TextEditingController(
                                          text: 'Payment ${rows.length + 1}'),
                                      'amount': TextEditingController(),
                                      'due': endDate(),
                                    });
                                  })),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded,
                              size: 16, color: plum),
                          label: const Text('Add a payment',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                        const Spacer(),
                        Text(
                            total <= 0
                                ? ''
                                : drift.abs() <= 1
                                    ? 'Adds up to ${_invMoney(total)} \u2713'
                                    : drift > 0
                                        ? '${_invMoney(drift)} unassigned'
                                        : '${_invMoney(-drift)} over',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: drift.abs() <= 1
                                    ? vGreen
                                    : const Color(0xFFB04343),
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ]),
                      section('Late fee'),
                      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                        chip('None', feeType == 'none',
                            () => setSheet(() => feeType = 'none')),
                        chip('Flat \u0024', feeType == 'flat',
                            () => setSheet(() => feeType = 'flat')),
                        chip('% of total', feeType == 'pct',
                            () => setSheet(() => feeType = 'pct')),
                      ]),
                      if (feeType != 'none') ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        Row(children: <Widget>[
                          SizedBox(
                              width: 96,
                              child: TextField(
                                  controller: feeC,
                                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                  decoration:
                                      deco(feeType == 'pct' ? '%' : '\u0024'))),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          const Text('after',
                              style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12.5)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          SizedBox(
                              width: 64,
                              child: TextField(
                                  controller: graceC,
                                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                                  decoration: deco('days'))),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          const Text('days,',
                              style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12.5)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          chip('once', feeEvery == 'once',
                              () => setSheet(() => feeEvery = 'once')),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          chip('every week', feeEvery == 'weekly',
                              () => setSheet(() => feeEvery = 'weekly')),
                        ]),
                      ],
                      section('Paying'),
                      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                        chip('Autopay optional', autopay == 'optional',
                            () => setSheet(() => autopay = 'optional')),
                        chip('Autopay required', autopay == 'required',
                            () => setSheet(() => autopay = 'required')),
                        chip('No autopay', autopay == 'off',
                            () => setSheet(() => autopay = 'off')),
                        chip(tips ? 'Tips on' : 'Tips off', tips,
                            () => setSheet(() => tips = !tips)),
                      ]),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      const Text(
                          'Autopay today means the pay link lands in their thread and inbox on the due date - one tap. Card-on-file charging follows once Whop confirms it.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10.5, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                      if (err.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                          child: Text(err,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFFB04343), fontSize: 12)),
                        ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: _h(
                              sending
                                  ? null
                                  : () async {
                                      if (total <= 0) {
                                        setSheet(
                                            () => err = 'Enter the total.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      if (rows.isEmpty) {
                                        setSheet(() => err =
                                            'Pick a schedule or add a payment.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      if (drift.abs() > 1) {
                                        setSheet(() => err =
                                            'The payments need to add up to the total.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      setSheet(() {
                                        sending = true;
                                        err = '';
                                      });
                                      try {
                                        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> sched =
                                            rows.map((Map<String, dynamic> r) {
                                          final DateTime d =
                                              r['due'] as DateTime;
                                          return <String, dynamic>{
                                            'label': (r['label']
                                                    as TextEditingController)
                                                .text
                                                .trim(),
                                            'amount': num.tryParse((r['amount']
                                                        as TextEditingController)
                                                    .text
                                                    .replaceAll(',', '')
                                                    .trim()) ??
                                                0,
                                            'dueDate':
                                                '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
                                          };
                                        }).toList();
                                        final HttpsCallable fn =
                                            FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                                .httpsCallable('planCreate');
                                        await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                                          'vendorId':
                                              (inq['vendorId'] ?? '') as String,
                                          'title': titleC.text.trim(),
                                          'total': total,
                                          'schedule': sched,
                                          'lateFee': feeType == 'none'
                                              ? null
                                              : <String, dynamic>{
                                                  'type': feeType,
                                                  'amount': num.tryParse(
                                                          feeC.text.trim()) ??
                                                      0,
                                                  'graceDays': int.tryParse(
                                                          graceC.text.trim()) ??
                                                      0,
                                                  'every': feeEvery,
                                                },
                                          'tipAllowed': tips,
                                          'autopay': autopay,
                                        });
                                        if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                        _toast(
                                            'Payment plan is out - every payment is in the thread.');
                                      } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                        setSheet(() {
                                          sending = false;
                                          err = e.message ??
                                              'Could not create the plan.';
                                        });
                                      } catch (e) {
                                        setSheet(() {
                                          sending = false;
                                          err = _errText(e);
                                        });
                                      }
                                    },
                              _Tick.medium),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: plum,
                              elevation: 0,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12))),
                          child: Text(
                              sending
                                  ? 'Sending\u2026'
                                  : rows.isEmpty
                                      ? 'Send the plan'
                                      : 'Send ${rows.length} payment${rows.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _leadSourceStrip(String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    if (inq['offPlatform'] != true) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final Map<String, dynamic> c = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (inq['contact'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final Map<String, dynamic> src = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (inq['sourceRef'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final String phone = (c['phone'] ?? '').toString();
    final String email = (c['email'] ?? '').toString();
    final bool smsOk = c['smsOk'] != false && phone.isNotEmpty;
    String where = 'your website';
    final String page = (src['page'] ?? '').toString();
    try {
      if (page.isNotEmpty)
        where = Uri.parse(page).host.replaceFirst('www.', '');
    } catch (_) {}
    final String camp = (src['utm_source'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
        ? ''
        : ' \u00b7 ${src['utm_source']}${(src['utm_campaign'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ? '' : ' / ${src['utm_campaign']}'}';
    Widget chip(IconData i, String t, String copy) {
      return _Press(
        onTap: () async {
          await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: copy));
          _toast('Copied');
        },
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
          child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            Icon(i, size: 13, color: plum),
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
            Text(t,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ]),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 0),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: gold.withOpacity(.16),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Icon(Icons.language_rounded, size: 15, color: plum),
            const SizedBox(width: 7),
            Expanded(
              child: Text('From $where$camp',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: plum,
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Text(
              smsOk
                  ? 'No Lazo account yet - every reply you send here goes to them by text${email.isNotEmpty ? ' and email' : ''}, and their texts land in this thread.'
                  : email.isNotEmpty
                      ? 'No Lazo account yet - every reply you send here goes to them by email.'
                      : 'No Lazo account yet and no contact details - reply carefully.',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
          if (phone.isNotEmpty || email.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
              if (phone.isNotEmpty) chip(Icons.sms_rounded, phone, phone),
              if (email.isNotEmpty)
                chip(Icons.mail_outline_rounded, email, email),
            ]),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _leadFormSheet(String vendorId) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    Map<String, dynamic> form = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (vd['leadForm'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    String key = (form['key'] ?? '').toString();
    if (key.isEmpty) {
      key = _randomCode(20);
      form = <String, dynamic>{
        'key': key,
        'enabled': true,
        'redirect': '',
        'thanks': '',
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      try {
        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('vendors')
            .doc(vendorId)
            .set(<String, dynamic>{'leadForm': form}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } catch (e) {
        _toast('Could not create the form: ' + _errText(e));
        return;
      }
    }
    final String snippet =
        '<script src="https://meetlazo.com/embed/lead.js" data-vendor="$vendorId" data-key="$key"></script>';
    final String hosted = 'https://meetlazo.com/lead/$vendorId?k=$key';
    final TextEditingController redirectC =
        TextEditingController(text: (form['redirect'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController thanksC =
        TextEditingController(text: (form['thanks'] ?? '').toString());
    bool enabled = form['enabled'] != false;
    if (!mounted) return;

      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'leadForm': <String, dynamic>{
          'redirect': redirectC.text.trim(),
          'thanks': thanksC.text.trim(),
          'enabled': enabled,
        }
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    }
