  // ===================================================================
  // v162: PIPELINE, TAGS, TASKS
  // ===================================================================

  static const List<List<String>> _kBaseStages = <List<String>>[
    <String>['new', 'New'],
    <String>['talking', 'Talking'],
    <String>['booked', 'Booked'],
    <String>['delivered', 'Delivered'],
    <String>['lost', 'Lost'],
  ];
  static const Set<String> _kStatusStages = <String>{
    'booked',
    'delivered',
    'lost'
  };

  List<List<String>> _stagesFor(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<dynamic> custom = (vd['pipeline'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    final List<List<String>> out = <List<String>>[
      _kBaseStages[0],
      _kBaseStages[1],
    ];
    for (final dynamic c in custom) {
      if (c is Map && (c['key'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        out.add(
            <String>[c['key'].toString(), (c['label'] ?? c['key']).toString()]);
      }
    }
    out.addAll(_kBaseStages.sublist(2));
    return out;
  }

  String _stageOf(Map<String, dynamic> inq, List<List<String>> stages) {
    final String st = (inq['status'] ?? '').toString();
    if (st == 'lost') return 'lost';
    if (st == 'booked') {
      return inq['deliveredAt'] is Timestamp ? 'delivered' : 'booked';
    }
    final String explicit = (inq['stage'] ?? '').toString();
    if (explicit.isNotEmpty &&
        !_kStatusStages.contains(explicit) &&
        stages.any((List<String> s) => s[0] == explicit)) {
      return explicit;
    }
    if (st == 'responded' || st == 'replied') return 'talking';
    if ((inq['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor') return 'talking';
    return 'new';
  }

  Widget _pipelineMain(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<List<String>> stages = _stagesFor(vd);
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> all =
            _leadDocs(snap);
        final Set<String> tagUniverse = <String>{};
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in all) {
          for (final dynamic t
              in (d.data()['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
            tagUniverse.add(t.toString());
          }
        }
        final String q = _pipeSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs = all
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if (_pipeTag.isNotEmpty &&
              !((m['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]).contains(_pipeTag)) {
            return false;
          }
          if (q.isEmpty) return true;
          final String hay = [
            m['coupleName'],
            (m['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['venue'],
            (m['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['weddingDate'],
            ((m['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]).join(' '),
          ].map((dynamic e) => (e ?? '').toString().toLowerCase()).join(' ');
          return hay.contains(q);
        }).toList()
          ..sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
              QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
            final dynamic ta =
                a.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? a.data()['createdAt'];
            final dynamic tb =
                b.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? b.data()['createdAt'];
            if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) return tb.compareTo(ta);
            return 0;
          });
        final Map<String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>
            cols =
            <String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>{};
        for (final List<String> st in stages) {
          cols[st[0]] = <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        }
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          cols[_stageOf(d.data(), stages)]!.add(d);
        }

        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Text('Pipeline', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                const Spacer(),
                TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _h(() => _stagesSheet(vendorId, vd)),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, size: 15, color: plum),
                  label: const Text('Stages',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                  '${docs.length} thread${docs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} \u00b7 drag a card to move it \u00b7 tap to open',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    onChanged: (String v) => setState(() => _pipeSearch = v),
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'Search names, venues, dates, tags',
                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                          color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 12.5),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                          size: 17, color: muted),
                      isDense: true,
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: Colors.white,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 10, vertical: 9),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
                          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11),
                          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
              if (tagUniverse.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                  _tagChip('All', _pipeTag.isEmpty,
                      () => setState(() => _pipeTag = '')),
                  for (final String t in tagUniverse.toList()..sort())
                    _tagChip(
                        t,
                        _pipeTag == t,
                        () =>
                            setState(() => _pipeTag = _pipeTag == t ? '' : t)),
                ]),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              SizedBox(
                height: 560,
                child: ListView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final List<String> st in stages)
                      _pipeColumn(vendorId, st[0], st[1], cols[st[0]]!, stages),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _tagChip(String label, bool on, VoidCallback onTap, {Color? tint}) {
    final Color base = tint ?? plum;
    return _Press(
      tick: _Tick.select,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
        curve: Curves.easeOut,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: on ? base : base.withOpacity(.08),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
            border: Border.all(color: base.withOpacity(on ? 1 : .35))),
        child: Text(label,
            style: TextStyle(
                color: on ? Colors.white : base,
                fontSize: 10.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _pipeColumn(
      String vendorId,
      String key,
      String label,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> items,
      List<List<String>> stages) {
    final bool statusCol = _kStatusStages.contains(key);
    final Color head = key == 'booked'
        ? vGreen
        : key == 'lost'
            ? muted
            : key == 'delivered'
                ? plumDeep
                : plum;
    return DragTarget<String>(
      onWillAccept: (String? id) => id != null,
      onAccept: (String id) => _moveToStage(vendorId, id, key, statusCol),
      builder: (BuildContext c, List<String?> cand, List<dynamic> rej) {
        final bool hot = cand.isNotEmpty;
        return Container(
          width: 250,
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: hot ? gold.withOpacity(.18) : Colors.white.withOpacity(.55),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: hot ? gold : goldLine),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                    width: 8,
                    height: 8,
                    decoration:
                        BoxDecoration(color: head, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
                const SizedBox(width: 7),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(label,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: head,
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
                Text('${items.length}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: muted,
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: items.isEmpty
                    ? Center(
                        child: Text(
                            statusCol
                                ? 'Drop here to update status'
                                : 'Nothing here yet',
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11, color: muted.withOpacity(.8))))
                    : ListView.builder(
                        itemCount: items.length,
                        itemBuilder: (BuildContext ic, int i) =>
                            _pipeCard(vendorId, items[i]),
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _pipeCard(
      String vendorId, QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
    final String name = (m['coupleName'] ?? 'A couple').toString();
    final String wd =
        ((m['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['weddingDate'] ?? '').toString();
    final List<dynamic> tags = (m['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    final bool unread = _isUnread(m);
    final String nextTitle = (m['nextTaskTitle'] ?? '').toString();
    final dynamic nextAt = m['nextTaskAt'];
    final bool overdue =
        nextAt is Timestamp && nextAt.toDate().isBefore(DateTime.now());
    final Widget card = Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(11),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: unread ? gold : goldLine.withOpacity(.8)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            if (unread)
              Container(
                  width: 7,
                  height: 7,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                  decoration:
                      const BoxDecoration(color: gold, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(name,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ink, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
            if (m['offPlatform'] == true)
              const Icon(Icons.language_rounded, size: 12, color: muted),
            if ((m['status'] ?? '') != 'booked' &&
                (m['status'] ?? '') != 'lost' &&
                m['demo'] != true)
              Builder(builder: (BuildContext fc) {
                final _Fit fit = _fitOf(
                    m,
                    _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ??
                        <String, dynamic>{});
                return InkWell(
                  onTap: () => _fitSheet(m, fit),
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: fit.color.withOpacity(.15),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        border: Border.all(color: fit.color.withOpacity(.6))),
                    child: Text(fit.grade.toUpperCase(),
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: fit.color == gold
                                ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
                                : fit.color,
                            fontSize: 8,
                            letterSpacing: .8,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                );
              }),
          ]),
          if (wd.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
              child:
                  Text(wd, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
            ),
          if (tags.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
              child: Wrap(spacing: 4, runSpacing: 4, children: <Widget>[
                for (final dynamic t in tags)
                  _tagChip(t.toString(), false, () {}),
              ]),
            ),
          if (nextTitle.isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Icon(Icons.task_alt_rounded,
                    size: 12, color: overdue ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : plum),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                      '$nextTitle${nextAt is Timestamp ? ' \u00b7 ${nextAt.toDate().month}/${nextAt.toDate().day}' : ''}',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          color: overdue ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : plum,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    // v175: picking a card up lifts it - scale, shadow, a haptic.
    final Widget feedback = Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: Transform.scale(
        scale: 1.04,
        child: Container(
          width: 228,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
              BoxShadow(
                  color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.28),
                  blurRadius: 26,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 14)),
            ],
          ),
          child: card,
        ),
      ),
    );
    void open() {
      setState(() {
        _dashMode = 'leads';
        _setInboxThread(d.id);
        _showInbox = true;
      });
      _markThreadRead(d.id, m);
    }

    final Widget tappable = _Press(onTap: open, child: card);
    if (kIsWeb) {
      return Draggable<String>(
          data: d.id,
          feedback: feedback,
          onDragStarted: () => _tick(_Tick.medium),
          childWhenDragging: Opacity(opacity: .35, child: card),
          child: tappable);
    }
    return LongPressDraggable<String>(
        data: d.id,
        feedback: feedback,
        onDragStarted: () => _tick(_Tick.medium),
        childWhenDragging: Opacity(opacity: .35, child: card),
        child: tappable);
  }

  Future<void> _moveToStage(
      String vendorId, String inquiryId, String key, bool statusCol) async {
    if (statusCol) {
      // booked / delivered / lost are status, not a label - keep it honest.
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> s = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .get();
      if (!s.exists || !mounted) return;
      await _bookingStatusSheet(inquiryId, s.data()!);
      return;
    }
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'stage': key}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _tick(_Tick.select);
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not move that: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _stagesSheet(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> custom =
        ((vd['pipeline'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m))
            .toList();
    final TextEditingController addC = TextEditingController();
    Future<void> save() async {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'pipeline': custom}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text('Your stages', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                const Text(
                    'New and Talking come first; Booked, Delivered and Lost come last and follow the real status. Add the steps in between that match how you work.',
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (custom.isEmpty)
                  const Text(
                      'No custom stages yet - try "Tour scheduled" or "Waiting on deposit".',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: muted)),
                ...custom
                    .asMap()
                    .entries
                    .map((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) {
                  final int i = e.key;
                  return Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text((e.value['label'] ?? '').toString(),
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: ink,
                                fontSize: 13.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        onPressed: _h(i == 0
                            ? null
                            : () => setSheet(() {
                                  final Map<String, dynamic> x =
                                      custom.removeAt(i);
                                  custom.insert(i - 1, x);
                                })),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_upward_rounded,
                            size: 16, color: muted),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        onPressed: _h(i == custom.length - 1
                            ? null
                            : () => setSheet(() {
                                  final Map<String, dynamic> x =
                                      custom.removeAt(i);
                                  custom.insert(i + 1, x);
                                })),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_downward_rounded,
                            size: 16, color: muted),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        onPressed: _h(() => setSheet(() => custom.removeAt(i))),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                            size: 16, color: muted),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  );
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: addC,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'New stage name',
                        hintStyle: TextStyle(
                            color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
                        isDense: true,
                        filled: true,
                        fillColor: Colors.white,
                        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: plum,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                    onPressed: _h(() {
                      final String label = addC.text.trim();
                      if (label.isEmpty || custom.length >= 8) return;
                      setSheet(() {
                        custom.add(<String, dynamic>{
                          'key': 'c_' + _randomCode(6).toLowerCase(),
                          'label': label,
                        });
                        addC.clear();
                      });
                    }),
                    child: const Text('Add',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(() async {
                      await save();
                      if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      _toast('Stages saved');
                    }),
                    child: const Text('Save stages',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  // ---- tags -----------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _tagRow(String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) {
    final List<dynamic> tags = (inq['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
      child: Wrap(
          spacing: 5,
          runSpacing: 4,
          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final dynamic t in tags)
              _tagChip(t.toString(), true, () async {
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('inquiries')
                    .doc(inquiryId)
                    .set(<String, dynamic>{
                  'tags': FieldValue.arrayRemove(<dynamic>[t])
                }, SetOptions(merge: true));
              }),
            InkWell(
              onTap: () => _addTagSheet(inquiryId, inq, vendorId),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    border: Border.all(color: plum.withOpacity(.3))),
                child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: const <Widget>[
                      Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 12, color: plum),
                      SizedBox(width: 2),
                      Text('tag',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ]),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _addTagSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<String> palette =
        ((vd['tagPalette'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
            .toList();
    final List<dynamic> have = (inq['tags'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    Future<void> apply(String t) async {
      final String tag = t.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
      if (tag.isEmpty || tag.length > 24) return;
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'tags': FieldValue.arrayUnion(<dynamic>[tag])
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'tagPalette': FieldValue.arrayUnion(<dynamic>[tag])
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text('Tag this thread', style: _serif(size: 22)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              if (palette.isNotEmpty)
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final String t in palette)
                    _tagChip(t, have.contains(t), () async {
                      await apply(t);
                      if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    }),
                ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: c,
                    autofocus: palette.isEmpty,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    onSubmitted: (String v) async {
                      await apply(v);
                      if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    },
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'New tag - "referral", "elopement", "hot"',
                      hintStyle:
                          TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
                      isDense: true,
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: Colors.white,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: plum,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                  onPressed: _h(() async {
                    await apply(c.text);
                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  }),
                  child: const Text('Add',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---- tasks ----------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _tasksStrip(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'tasks'),
      stream: _threadQuery(
          inquiryId,
          'tasks',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .doc(inquiryId)
              .collection('tasks')
              .orderBy('dueAt')),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    d.data()['done'] != true)
                .toList();
        if (docs.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
        final DateTime today = DateTime.now();
        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 6),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.7),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: Border.all(color: goldLine),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(Icons.task_alt_rounded, size: 14, color: plum),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text('${docs.length} open task${docs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const Spacer(),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () => _taskSheet(inquiryId, inq, vendorId),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                    child: Text('+ Add',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
              ...docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                final Map<String, dynamic> t = d.data();
                final dynamic due = t['dueAt'];
                final bool late = due is Timestamp &&
                    due
                        .toDate()
                        .isBefore(DateTime(today.year, today.month, today.day));
                final String who = (t['assignedTo'] ?? 'vendor').toString();
                return InkWell(
                  onTap: () =>
                      _taskSheet(inquiryId, inq, vendorId, existing: d),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
                    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                      InkWell(
                        onTap: () async {
                          await d.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
                            'done': true,
                            'doneAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                          }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                        },
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        child: Container(
                          width: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              border: Border.all(
                                  color: plum.withOpacity(.5), width: 1.5)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 9),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text((t['title'] ?? '').toString(),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: ink,
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                      if (who == 'couple')
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                          child: _tagChip('couple', false, () {}, tint: vGreen),
                        ),
                      if (due is Timestamp)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
                          child: Text(
                              '${due.toDate().month}/${due.toDate().day}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color: late ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : muted,
                                  fontWeight: late
                                      ? FontWeight.w800
                                      : FontWeight.w600)),
                        ),
                    ]),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _taskSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId,
      {QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? existing}) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> ex = existing?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController titleC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ex['title'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ex['note'] ?? '').toString());
    DateTime? due =
        ex['dueAt'] is Timestamp ? (ex['dueAt'] as Timestamp).toDate() : null;
    String who = (ex['assignedTo'] ?? 'vendor').toString();
    String err = '';
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    if (!mounted) return;

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        InputDecoration deco(String hint) => InputDecoration(
              hintText: hint,
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
              isDense: true,
              filled: true,
              fillColor: Colors.white,
              contentPadding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
            );
        Widget quick(String label, DateTime d) => _tagChip(
            label,
            due != null &&
                due!.year == d.year &&
                due!.month == d.month &&
                due!.day == d.day,
            () => setSheet(() => due = d));
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text(existing == null ? 'Add a task' : 'Edit task',
                    style: _serif(size: 22)),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                TextField(
                    controller: titleC,
                    autofocus: existing == null,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                    decoration:
                        deco('What needs doing? - "Send the timeline draft"')),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(
                    controller: noteC,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                    decoration: deco('Note (optional)')),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text('DUE',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: muted,
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        letterSpacing: 1.4,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                  quick('Today', today),
                  quick('Tomorrow', today.add(const Duration(days: 1))),
                  quick('Next week', today.add(const Duration(days: 7))),
                  _tagChip(
                      due == null
                          ? 'Pick a date'
                          : '${due!.month}/${due!.day}/${due!.year}',
                      false, () async {
                    final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                        context: sc,
                        initialDate: due ?? today,
                        firstDate: today.subtract(const Duration(days: 365)),
                        lastDate: today.add(const Duration(days: 1095)));
                    if (d != null)
                      setSheet(() => due = DateTime(d.year, d.month, d.day));
                  }),
                  if (due != null)
                    _tagChip(
                        'No date', false, () => setSheet(() => due = null)),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                const Text('FOR',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: muted,
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        letterSpacing: 1.4,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                  _tagChip('Me / my team', who == 'vendor',
                      () => setSheet(() => who = 'vendor')),
                  _tagChip('The couple', who == 'couple',
                      () => setSheet(() => who = 'couple'),
                      tint: vGreen),
                ]),
                if (who == 'couple')
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                    child: Text(
                        'They see it in their thread and get a reminder the morning it is due (text and email for website leads).',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                  ),
                if (err.isNotEmpty)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    child: Text(err,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFFB04343), fontSize: 12)),
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  if (existing != null)
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() async {
                        await existing.reference.delete();
                        if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      }),
                      child: const Text('Delete',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: muted,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: plum,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 18, vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                    onPressed: _h(() async {
                      final String title = titleC.text.trim();
                      if (title.isEmpty) {
                        setSheet(() => err = 'Give it a title.');
                        return;
                      }
                      final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{
                        'title': title,
                        'note': noteC.text.trim(),
                        'dueAt': due == null ? null : Timestamp.fromDate(due!),
                        'assignedTo': who,
                        'vendorId': vendorId,
                        'coupleUid': (inq['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString(),
                        'done': false,
                      };
                      try {
                        if (existing != null) {
                          await existing.reference
                              .set(data, SetOptions(merge: true));
                        } else {
                          data['createdAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
                          data['createdBy'] = _uid ?? '';
                          await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                              .collection('inquiries')
                              .doc(inquiryId)
                              .collection('tasks')
                              .add(data);
                          if (who == 'couple') {
                            await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                .collection('inquiries')
                                .doc(inquiryId)
                                .collection('messages')
                                .add(<String, dynamic>{
                              'senderRole': 'vendor',
                              'system': true,
                              'text':
                                  'Quick one for you: $title${due == null ? '' : ' - by ${due!.month}/${due!.day}'}.',
                              'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                            });
                          }
                        }
                        if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      } catch (e) {
                        setSheet(() => err = _errText(e));
                      }
                    }),
                    child: Text(existing == null ? 'Add task' : 'Save',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ]),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  Color _hexColor(String h, Color fallback) {
    final String x = h.replaceAll('#', '').trim();
    if (x.length != 6) return fallback;
    final int? v = int.tryParse(x, radix: 16);
    return v == null ? fallback : Color(0xFF000000 | v);
  }

  static const List<List<String>> _kDays = <List<String>>[
    <String>['mon', 'Mon'],
    <String>['tue', 'Tue'],
    <String>['wed', 'Wed'],
    <String>['thu', 'Thu'],
    <String>['fri', 'Fri'],
    <String>['sat', 'Sat'],
    <String>['sun', 'Sun'],
  ];

  String _fmtConsult(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> w = <String>[
      'Mon',
      'Tue',
      'Wed',
      'Thu',
      'Fri',
      'Sat',
      'Sun'
    ];
    final int h12 = d.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : d.hour % 12;
    final String mm = d.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '${w[d.weekday - 1]} ${d.month}/${d.day} \u00b7 $h12:$mm ${d.hour < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}';
  }

  Widget _consultStrip(String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    final dynamic t = inq['nextConsultAt'];
    if (t is! Timestamp) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final DateTime d = t.toDate().toLocal();
    if (d.isBefore(DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(hours: 2))))
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: vGreen.withOpacity(.1),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.45)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        const Icon(Icons.event_available_rounded, size: 15, color: vGreen),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(
          child: Text('Consult booked \u00b7 ${_fmtConsult(d)}',
              style: const TextStyle(
                  color: vGreen, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _upcomingConsultsCard(String vendorId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'consults:$vendorId',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('consults')
              .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId)
              .where('status', isEqualTo: 'booked')
              .where('startAt',
                  isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: Timestamp.fromDate(
                      DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(hours: 1))))
              .orderBy('startAt')
              .limit(6)),
      initialData: _liveQ['consults:$vendorId']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        if (docs.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 10),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  _cardIconChip(Icons.event_available_rounded),
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Text('Upcoming consults',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                  _foldBtn('consults'),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ...docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
                  final DateTime when =
                      (m['startAt'] as Timestamp).toDate().toLocal();
                  final String who =
                      ((m['contact'] as Map?)?['name'] ?? 'A couple')
                          .toString();
                  final String mode = (m['mode'] ?? '').toString();
                  final String link = (m['videoLink'] ?? '').toString();
                  return InkWell(
                    onTap: () {
                      final String inqId = (m['inquiryId'] ?? '').toString();
                      if (inqId.isEmpty) return;
                      setState(() {
                        _dashMode = 'leads';
                        _setInboxThread(inqId);
                        _showInbox = true;
                      });
                    },
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Icon(
                            mode == 'video'
                                ? Icons.videocam_rounded
                                : mode == 'phone'
                                    ? Icons.call_rounded
                                    : Icons.place_rounded,
                            size: 15,
                            color: plum),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Text(
                                    '$who \u00b7 ${(m['typeLabel'] ?? 'Consult').toString()}',
                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: ink,
                                        fontSize: 12.5,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                Text(_fmtConsult(when),
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
                              ]),
                        ),
                        if (link.isNotEmpty)
                          IconButton(
                            visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                            onPressed: _h(() => _openUrl(link)),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                                size: 15, color: plum),
                          ),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _sendBookingLink(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vendorId = (inq['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> sch = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (vd['scheduler'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    if (sch.isEmpty || sch['enabled'] == false) {
      _toast('Set up your scheduler first - Account \u203a Consult scheduler.');
      await _schedulerSheet(vendorId);
      return;
    }
    final String url = 'https://meetlazo.com/book/$vendorId?inq=$inquiryId';
    final String first = (inq['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().split(' ').first;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('messages')
          .add(<String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'vendor',
        'text':
            '${first.isEmpty ? 'Hi' : 'Hi $first'} - grab a time that works for you and I\u2019ll be there: $url',
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'lastMessageAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'lastMessageRole': 'vendor',
        'status':
            ((inq['status'] ?? '') == 'new' || (inq['status'] ?? '') == '')
                ? 'responded'
                : inq['status'],
        'respondedAt': inq['respondedAt'] ?? FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
      _toast('Booking link sent - and copied, in case you want to text it.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _schedulerSheet(String vendorId) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> sch = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (vd['scheduler'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    bool enabled = sch['enabled'] != false;
    int slot =
        (sch['slotMinutes'] is num) ? (sch['slotMinutes'] as num).toInt() : 30;
    int buffer = (sch['bufferMinutes'] is num)
        ? (sch['bufferMinutes'] as num).toInt()
        : 15;
    int notice = (sch['minNoticeHours'] is num)
        ? (sch['minNoticeHours'] as num).toInt()
        : 24;
    final TextEditingController videoC =
        TextEditingController(text: (sch['videoLink'] ?? '').toString());
    final Map<String, List<List<String>>> hours =
        <String, List<List<String>>>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> rawHours = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        (sch['hours'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    for (final List<String> d in _kDays) {
      final List<dynamic> w = (rawHours[d[0]] as List?) ??
          (rawHours.isEmpty && d[0] != 'sat' && d[0] != 'sun'
              ? <dynamic>[
                  <dynamic>['09:00', '17:00']
                ]
              : <dynamic>[]);
      hours[d[0]] = w
          .whereType<List>()
          .map((List x) => <String>[x[0].toString(), x[1].toString()])
          .toList();
    }
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> types =
        ((sch['types'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m))
            .toList();
    if (types.isEmpty) {
      types.add(<String, dynamic>{
        'key': 'intro',
        'label': 'Intro call',
        'minutes': 30,
        'mode': 'video',
        'location': ''
      });
    }
    final String publicUrl = 'https://meetlazo.com/book/$vendorId';
    bool saving = false;
    if (!mounted) return;

    String tzGuess() {
      final String metro = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
      const Map<String, String> tz = <String, String>{
        'phoenix': 'America/Phoenix',
        'tucson': 'America/Phoenix',
        'denver': 'America/Denver',
        'salt-lake-city': 'America/Denver',
        'las-vegas': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'los-angeles': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'san-diego': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'san-francisco-bay': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'sacramento': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'seattle': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'portland': 'America/Los_Angeles',
        'dallas-fort-worth': 'America/Chicago',
        'houston': 'America/Chicago',
        'austin': 'America/Chicago',
        'san-antonio': 'America/Chicago',
        'chicago': 'America/Chicago',
        'minneapolis': 'America/Chicago',
        'st-louis': 'America/Chicago',
        'kansas-city': 'America/Chicago',
        'new-orleans': 'America/Chicago',
        'milwaukee': 'America/Chicago',
        'memphis': 'America/Chicago',
        'nashville': 'America/Chicago',
      };
      return (sch['tz'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
          ? sch['tz'].toString()
          : (tz[metro] ?? 'America/New_York');
    }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        InputDecoration deco(String hint) => InputDecoration(
              hintText: hint,
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 12.5),
              isDense: true,
              filled: true,
              fillColor: Colors.white,
              contentPadding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 9),
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
            );
        Widget label(String t) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14, bottom: 6),
              child: Text(t.toUpperCase(),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: muted,
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      letterSpacing: 1.4,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            );
        Future<String?> pickTime(String cur) async {
          final List<String> parts = cur.split(':');
          final TimeOfDay? t = await showTimePicker(
              context: sc,
              initialTime: TimeOfDay(
                  hour: int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? 9,
                  minute:
                      parts.length > 1 ? (int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? 0) : 0));
          if (t == null) return null;
          return '${t.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${t.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
        }

        String pretty(String hm) {
          final List<String> p = hm.split(':');
          final int h = int.tryParse(p[0]) ?? 0;
          final int h12 = h % 12 == 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
          return '$h12:${p.length > 1 ? p[1] : '00'} ${h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}';
        }

        Widget timeBtn(String v, void Function(String) set) => InkWell(
              onTap: () async {
                final String? n = await pickTime(v);
                if (n != null) setSheet(() => set(n));
              },
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 7),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                    border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                child: Text(pretty(v),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            );

        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                        child:
                            Text('Consult scheduler', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                    Switch(
                        value: enabled,
                        activeColor: vGreen,
                        onChanged:
                            _hb((bool v) => setSheet(() => enabled = v))),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  const Text(
                      'Couples pick a time from your real availability; you both get a calendar invite, and reminders go out the day before and an hour before. Your blocked dates and booked weddings are never offered.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                  label('Your link'),
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                            border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                        child: SelectableText(publicUrl,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                color: ink,
                                fontFamily: 'monospace')),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() async {
                        await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: publicUrl));
                        _toast('Link copied \u2713');
                      }),
                      icon:
                          const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, color: plum, size: 18),
                    ),
                  ]),
                  label('Meeting types'),
                  ...types
                      .asMap()
                      .entries
                      .map((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) {
                    final Map<String, dynamic> t = e.value;
                    final String mode = (t['mode'] ?? 'video').toString();
                    return Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                      child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                        Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(
                            flex: 3,
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: TextEditingController(
                                  text: (t['label'] ?? '').toString())
                                ..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
                                    offset:
                                        (t['label'] ?? '').toString().length),
                              onChanged: (String v) => t['label'] = v,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                              decoration:
                                  deco('Name - "Intro call", "Venue tour"'),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          SizedBox(
                            width: 74,
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: TextEditingController(
                                  text: (t['minutes'] ?? 30).toString())
                                ..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
                                    offset:
                                        (t['minutes'] ?? 30).toString().length),
                              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                              onChanged: (String v) =>
                                  t['minutes'] = int.tryParse(v) ?? 30,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                              decoration: deco('min'),
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (types.length > 1)
                            IconButton(
                              visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                              onPressed: _h(
                                  () => setSheet(() => types.removeAt(e.key))),
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                  size: 16, color: muted),
                            ),
                        ]),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Wrap(spacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                            _tagChip('Video', mode == 'video',
                                () => setSheet(() => t['mode'] = 'video')),
                            _tagChip('Phone', mode == 'phone',
                                () => setSheet(() => t['mode'] = 'phone')),
                            _tagChip('In person', mode == 'in_person',
                                () => setSheet(() => t['mode'] = 'in_person')),
                          ]),
                        ]),
                        if (mode == 'in_person')
                          Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: TextEditingController(
                                  text: (t['location'] ?? '').toString())
                                ..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
                                    offset: (t['location'] ?? '')
                                        .toString()
                                        .length),
                              onChanged: (String v) => t['location'] = v,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                              decoration: deco(
                                  'Where - studio address, venue, coffee shop'),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ]),
                    );
                  }),
                  if (types.length < 5)
                    TextButton.icon(
                      onPressed:
                          _h(() => setSheet(() => types.add(<String, dynamic>{
                                'key': 't_' + _randomCode(6).toLowerCase(),
                                'label': '',
                                'minutes': 30,
                                'mode': 'video',
                                'location': '',
                              }))),
                      icon:
                          const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 16, color: plum),
                      label: const Text('Add a type',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  label('Video link'),
                  TextField(
                    controller: videoC,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
                    decoration: deco(
                        'Your Zoom / Google Meet room link (used for every video type)'),
                  ),
                  label('Weekly hours \u00b7 ${tzGuess()}'),
                  ..._kDays.map((List<String> d) {
                    final List<List<String>> w = hours[d[0]]!;
                    return Padding(

                                            style: TextStyle(
                                                color: muted, fontSize: 12)),
                                      ),

                                                children: <Widget>[
                                                  timeBtn(

                                                          e.value[0] = v),

                                                      padding:
                                                          EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                                              horizontal: 4),

                                                          style: TextStyle(
                                                              color: muted))),

                                                      e.value[1],
                                                      (String v) =>
                                                          e.value[1] = v),

                                                    onTap: () => setSheet(() =>
                                                        w.removeAt(e.key)),
                                                    child: const Padding(
                                                      padding:
                                                          EdgeInsets.all(4),
                                                      child: Icon(
                                                          Icons.close_rounded,
                                                          size: 14,
                                                          color: muted),
                                                    ),
                                                  ),
                                                ])),
                                    if (w.length < 2)
                                      InkWell(
                                        onTap: () => setSheet(() => w
                                                .add(<String>[
                                              w.isEmpty ? '09:00' : '13:00',
                                              w.isEmpty ? '17:00' : '17:00'
                                            ])),
                                        borderRadius:
                                            BorderRadius.circular(999),
                                        child: Container(
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                              horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              borderRadius:
                                                  BorderRadius.circular(999),

                                                  color: plum.withOpacity(.3))),
                                          child: Text(
                                              w.isEmpty

                                                  : '+ another window',
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                  color: plum,
                                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
