                                      ),
                                  ]),
                            ),
                          ]),
                    );
                  }),
                  label('Slots'),
                  Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                    for (final int m in <int>[15, 30, 45, 60])
                      _tagChip('Every $m min', slot == m,
                          () => setSheet(() => slot = m)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                    for (final int m in <int>[0, 15, 30])
                      _tagChip(m == 0 ? 'No buffer' : '$m min buffer',
                          buffer == m, () => setSheet(() => buffer = m)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                    for (final int h in <int>[2, 12, 24, 48])
                      _tagChip(
                          h < 24
                              ? '${h}h notice'
                              : '${h ~/ 24} day${h > 24 ? 's' : ''} notice',
                          notice == h,
                          () => setSheet(() => notice = h)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: FilledButton(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: gold,
                          foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                          elevation: 0,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                      onPressed: _h(
                          saving
                              ? null
                              : () async {
                                  setSheet(() => saving = true);
                                  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cleanTypes =
                                      types
                                          .where((Map<String, dynamic> t) =>
                                              (t['label'] ?? '')
                                                  .toString()
                                                  .trim()
                                                  .isNotEmpty)
                                          .map((Map<String, dynamic> t) =>
                                              <String, dynamic>{
                                                'key': (t['key'] ?? 'intro')
                                                    .toString(),
                                                'label': (t['label'] ?? '')
                                                    .toString()
                                                    .trim(),
                                                'minutes': (t['minutes'] is num)
                                                    ? (t['minutes'] as num)
                                                        .toInt()
                                                    : 30,
                                                'mode': (t['mode'] ?? 'video')
                                                    .toString(),
                                                'location':
                                                    (t['location'] ?? '')
                                                        .toString()
                                                        .trim(),
                                              })
                                          .toList();
                                  try {
                                    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                        .collection('vendors')
                                        .doc(vendorId)
                                        .set(<String, dynamic>{
                                      'scheduler': <String, dynamic>{
                                        'enabled': enabled,
                                        'tz': tzGuess(),
                                        'slotMinutes': slot,
                                        'bufferMinutes': buffer,
                                        'minNoticeHours': notice,
                                        'maxDaysOut': 60,
                                        'videoLink': videoC.text.trim(),
                                        'hours': hours,
                                        'types': cleanTypes.isEmpty
                                            ? <Map<String, dynamic>>[
                                                <String, dynamic>{
                                                  'key': 'intro',
                                                  'label': 'Intro call',
                                                  'minutes': 30,
                                                  'mode': 'video',
                                                  'location': ''
                                                }
                                              ]
                                            : cleanTypes,
                                        'updatedAt':
                                            FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                      }
                                    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                    _toast(enabled
                                        ? 'Scheduler is live at $publicUrl'
                                        : 'Scheduler saved (off).');
                                  } catch (e) {
                                    setSheet(() => saving = false);
                                    _toast('Could not save: ' + _errText(e));
                                  }
                                },
                          _Tick.medium),
                      child: Text(saving ? 'Saving\u2026' : 'Save scheduler',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v165: CONNECT CLAUDE OR CHATGPT (MCP)
  // ===================================================================
  Future<void> _mcpSheet(String vendorId) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> mcp =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((vd['mcp'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    bool connected = mcp['enabled'] == true &&
        (mcp['tokenHash'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty;
    String url = '';
    bool busy = false;
    final String client = (mcp['lastClient'] ?? '').toString();
    final dynamic lastUsed = mcp['lastUsedAt'];
    if (!mounted) return;

    Future<void> mint(StateSetter setSheet) async {
      setSheet(() => busy = true);
      try {
        final HttpsCallable fn =
            FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('mcpToken');
        final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r = await fn
            .call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId, 'action': 'mint'});
        setSheet(() {
          url = ((r.data as Map?)?['url'] ?? '').toString();
          connected = true;
          busy = false;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        setSheet(() => busy = false);
        _toast('Could not create the link: ' + _errText(e));
      }
    }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        Widget step(String n, String t) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
              child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Container(
                        width: 20,
                        height: 20,
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                            color: plum, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                        child: Text(n,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: gold,
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(t,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12.5, color: ink, height: 1.4))),
                  ]),
            );
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text('Connect Claude or ChatGPT', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  const Text(
                      '"Who is waiting on me?" "What is due this week?" "Draft a reply to Sarah about the second shooter." Your assistant can see your pipeline, every thread, money and consults - and, when you say so, reply, add tasks, tag and move things. Nothing about other vendors, ever.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (url.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const Text('YOUR PRIVATE LINK - SHOWN ONCE',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.4,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Container(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: gold)),
                      child: SelectableText(url,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11.5,
                              color: ink,
                              fontFamily: 'monospace')),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton.icon(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold,
                            foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12)),
                        onPressed: _h(() async {
                          await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
                          _toast('Link copied \u2713');
                        }),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, size: 16),
                        label: const Text('Copy link',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text(
                        'Treat it like a password - anyone with it can read your threads. Close this and it is gone; you can always make a new one.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    const Text('CLAUDE',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.4,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    step('1',
                        'claude.ai \u203a Settings \u203a Connectors \u203a Add custom connector.'),
                    step('2',
                        'Name it Lazo, paste the link, Add. Leave authentication blank.'),
                    step('3',
                        'In a chat, turn Lazo on under the tools menu and ask "What is waiting on me?"'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text('CHATGPT',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.4,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    step('1',
                        'Settings \u203a Connectors \u203a Create (developer mode on) \u203a paste the link as the MCP server URL, no auth.'),
                    step('2', 'Start a chat, pick Lazo under Tools.'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text('CLAUDE CODE / CURSOR',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: muted,
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.4,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    step('1', 'claude mcp add --transport http lazo <link>'),
                  ] else if (connected) ...<Widget>[
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: vGreen.withOpacity(.1),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.5))),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                            color: vGreen, size: 18),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                              'Connected${client.isNotEmpty ? ' \u00b7 last used by $client' : ''}${lastUsed is Timestamp ? ' \u00b7 ${lastUsed.toDate().month}/${lastUsed.toDate().day}' : ''}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: vGreen,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text(
                        'The link itself is only shown when it is made. Lost it? Make a new one - the old one stops working the moment you do.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                  ] else
                    const Text('Not connected yet.',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: plum,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11))),
                        onPressed: _h(busy ? null : () => mint(setSheet)),
                        child: Text(
                            busy
                                ? 'One moment\u2026'
                                : connected
                                    ? 'Make a new link'
                                    : 'Make my link',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (connected) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      OutlinedButton(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: muted,
                            side: const BorderSide(color: goldLine),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14, vertical: 12)),
                        onPressed: _h(busy
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                setSheet(() => busy = true);
                                try {
                                  await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                      .httpsCallable('mcpToken')
                                      .call(<String, dynamic>{
                                    'vendorId': vendorId,
                                    'action': 'revoke'
                                  });
                                  setSheet(() {
                                    connected = false;
                                    url = '';
                                    busy = false;
                                  });
                                  _toast('Disconnected.');
                                } catch (e) {
                                  setSheet(() => busy = false);
                                  _toast(_errText(e));
                                }
                              }),
                        child: const Text('Turn off',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ]),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v166: ASK JUNE (vendor side, with tools)
  // ===================================================================
  final TextEditingController _juneAskC = TextEditingController();

  Widget _askJuneCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    const List<String> suggestions = <String>[
      'Who is waiting on me?',
      'What is due this week?',
      'How much is outstanding?',
      'Which leads went quiet?',
    ];
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 14),
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.7),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            _cardIconChip(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded),
            const Expanded(
              child: Text('Ask June',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: plum, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
            _foldBtn('june'),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          const Text(
              'She reads your real leads, money and dates - and drafts, tags and adds tasks when you say so.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          TextField(
            controller: _juneAskC,
            textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
            onSubmitted: (String v) {
              final String q = v.trim();
              if (q.isEmpty) return;
              _juneAskC.clear();
              _juneVendorSheet(vendorId, seed: q);
            },
            style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'Ask about any couple, date or dollar\u2026',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 12.5),
              isDense: true,
              filled: true,
              fillColor: Colors.white,
              contentPadding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
              suffixIcon: IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                    size: 18, color: plum),
                onPressed: _h(() {
                  final String q = _juneAskC.text.trim();
                  if (q.isEmpty) return;
                  _juneAskC.clear();
                  _juneVendorSheet(vendorId, seed: q);
                }),
              ),
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
            for (final String q in suggestions)
              _tagChip(q, false, () => _juneVendorSheet(vendorId, seed: q)),
          ]),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _juneVendorSheet(String vendorId, {String seed = ''}) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> turns = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final TextEditingController inC = TextEditingController();
    final ScrollController scrollC = ScrollController();
    bool busy = false;
    if (!mounted) return;

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        Future<void> ask(String q) async {
          final String text = q.trim();
          if (text.isEmpty || busy) return;
          setSheet(() {
            turns.add(<String, dynamic>{'role': 'user', 'content': text});
            busy = true;
          });
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (scrollC.hasClients)
              scrollC.jumpTo(scrollC.position.maxScrollExtent);
          });
          try {
            final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
                'juneVendor',
                options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                    timeout: const Duration(seconds: 120)));
            final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r =
                await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
              'vendorId': vendorId,
              'messages': turns
                  .map((Map<String, dynamic> t) => <String, dynamic>{
                        'role': t['role'],
                        'content': t['content']
                      })
                  .toList(),
            });
            final Map<String, dynamic> data =
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(r.data as Map);
            setSheet(() {
              turns.add(<String, dynamic>{
                'role': 'assistant',
                'content': (data['reply'] ?? '').toString(),
                'steps': (data['steps'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[],
              });
              busy = false;
            });
          } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
            setSheet(() {
              turns.add(<String, dynamic>{
                'role': 'assistant',
                'content': e.message ?? 'June could not answer right now.',
                'error': true
              });
              busy = false;
            });
          } catch (e) {
            setSheet(() {
              turns.add(<String, dynamic>{
                'role': 'assistant',
                'content': 'June could not answer right now.',
                'error': true
              });
              busy = false;
            });
          }
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (scrollC.hasClients)
              scrollC.animateTo(scrollC.position.maxScrollExtent,
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                  curve: Curves.easeOut);
          });
        }

        if (seed.isNotEmpty && turns.isEmpty && !busy) {
          final String q = seed;
          seed = '';
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => ask(q));
        }

        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding:
                EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SizedBox(
              height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .82,
              child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 16, 14, 8),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                    _cardIconChip(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded),
                    Expanded(child: Text('June', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                    IconButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted)),
                  ]),
                ),
                Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
                Expanded(
                  child: ListView(
                    controller: scrollC,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 14),
                    children: <Widget>[
                      if (turns.isEmpty)
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                          child: Text(
                              'Ask about any couple, any date, any dollar. I read your real threads before I answer.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: muted, fontSize: 13, height: 1.5)),
                        ),
                      ...turns.map((Map<String, dynamic> t) {
                        final bool me = t['role'] == 'user';
                        final List<dynamic> steps =
                            (t['steps'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
                        return Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: me
                              ? CrossAxisAlignment.end
                              : CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            if (steps.isNotEmpty)
                              Padding(
                                padding:
                                    const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6, left: 4),
                                child: Wrap(
                                    spacing: 6,
                                    runSpacing: 4,
                                    children: <Widget>[
                                      for (final dynamic st in steps)
                                        Container(
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                              horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              color: (st is Map &&
                                                      st['error'] == true)
                                                  ? const Color(0xFFB04343)
                                                      .withOpacity(.08)
                                                  : gold.withOpacity(.18),
                                              borderRadius:
                                                  BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                                          child: Text(
                                              (st is Map
                                                      ? (st['summary'] ?? '')
                                                      : '')
                                                  .toString(),
                                              style: TextStyle(
                                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                                  color: (st is Map &&
                                                          st['error'] == true)
                                                      ? const Color(0xFFB04343)
                                                      : plumDeep,
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                        ),
                                    ]),
                              ),
                            Container(
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: me ? plum : Colors.white,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                                  topLeft: const Radius.circular(16),
                                  topRight: const Radius.circular(16),
                                  bottomLeft: Radius.circular(me ? 16 : 4),
                                  bottomRight: Radius.circular(me ? 4 : 16),
                                ),
                                border: Border.all(color: me ? plum : goldLine),
                              ),
                              child: SelectableText(
                                  (t['content'] ?? '').toString(),
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: me
                                          ? ivory
                                          : (t['error'] == true
                                              ? const Color(0xFFB04343)
                                              : ink),
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      height: 1.45)),
                            ),
                          ],
                        );
                      }),
                      if (busy)
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 12),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            SizedBox(
                                width: 14,
                                height: 14,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    strokeWidth: 2, color: plum)),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('June is reading your threads\u2026',
                                style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12)),
                          ]),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 12, 12),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: inC,
                        autofocus: seed.isEmpty,
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                        onSubmitted: (String v) {
                          inC.clear();
                          ask(v);
                        },
                        style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Ask June\u2026',
                          hintStyle: TextStyle(
                              color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
                          isDense: true,
                          filled: true,
                          fillColor: Colors.white,
                          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
                          border: OutlineInputBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(busy
                          ? null
                          : () {
                              final String v = inC.text;
                              inC.clear();
                              ask(v);
                            }),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: plum),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _wxCache =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  final Set<String> _wxLoading = <String>{};
  String _wxErr = '';

  String _ymd(DateTime d) =>
      '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

  static String _wmoLabel(int code) {
    if (code == 0) return 'Clear';
    if (code == 1) return 'Mostly sunny';
    if (code == 2) return 'Partly cloudy';
    if (code == 3) return 'Overcast';
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return 'Foggy';
    if (code >= 51 && code <= 57) return 'Drizzle';
    if (code >= 61 && code <= 67) return 'Rain';
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) return 'Snow';
    if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return 'Showers';
    if (code >= 85 && code <= 86) return 'Snow showers';
    if (code >= 95) return 'Thunderstorms';
    return 'Mixed';
  }

  static IconData _wmoIcon(int code) {
    if (code == 0 || code == 1) return Icons.wb_sunny_rounded;
    if (code == 2) return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
    if (code == 3) return Icons.cloud_rounded;
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return Icons.foggy;
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 86 && code != 80 && code != 81 && code != 82)
      return Icons.ac_unit_rounded;
    if (code >= 95) return Icons.thunderstorm_rounded;
    if (code >= 51) return Icons.water_drop_rounded;
    return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
  }

  String _sunsetClock(String iso) {
    final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(iso);
    if (d == null) return '';
    final int h12 = d.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : d.hour % 12;
    return '$h12:${d.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${d.hour < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}';
  }

  static num _numAt(dynamic list) =>
      (list is List && list.isNotEmpty && list.first is num)
          ? list.first as num
          : 0;

  Future<void> _loadWx(DateTime day, String metro) async {
    final String key = '${_ymd(day)}|$metro';
    if (_wxCache.containsKey(key) || _wxLoading.contains(key)) return;
    final List<double>? ll = kMetroLatLng[metro];
    if (ll == null) return;
    _wxLoading.add(key);
    _wxErr = '';
    Map<String, dynamic>? wx;
    try {
      final DateTime today = DateTime(
          DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
      final int daysOut =
          DateTime(day.year, day.month, day.day).difference(today).inDays;
      if (daysOut >= 0 && daysOut <= 15) {
        final Uri u = Uri.parse(
            'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
            '&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max,wind_speed_10m_max,sunset'
            '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&wind_speed_unit=mph&timezone=auto&start_date=${_ymd(day)}&end_date=${_ymd(day)}');
        final httpc.Response r =
            await httpc.get(u).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
        final Map<String, dynamic> j =
            jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final Map<String, dynamic> d =
            Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
        wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'forecast',
          'hi': ((d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'lo': ((d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'code': ((d['weather_code'] as List).first as num).toInt(),
          'rainPct': _numAt(d['precipitation_probability_max']).round(),
          'wind': _numAt(d['wind_speed_10m_max']).round(),
          'sunset': (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString(),
          'daysOut': daysOut,
        };
      } else {
        final int endYear = today.year -
            (day.month > today.month ||
                    (day.month == today.month && day.day > today.day)
                ? 1
                : 0);
        final List<Future<httpc.Response>> reqs = <Future<httpc.Response>>[];
        for (int y = endYear; y > endYear - 5; y--) {
          final String ds =
              '$y-${day.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${day.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
          reqs.add(httpc
              .get(Uri.parse(
                  'https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
                  '&start_date=$ds&end_date=$ds&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunset'
                  '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&timezone=auto'))
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12)));
        }
        final List<httpc.Response> rs = await Future.wait(reqs);
        double hi = 0, lo = 0;
        int n = 0, rainy = 0;
        final Map<int, int> codes = <int, int>{};
        String sunset = '';
        for (final httpc.Response r in rs) {
          if (r.statusCode != 200) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> j =
              jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
          if (j['daily'] is! Map) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> d =
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
          final dynamic h = (d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first;
          final dynamic l = (d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first;
          if (h is! num || l is! num) continue;
          hi += h;
          lo += l;
          n++;
          final dynamic pr = (d['precipitation_sum'] as List).first;
          if (pr is num && pr >= 1.0) rainy++;
          final dynamic c = (d['weather_code'] as List).first;
          if (c is num) codes[c.toInt()] = (codes[c.toInt()] ?? 0) + 1;
          if (sunset.isEmpty &&
              d['sunset'] is List &&
              (d['sunset'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
            sunset = (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString();
          }
        }
        if (n == 0) throw Exception('no history');
        int code = 1, best = -1;
        codes.forEach((int c, int k) {
          if (k > best) {
            best = k;
            code = c;
          }
        });
        wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'typical',
          'hi': (hi / n).round(),
          'lo': (lo / n).round(),
          'code': code,
          'rainYears': rainy,
          'years': n,
          'sunset': sunset,
          'daysOut': daysOut
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO weather: ' + e.toString());
      _wxErr = 'Weather is unavailable right now.';
    }
    _wxLoading.remove(key);
    if (wx != null) _wxCache[key] = wx;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _vendorWeatherCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String metro = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro))
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final DateTime today = DateTime(
            DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
        DateTime? next;
        String who = '', threadId = '';
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
            in _leadDocs(snap)) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if ((m['status'] ?? '') != 'booked') continue;
          final String raw =
              ((m['structuredIntent'] as Map?)?['weddingDate'] ?? '')
                  .toString();
          final DateTime? wd = raw.isEmpty
              ? null
              : DateTime.tryParse(raw.length == 10 ? raw + 'T12:00:00' : raw);
          if (wd == null || wd.isBefore(today)) continue;
          if (next == null || wd.isBefore(next!)) {
            next = wd;
            who = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
            threadId = d.id;
          }
        }
        final DateTime day = next ?? today;
        WidgetsBinding.instance
            .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWx(day, metro));
        final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(day)}|$metro'];
        final int code = w == null ? -1 : (w['code'] as int);
        final bool fc = w != null && w['mode'] == 'forecast';
        List<Color> sky;
        if (code < 0) {
          sky = <Color>[const Color(0xFF4A2B4C), plumDeep];
        } else if (code <= 1) {
          sky = <Color>[
            const Color(0xFF2E5C8A),
            const Color(0xFF7FB3D5),
            const Color(0xFFF2D7A0)
          ];
        } else if (code <= 3) {
          sky = <Color>[
            const Color(0xFF4C5C7A),
            const Color(0xFF8C9BB5),
            const Color(0xFFD9D2C5)
          ];
        } else if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) {
          sky = <Color>[
            const Color(0xFF5B6B8C),
            const Color(0xFFB9C7DB),
            const Color(0xFFEEF2F7)
          ];
        } else if (code >= 95) {
          sky = <Color>[
            const Color(0xFF2B2A45),
            const Color(0xFF4C4A72),
            const Color(0xFF8A86A8)
          ];
        } else {
          sky = <Color>[
            const Color(0xFF34506B),
            const Color(0xFF5F7E9C),
            const Color(0xFFA9BCCB)
          ];
        }
        final bool light =
            code >= 0 && (code <= 3 || (code >= 71 && code <= 77));
        final Color fg = light ? const Color(0xFF1E2430) : Colors.white;
        final Color fg2 = fg.withOpacity(.72);
        const List<String> mo = <String>[
          'Jan',
          'Feb',
          'Mar',
          'Apr',
          'May',
          'Jun',
          'Jul',
          'Aug',
          'Sep',
          'Oct',
          'Nov',
          'Dec'
        ];
        const List<String> wk = <String>[
          'Mon',
          'Tue',
          'Wed',
          'Thu',
          'Fri',
          'Sat',
          'Sun'
        ];
        final String metroName = metro
            .split('-')
            .map((String p) =>
                p.isEmpty ? p : p[0].toUpperCase() + p.substring(1))
            .join(' ');
        final String eyebrow = next == null
            ? 'TODAY \u00b7 ${metroName.toUpperCase()}'
            : '${fc ? 'FORECAST' : 'USUALLY'} \u00b7 ${wk[day.weekday - 1].toUpperCase()} ${mo[day.month - 1].toUpperCase()} ${day.day} \u00b7 ${metroName.toUpperCase()}';
        final String sunset =
            w == null ? '' : _sunsetClock((w['sunset'] ?? '').toString());
        final String rain = w == null
            ? ''
            : fc
                ? '${w['rainPct']}% rain'
                : (w['rainYears'] == 0
                    ? 'Dry ${w['years']} of ${w['years']} yrs'
                    : 'Rain ${w['rainYears']} of ${w['years']} yrs');
        // v176: laid out like a weather widget, not a stat row. The sky runs
        // top to bottom with light catching the upper edge, the temperature
        // leads, the condition and low sit beside it, the details ride in the
        // same frosted tiles the hero uses, and the icon holds the corner.
        final bool loaded = w != null;
        final String condition = loaded
            ? _wmoLabel(code)
            : (_wxErr.isEmpty ? 'Reading the sky\u2026' : _wxErr);
        Widget tile(String t) => Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: (light ? Colors.white : Colors.black)
                      .withOpacity(light ? .30 : .18),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),

  // ===================================================================
  // vTOUR: THE FIRST-RUN TOUR (spotlight coach marks, no packages)
  // ===================================================================
  final GlobalKey _tourRootKey = GlobalKey();
  int _tourIdx = -1;
  List<_TourStep> _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
  Rect? _tourRect;
  bool _tourMeasuring = false;

  void _startTour(List<_TourStep> steps) {
    if (steps.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() {
      _tourSteps = steps;
      _tourIdx = 0;
      _tourRect = null;
    });
    _tourFocus();
  }

  void _tourGo(int delta) {
    final int next = _tourIdx + delta;
    if (next < 0 || next >= _tourSteps.length) {
      _endTour(completed: next >= _tourSteps.length);
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _tourIdx = next);
    _tourFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _tourFocus() async {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length) return;
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    st.before?.call();
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 60));
    BuildContext? tc = st.key?.currentContext;
    if (tc == null && st.key != null) {
      // target not on this screen - skip it
      if (mounted) _tourGo(1);
      return;
    }
    if (tc != null) {
      // Scroll only when the target is actually off-screen; ensureVisible
      // resolves when its animation ends, so no fixed wait is needed.
      bool needScroll = true;
      try {
        final RenderObject? rootRo0 =
            _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
        final RenderObject? ro0 = tc.findRenderObject();
        if (rootRo0 is RenderBox && ro0 is RenderBox && ro0.hasSize) {
          final Offset o0 = ro0.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo0);
          final double h0 = rootRo0.size.height;
          needScroll = o0.dy < 70 || o0.dy + ro0.size.height > h0 - 90;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      if (needScroll) {
        try {
          await Scrollable.ensureVisible(tc,
              alignment: .25,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
              curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    _tourMeasuring = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _tourMeasuring = false;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final RenderObject? rootRo =
          _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      final RenderObject? ro = st.key?.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      Rect? r;
      if (rootRo is RenderBox && ro is RenderBox && ro.hasSize) {
        final Offset o = ro.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo);
        r = Rect.fromLTWH(o.dx, o.dy, ro.size.width, ro.size.height).inflate(6);
      }
      setState(() => _tourRect = r);
    });
  }

  Widget _tourOverlay() {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length)
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    final Rect? r = _tourRect;
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
        final double w = cons.maxWidth, h = cons.maxHeight;
        final bool phone = w < 700;
        // card goes below the spotlight when there's room, else above
        final double cardW = phone ? w - 28 : 380;
        final bool below = r == null || r.bottom + 190 < h;
        final double top = r == null
            ? h * .35
            : (below ? r.bottom + 14 : (r.top - 14 - 180).clamp(12.0, h - 200));
        final double left = phone
            ? 14
            : (r == null
                ? (w - cardW) / 2
                : (r.left).clamp(14.0, w - cardW - 14));
        return Stack(children: <Widget>[
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => _tourGo(1),
              child: TweenAnimationBuilder<Rect?>(
                // v175: re-key when the ring first appears so it doesn't
                // grow out of the top-left corner (Rect.lerp from null).
                key: ValueKey<bool>(r == null),
                tween: RectTween(begin: r, end: r),
                duration:
                    Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 260),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                builder: (BuildContext bc, Rect? v, Widget? _) =>
                    CustomPaint(painter: _SpotlightPainter(v, plum)),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          AnimatedPositioned(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
            curve: Curves.easeOut,
            left: left,
            top: top,
            width: cardW,
            child: Material(
              color: Colors.transparent,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFFFFDF9),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold),
                  boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                    BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.35),
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                          color: gold, size: 16),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(st.title,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: plum,
                                fontSize: 16,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                      Text('${_tourIdx + 1} of ${_tourSteps.length}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFF6B5F72),
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(st.body,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF241E2B),
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            height: 1.45)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => _endTour(completed: false)),
                        child: const Text('Skip',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: Color(0xFF6B5F72),
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      if (_tourIdx > 0)
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(-1)),
                          child: const Text('Back',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: plum,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(1)),
                        child: Text(
                            _tourIdx == _tourSteps.length - 1 ? 'Done' : 'Next',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ]);
      }),
    );
  }

  // ---- vendor-specific ----
  final GlobalKey _kTourHero = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourInbox = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourModes = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourJune = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourActions = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourMoney = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourAvatar = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourFab = GlobalKey();
  bool _tourChecked = false;

  void _maybeStartVendorTour(String vendorId) {
    if (_tourChecked || _tourIdx >= 0 || _uid == null) return;
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? us =
        _liveD['user:$_uid']?.latest;
    if (us == null || !us.exists) return; // not loaded yet - decide next frame
    _tourChecked = true;
    final Map<String, dynamic> u = us.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    if (u['vendorTourDoneAt'] != null) return;
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 900), () {
      if (mounted && !_showInbox && !_showAccount && !_editingProfile)
        _startTour(_vendorTourSteps());
    });
  }

  List<_TourStep> _vendorTourSteps() {
    final bool phone = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 1100;
    return <_TourStep>[
      _TourStep('Welcome to your Lazo dashboard',
          'Leads, conversations, contracts, money and your public page - all here. Thirty seconds and you will know where everything is.'),

          key: _kTourHero),
      _TourStep('Inbox',
          'Every couple who inquired, newest first. Open a thread to reply, send a proposal, contract, invoice or payment plan - all from the + beside the reply box.',
          key: _kTourInbox),
      _TourStep('Five tabs, one job each',
          'Today is this view. Pipeline is your threads as a board you can drag. Money is payments and how you get paid. Studio is contracts, galleries and files. Profile is how couples see you.',
          key: _kTourModes, before: () => setState(() => _dashMode = 'leads')),
      _TourStep('Ask June',
          '"Who is waiting on me?" "What is due this week?" She reads your real threads and money, drafts replies, and adds tasks when you ask.',
          key: _kTourJune),
      _TourStep('Money',
          'What is outstanding and what came in, across every couple - and how you get paid: Whop, Stripe or Square.',
          key: _kTourMoney, before: () => setState(() => _dashMode = 'money')),
      _TourStep('Profile',
          'Edit profile is how couples see you on meetlazo.com - photos, packages, price sheet. It updates live within a minute. Profile strength tells you what to add next.',
          key: _kTourActions,
          before: () => setState(() => _dashMode = 'profile')),
      if (phone)
        _TourStep('Your desk button',
            'Inbox, Pipeline, Studio, June, your profile, scheduler, lead form, payments and Account - one tap from anywhere.',
            key: _kTourFab, before: () => setState(() => _dashMode = 'leads'))
      else
        _TourStep('Account',
            'Team invites, calendar feed, morning brief, your brand, the consult scheduler, the website lead form, Whop and Stripe, and this tour again - all behind your avatar.',
            key: _kTourAvatar,
            before: () => setState(() => _dashMode = 'leads')),
    ];
  }

  Future<void> _endTour({required bool completed}) async {
    _tourChecked = true;
    setState(() {
      _tourIdx = -1;
      _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
      _tourRect = null;
      _dashMode = 'leads';
    });
    if (_uid == null) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(_uid)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorTourDoneAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'vendorTourCompleted': completed,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {}
    // v169: the practice couple arrives once, right after the first tour.
    final String vendorId = _vendorIdCache;
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    if (vd['demoStartedAt'] != null) return;
    await _startPracticeCouple(vendorId, announce: true);
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v169: THE PRACTICE COUPLE
  // ===================================================================
  Future<void> _startPracticeCouple(String vendorId,
      {bool announce = false}) async {
    _showJuneVeil('Jordan & Sam are writing to you\u2026',
        'A practice couple, played by June. Not a real inquiry.');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('demoStart');
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      _popJuneVeil();
      final String id = ((r.data as Map?)?['inquiryId'] ?? '').toString();
      final bool existed = (r.data as Map?)?['existed'] == true;
      if (id.isEmpty) return;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _showAccount = false;
        _editingProfile = false;
        _dashMode = 'leads';
        _setInboxThread(id);
        _showInbox = true;
      });
      if (announce) {
        _toast(existed
            ? 'Your practice couple is still here - pick up where you left off.'
            : 'Your practice lead is in - not a real couple. Try replying.');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast('Could not start the practice couple: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  Widget _practiceStrip(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) {
    if (inq['demo'] != true) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 0),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 11, 12, 11),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        const Icon(Icons.school_rounded, color: gold, size: 18),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Text('PRACTICE COUPLE \u00b7 NOT A REAL INQUIRY',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: gold,
                        fontSize: 10,
                        letterSpacing: 1.6,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(
                    'Jordan & Sam are played by June so you can learn the dashboard. Reply, send a proposal, a contract, an invoice, a booking link, mark them booked - they answer within a minute. Nothing here counts toward your stats or money.',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        height: 1.35)),
              ]),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        TextButton(
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
              foregroundColor: plumDeep,
              backgroundColor: gold,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
          onPressed: _h(() async {
            final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
              context: context,
              builder: (BuildContext dctx) => AlertDialog(
                backgroundColor: ivory,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
                title: const Text('Done practicing?',
                    style: TextStyle(color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                content: const Text(
                    'This deletes the practice thread and everything in it. You can start a fresh one any time from Account.',
                    style: TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4)),
                actions: <Widget>[
                  TextButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx, false)),
                      child: const Text('Keep it',
                          style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
                  FilledButton(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: plum),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx, true)),
                      child: const Text('Delete it',
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white))),
                ],
              ),
            );
            if (ok != true) return;
            _showJuneVeil('Clearing the practice thread\u2026', 'One moment.');
            try {
              await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                  .httpsCallable('demoEnd')
                  .call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
              _popJuneVeil();
              if (mounted) setState(() => _showInbox = false);
              _toast('Practice thread deleted. You know the room now.');
            } catch (e) {
              _popJuneVeil();
              _toast('Could not delete it: ' + _errText(e));
            }
          }),
          child: const Text('Done practicing',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v171: FIT GRADE, WHO I WORK WITH, REAL WEDDINGS
  // ===================================================================
  static const List<List<String>> _kEventTypes = <List<String>>[
    <String>['wedding', 'Weddings'],
    <String>['elopement', 'Elopements'],
    <String>['engagement', 'Engagements'],
    <String>['rehearsal', 'Rehearsal dinners'],
    <String>['destination', 'Destination'],
    <String>['corporate', 'Corporate'],
  ];

  _Fit _fitOf(Map<String, dynamic> inq, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> intent = inq['structuredIntent'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(inq['structuredIntent'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> prefs =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((vd['prefs'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    int score = 40;
    final List<List<dynamic>> why = <List<dynamic>>[]; // [text, +/-]
    // date
    final String iso = _weddingIso(inq);
    if (iso.isNotEmpty) {
      final bool blocked = vd['unavailableDates'] is List &&
          (vd['unavailableDates'] as List).contains(iso);
      if (blocked) {
        score -= 45;
        why.add(<dynamic>['Date is blocked on your calendar', -45]);
      } else {
        score += 20;
        why.add(<dynamic>['Date is open', 20]);
      }
      final DateTime? d = _weddingDateRaw(inq);
      final List<dynamic> off =
          (prefs['daysOff'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
      if (d != null && off.contains(d.weekday % 7)) {
        score -= 20;
        why.add(<dynamic>['A day you don\u2019t usually take', -20]);
      }
    } else {
      why.add(<dynamic>['No date yet', 0]);
    }
    // budget
    final List<num> b = _numbersIn(intent['budget']);
    final num minB = prefs['minBudget'] is num ? prefs['minBudget'] as num : 0;
    if (b.isNotEmpty) {
      num bMax = b.reduce((num a, num c) => a > c ? a : c);
      if (minB > 0 && bMax < minB) {
        score -= 30;
        why.add(
            <dynamic>['Budget is under your minimum (${_pMoney(minB)})', -30]);
      } else if (_budgetFits(intent['budget'], vd['startingPrice'])) {
        score += 20;
        why.add(<dynamic>['Budget covers your starting price', 20]);
      } else if ((vd['startingPrice'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        score -= 15;
        why.add(<dynamic>['Budget is below your starting price', -15]);
      }
    } else {
      why.add(<dynamic>['No budget given', 0]);
    }
    // guests
    final List<num> g = _numbersIn(intent['guests']);
    if (g.isNotEmpty) {
      final num gn = g.first;
      final num gMin = prefs['guestMin'] is num ? prefs['guestMin'] as num : 0;
      final num gMax = prefs['guestMax'] is num ? prefs['guestMax'] as num : 0;
      if ((gMin > 0 && gn < gMin) || (gMax > 0 && gn > gMax)) {
        score -= 15;
        why.add(<dynamic>['${gn.round()} guests is outside your range', -15]);
      } else if (gMin > 0 || gMax > 0) {
        score += 8;
        why.add(<dynamic>['${gn.round()} guests fits your range', 8]);
      }
    }
    // event type
    final String et = (intent['eventType'] ?? 'wedding').toString();
    final List<dynamic> types =
        (prefs['eventTypes'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    if (types.isNotEmpty && !types.contains(et)) {
      score -= 15;
      why.add(<dynamic>[
        '${et[0].toUpperCase()}${et.substring(1)} isn\u2019t in your event types',
        -15
      ]);
    }
    // completeness + effort
    int complete = 0;
    if (iso.isNotEmpty) complete++;
    if ((intent['venue'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) complete++;
    if (b.isNotEmpty) complete++;
    if (g.isNotEmpty) complete++;
    if (complete >= 3) {
      score += 8;
      why.add(<dynamic>[
        'Their plan is filled in (date, venue, budget, guests)',
        8
      ]);
    }
    final String msg =
        (intent['message'] ?? inq['lastMessagePreview'] ?? '').toString();
    if (msg.trim().length >= 80) {
      score += 6;
      why.add(<dynamic>['They wrote you a real message', 6]);
    }
    if ((inq['source'] ?? '') == 'embed' || (inq['source'] ?? '') == 'book') {
      score += 6;
      why.add(<dynamic>['Came through your own website', 6]);
    }
    if (inq['referredBy'] is Map &&
        ((inq['referredBy'] as Map)['name'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
      score += 15;
      why.add(<dynamic>[
        'Referred by ${(inq['referredBy'] as Map)['name']} - a pro who works with you',
        15
      ]);
    }
    score = score.clamp(0, 100);
    final String grade =
        score >= 65 ? 'Gold' : (score >= 40 ? 'Silver' : 'Bronze');
    final Color color = grade == 'Gold'
        ? gold
        : (grade == 'Silver'
            ? const Color(0xFF7A8794)
            : const Color(0xFFA0714B));
    return _Fit(grade, score, color, why);
  }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(

      backgroundColor: ivory,

                      style: _serif(size: 24)),
                ]),

                        fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),

                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: pts > 0 ? vGreen : const Color(0xFFB04343),
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

                  );
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: _h(() {
