                  }),
                  child: const Text('Edit who I work with \u2192',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
              ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _prefsCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> p =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((vd['prefs'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final List<String> bits = <String>[];
    if (p['minBudget'] is num && (p['minBudget'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('from ${_pMoney(p['minBudget'] as num)}');
    if ((p['guestMin'] is num && (p['guestMin'] as num) > 0) ||
        (p['guestMax'] is num && (p['guestMax'] as num) > 0)) {
      bits.add(
          '${p['guestMin'] is num && (p['guestMin'] as num) > 0 ? (p['guestMin'] as num).round() : 'any'}\u2013${p['guestMax'] is num && (p['guestMax'] as num) > 0 ? (p['guestMax'] as num).round() : 'any'} guests');
    }
    if (p['travelMiles'] is num && (p['travelMiles'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('travels ${(p['travelMiles'] as num).round()} mi');
    final List<dynamic> types = (p['eventTypes'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    if (types.isNotEmpty)
      bits.add(types
          .map((dynamic t) => _kEventTypes
              .firstWhere((List<String> e) => e[0] == t,
                  orElse: () => <String>[t.toString(), t.toString()])[1]
              .toLowerCase())
          .join(', '));
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () => _prefsSheet(vendorId),
      child: _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 14, 16),
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          _cardIconChip(Icons.tune_rounded),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  const Text('Who I work with',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: plum,
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(
                      bits.isEmpty
                          ? 'Set your minimum, guest range, days and event types. Every lead gets a Fit grade against it, and couples see it before they inquire.'
                          : bits.join(' \u00b7 '),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                ]),
          ),
          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: muted),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _prefsSheet(String vendorId) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, dynamic> p =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((vd['prefs'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final TextEditingController minC = TextEditingController(
        text: p['minBudget'] is num && (p['minBudget'] as num) > 0
            ? (p['minBudget'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    final TextEditingController gMinC = TextEditingController(
        text: p['guestMin'] is num && (p['guestMin'] as num) > 0
            ? (p['guestMin'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    final TextEditingController gMaxC = TextEditingController(
        text: p['guestMax'] is num && (p['guestMax'] as num) > 0
            ? (p['guestMax'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    final TextEditingController travelC = TextEditingController(
        text: p['travelMiles'] is num && (p['travelMiles'] as num) > 0
            ? (p['travelMiles'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (p['note'] ?? '').toString());
    final Set<String> types = <String>{
      ...((p['eventTypes'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
          .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
    };
    final Set<int> daysOff = <int>{
      ...((p['daysOff'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
          .map((dynamic e) => (e as num).toInt())
    };
    bool saving = false;
    if (!mounted) return;
    InputDecoration deco(String hint) => InputDecoration(
          hintText: hint,
          hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
          isDense: true,
          filled: true,
          fillColor: Colors.white,
          contentPadding:
              const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
          border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
          enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
        );
    const List<String> dayNames = <String>[
      'Sun',
      'Mon',
      'Tue',
      'Wed',
      'Thu',
      'Fri',
      'Sat'
    ];
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        Widget label(String t) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14, bottom: 6),
              child: Text(t.toUpperCase(),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: muted,
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      letterSpacing: 1.4,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            );
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text('Who I work with', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                        'Two things happen: every lead gets a Fit grade against this, and your public page says it plainly ("Books weddings from \u00244,000") so the couples who inquire are the right ones.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                    label('Minimum budget'),
                    TextField(
                        controller: minC,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: deco('\u0024 - the smallest job you take')),
                    label('Guest count'),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                              controller: gMinC,
                              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                              decoration: deco('from'))),
                      const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10),
                          child: Text('to', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
                      Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                              controller: gMaxC,
                              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                              decoration: deco('up to'))),
                    ]),
                    label('Event types'),
                    Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                      for (final List<String> t in _kEventTypes)
                        _tagChip(
                            t[1],
                            types.contains(t[0]),
                            () => setSheet(() {
                                  if (!types.remove(t[0])) types.add(t[0]);
                                })),
                    ]),
                    label('Days I don\u2019t take'),
                    Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                      for (int d = 0; d < 7; d++)
                        _tagChip(
                            dayNames[d],
                            daysOff.contains(d),
                            () => setSheet(() {
                                  if (!daysOff.remove(d)) daysOff.add(d);
                                })),
                    ]),
                    label('Travel'),
                    TextField(
                        controller: travelC,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: deco(
                            'miles from home base I travel without a fee')),
                    label('One line for couples'),
                    TextField(
                        controller: noteC,
                        maxLength: 140,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: deco(
                            '"Intimate weddings and elopements are my favorite"')),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold,
                            foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                        onPressed: _h(saving
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                setSheet(() => saving = true);
                                try {
                                  await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                      .collection('vendors')
                                      .doc(vendorId)
                                      .set(<String, dynamic>{
                                    'prefs': <String, dynamic>{
                                      'minBudget': num.tryParse(minC.text
                                              .replaceAll(
                                                  RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '')) ??
                                          0,
                                      'guestMin':
                                          int.tryParse(gMinC.text.trim()) ?? 0,
                                      'guestMax':
                                          int.tryParse(gMaxC.text.trim()) ?? 0,
                                      'travelMiles':
                                          int.tryParse(travelC.text.trim()) ??
                                              0,
                                      'eventTypes': types.toList(),
                                      'daysOff': daysOff.toList(),
                                      'note': noteC.text.trim(),
                                      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                    }
                                  }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                  if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                  _toast(
                                      'Saved - your leads are graded against it from now on.');
                                } catch (e) {
                                  setSheet(() => saving = false);
                                  _toast('Could not save: ' + _errText(e));
                                }
                              }),
                        child: Text(saving ? 'Saving\u2026' : 'Save',
                            style:
                                const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  Widget _realWeddingsCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'galleries:$vendorId',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('galleries')
              .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId)),
      initialData: _liveQ['galleries:$vendorId']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (sn.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    (d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'live')
                .toList();
        final int shown = docs
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                d.data()['showcase'] == true)
            .length;
        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  _cardIconChip(Icons.photo_library_rounded),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          const Text('Real weddings',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 15,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          Text(
                              docs.isEmpty
                                  ? 'Deliver a gallery through Lazo and you can show it here - a public page couples find on Google, linked from your profile.'
                                  : '$shown of ${docs.length} on your public page',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                ]),
                if (docs.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 10),
                ...docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
                  final bool on = g['showcase'] == true;
                  final String cover = (g['coverId'] ?? '').toString();
                  return Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 8, 10, 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.7),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        border: Border.all(color: on ? gold : goldLine)),
                    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: 56,
                          height: 56,
                          child: cover.isEmpty
                              ? Container(
                                  color: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                                  child: const Icon(Icons.image_rounded,
                                      color: plum))
                              : Image.network(
                                  'https://meetlazo.com/g/${d.id}/i/$cover/thumb',
                                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                  errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Container(
                                      color: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                                      child: const Icon(Icons.lock_rounded,
                                          color: plum, size: 18))),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Text(
                                  (g['showcaseTitle'] ?? g['names'] ?? d.id)
                                      .toString(),
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: ink,
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              Text(
                                  '${(g['dateIso'] ?? '').toString()} \u00b7 ${g['photoCount'] ?? 0} photos${on ? ' \u00b7 meetlazo.com/real/${d.id}' : ''}',
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11, color: muted)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                      if (on)
                        IconButton(
                          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                          tooltip: 'Open the public page',
                          onPressed: _h(() =>
                              _openUrl('https://meetlazo.com/real/${d.id}')),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                              size: 16, color: plum),
                        ),
                      Switch(
                        value: on,
                        activeColor: vGreen,
                        onChanged: _hb(
                            (bool v) => _toggleShowcase(vendorId, d.id, g, v)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  );
                }),
              ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

      final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (BuildContext dctx) => StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
                  backgroundColor: ivory,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(

                                  color: ink, fontSize: 13, height: 1.4)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          TextField(
                              controller: titleC,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                              decoration: InputDecoration(
                                  hintText:
                                      'Title - "Mindy & John at The Farm"',
                                  isDense: true,
                                  filled: true,
                                  fillColor: Colors.white,
                                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                      borderSide:
                                          const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                      borderSide:
                                          const BorderSide(color: goldLine)))),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          TextField(
                              controller: blurbC,
                              maxLines: 2,
                              style:

                              decoration: InputDecoration(
                                  hintText:

                                  isDense: true,
                                  filled: true,
                                  fillColor: Colors.white,
                                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                      borderSide:
                                          const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          InkWell(

                                  size: 20),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              const Expanded(
                                  child: Text(
                                      'The couple has agreed to be featured.',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: ink,
                                          fontSize: 13,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  actions: <Widget>[
                    TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx, false)),
                        child: const Text('Not now',
                            style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
                    FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: plum),
                        onPressed: _h(
                            consent ? () => Navigator.pop(dctx, true) : null),
                        child: const Text('Show it',
                            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white))),
                  ],
                )),
      );
      if (ok != true) return;
    }
    _showJuneVeil(
        on ? 'Publishing\u2026' : 'Taking it down\u2026', 'One moment.');
    try {
      await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable('galleryShowcase')
          .call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'slug': slug,
        'on': on,
        'consent': consent,
        'title': titleC.text.trim(),
        'blurb': blurbC.text.trim(),
      });
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(on
          ? 'Live at meetlazo.com/real/$slug'
          : 'Removed from your public page.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(e.message ?? 'Could not update.');
    } catch (e) {
      _popJuneVeil();
      _toast(_errText(e));
    }
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v172: SAY HELLO (Pro / Studio)
  // ===================================================================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _helloCache;
  String _helloCacheFor = '';
  bool _helloLoading = false;

  bool _isPaid(Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final String t = (vd['tier'] ?? '').toString();
    if (t != 'pro' && t != 'studio') return false;
    final dynamic exp = vd['tierExpiresAt'];
    if (exp is Timestamp && exp.toDate().isBefore(DateTime.now())) return false;
    return true;
  }

  Future<void> _loadHellos(String vendorId, {bool force = false}) async {
    if (_helloLoading) return;
    if (!force && _helloCacheFor == vendorId && _helloCache != null) return;
    _helloLoading = true;
    try {
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r = await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable('helloMatches')
          .call(<String, dynamic>{'vendorId': vendorId});
      _helloCache = Map<String, dynamic>.from(r.data as Map);
      _helloCacheFor = vendorId;
    } catch (e) {
      _helloCache = <String, dynamic>{'error': _errText(e)};
      _helloCacheFor = vendorId;
    }
    _helloLoading = false;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _helloCard(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    if (_helloCacheFor != vendorId && !_helloLoading) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance
          .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadHellos(vendorId));
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> h = _helloCache ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final bool paid = _isPaid(vd);
    final int count = (h['count'] is num) ? (h['count'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final int cap =
        (h['cap'] is num) ? (h['cap'] as num).toInt() : (paid ? 10 : 0);
    final int used = (h['used'] is num) ? (h['used'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final String cat = (vd['category'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .replaceFirst('wedding-', '')
        .replaceAll('-', ' ');
    final String metroName = (vd['metroId'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .split('-')
        .map((String p) => p.isEmpty ? p : p[0].toUpperCase() + p.substring(1))
        .join(' ');
    final String headline = _helloCache == null
        ? 'Finding couples who still need you\u2026'
        : count == 0
            ? 'No couples in $metroName need ${cat.isEmpty ? 'you' : 'a ' + cat.replaceFirst(RegExp(r's$'), '')} right now'
            : '$count couple${count == 1 ? '' : 's'} in $metroName still need${count == 1 ? 's' : ''} ${cat.isEmpty ? 'you' : 'a ' + cat.replaceFirst(RegExp(r's$'), '')}';
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => paid ? _helloSheet(vendorId, vd) : _upgradeSheet(vendorId),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 16, 16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
          ),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Container(
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
              child: Icon(paid ? Icons.waving_hand_rounded : Icons.lock_rounded,
                  color: gold, size: 21),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      const Text('SAY HELLO FIRST',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: gold,
                              fontSize: 9.5,
                              letterSpacing: 1.8,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      if (!paid) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: gold,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                          child: const Text('PRO',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plumDeep,
                                  fontSize: 8.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  letterSpacing: 1)),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(headline,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            height: 1.2)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                        paid
                            ? (count == 0
                                ? 'Check back - new couples set their date every week.'
                                : 'They set a date, a budget and a city and haven\u2019t chosen yet. Say hello before they search. ${cap - used} of $cap left this week.')
                            : 'Zola makes couples find you. Lazo Pro lets you find them: a short hello lands in their inbox before they ever search. Tap to unlock.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory.withOpacity(.82),
                            fontSize: 12,
                            height: 1.35)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            _foldBtn('hello', onDark: true),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: gold),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _helloSheet(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) async {
    await _loadHellos(vendorId, force: true);
    if (!mounted) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> h = _helloCache ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> matches =
        ((h['matches'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .map((dynamic e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
            .toList();
    int cap = (h['cap'] is num) ? (h['cap'] as num).toInt() : 10;
    int used = (h['used'] is num) ? (h['used'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final Set<String> done = <String>{};
    const List<String> dow = <String>[
      'Sun',
      'Mon',
      'Tue',
      'Wed',
      'Thu',
      'Fri',
      'Sat'
    ];
    // rank by fit against the vendor's prefs
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> m in matches) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> fake = <String, dynamic>{
        'structuredIntent': <String, dynamic>{
          'weddingDate': m['dateIso'],
          'budget': m['budget'] is num && (m['budget'] as num) > 0
              ? '\u0024${(m['budget'] as num).round()}'
              : '',
          'message': ''
        },
      };
      m['_fit'] = _fitOf(fake, vd);
    }
    matches.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>
        ((b['_fit'] as _Fit).score).compareTo((a['_fit'] as _Fit).score));

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        return SafeArea(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .88,
            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 14, 8),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text('Say hello first', style: _serif(size: 26)),
                          Text(
                              '${matches.length} couple${matches.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} who still need you \u00b7 ${cap - used} hello${cap - used == 1 ? '' : 's'} left this week. Names appear only if they write back.',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted)),
                ]),
              ),
              Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
              Expanded(
                child: matches.isEmpty
                    ? const Center(
                        child: Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.all(28),
                            child: Text(
                                'Nobody to greet right now. New couples set their date every week - check back.',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: muted,
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    height: 1.5))))
                    : ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 12, 18, 12),
                        itemCount: matches.length,
                        itemBuilder: (BuildContext ic, int i) {
                          final Map<String, dynamic> m = matches[i];
                          final _Fit fit = m['_fit'] as _Fit;
                          final String cid = (m['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString();
                          final bool sent = done.contains(cid);
                          final List<dynamic> needs =
                              (m['needs'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
                          final String needsLine = needs
                              .take(4)
                              .map((dynamic n) => n
                                  .toString()
                                  .replaceFirst('wedding-', '')
                                  .replaceAll('-', ' '))
                              .join(', ');
                          return Container(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 12, 12),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color:
                                    Colors.white.withOpacity(sent ? .5 : .85),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                border: Border.all(
                                    color: sent
                                        ? goldLine
                                        : gold.withOpacity(.6))),
                            child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                                    Container(
                                      width: 40,
                                      height: 40,
                                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: plum,
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                                      child: const Icon(Icons.favorite_rounded,
                                          color: gold, size: 18),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Column(
                                          crossAxisAlignment:
                                              CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                          children: <Widget>[
                                            Text(
                                                'A couple \u00b7 ${m['monthLabel']}${m['dow'] is num ? ' \u00b7 ${dow[(m['dow'] as num).toInt()]}' : ''}',
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    color: ink,
                                                    fontSize: 14,
                                                    fontWeight:
                                                        FontWeight.w800)),
                                            Text(
                                                '${(m['budgetBand'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ? 'Budget not set' : 'Budget ' + m['budgetBand']}${m['planningDays'] is num ? ' \u00b7 planning ${(m['planningDays'] as num).toInt() < 7 ? 'this week' : '${((m['planningDays'] as num) / 7).round()} wk'}' : ''}',
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 11.5,
                                                    color: muted)),
                                          ]),
                                    ),
                                    Container(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                          color: fit.color.withOpacity(.14),
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(999),
                                          border: Border.all(
                                              color:
                                                  fit.color.withOpacity(.6))),
                                      child: Text('${fit.grade} fit',
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                              color: fit.color == gold
                                                  ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
                                                  : fit.color,
                                              fontSize: 10.5,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                    ),
                                  ]),
                                  if (needsLine.isNotEmpty)
                                    Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                                      child: Text(
                                          'Still needs: $needsLine${needs.length > 4 ? ' +${needs.length - 4}' : ''}',
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                              fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                                    ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                                  Align(
                                    alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                                    child: sent
                                        ? const Row(
                                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                            children: <Widget>[
                                                Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                                    color: vGreen, size: 16),
                                                SizedBox(width: 5),
                                                Text('Hello sent',
                                                    style: TextStyle(
                                                        color: vGreen,
                                                        fontSize: 12,
                                                        fontWeight:
                                                            FontWeight.w800)),
                                              ])
                                        : FilledButton.icon(
                                            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                                backgroundColor:
                                                    used >= cap ? muted : plum,
                                                foregroundColor: ivory,
                                                elevation: 0,
                                                padding:
                                                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                                        horizontal: 14,
                                                        vertical: 10),
                                                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                                    borderRadius:
                                                        BorderRadius.circular(
                                                            10))),
                                            onPressed: _h(used >= cap
                                                ? null
                                                : () async {
                                                    final bool ok =
                                                        await _helloCompose(
                                                            vendorId, vd, m);
                                                    if (ok)
                                                      setSheet(() {
                                                        done.add(cid);
                                                        used++;
                                                      });
                                                  }),
                                            icon: const Icon(
                                                Icons.waving_hand_rounded,
                                                size: 15),
                                            label: Text(
                                                used >= cap
                                                    ? 'Out of hellos this week'
                                                    : 'Say hello',
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                                    fontWeight:
                                                        FontWeight.w800)),
                                          ),
                                  ),
                                ]),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
    _loadHellos(vendorId, force: true);
  }

  Future<bool> _helloCompose(
      String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd, Map<String, dynamic> m) async {
    final String first =
        (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '').split(' ').first;
    final String cat = (vd['category'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .replaceFirst('wedding-', '')
        .replaceAll('-', ' ');
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController(
        text:
            'Hi! ${first.isEmpty ? 'I\u2019m' : 'I\u2019m $first,'} with ${vd['name'] ?? 'our studio'} here in ${(vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString().split('-').map((String p) => p.isEmpty ? p : p[0].toUpperCase() + p.substring(1)).join(' ')}. '
            'I saw you\u2019re getting married ${m['monthLabel']} and still looking for ${cat.isEmpty ? 'someone' : 'a ' + cat.replaceFirst(RegExp(r's$'), '')} - that date is open on my calendar. '
            'No pressure at all; if it\u2019s helpful I\u2019d love to share what a day with us looks like.');
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    bool sent = false;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) => SafeArea(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                      22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
                  child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text('Your hello', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                            'To a couple marrying ${m['monthLabel']}. Short and human wins - they get it by email and in their Lazo inbox, with your name and page attached.',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        TextField(
                          controller: c,
                          minLines: 4,
                          maxLines: 8,
                          maxLength: 1200,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: ink, fontSize: 14, height: 1.4),
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            filled: true,
                            fillColor: Colors.white,
                            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                                borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                                borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                                borderSide:
                                    const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.4)),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (err.isNotEmpty)
                          Text(err,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFFB04343), fontSize: 12)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        SizedBox(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          child: FilledButton.icon(
                            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                backgroundColor: plum,
                                foregroundColor: ivory,
                                elevation: 0,
                                padding:
                                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                            onPressed: _h(
                                busy
                                    ? null
                                    : () async {
                                        setSheet(() {
                                          busy = true;
                                          err = '';
                                        });
                                        try {
                                          await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                              .httpsCallable('helloSend')
                                              .call(<String, dynamic>{
                                            'vendorId': vendorId,
                                            'coupleUid': m['coupleUid'],
                                            'text': c.text.trim(),
                                          });
                                          sent = true;
                                          if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                          _toast(
                                              'Hello sent - it\u2019s a thread in your inbox now.');
                                        } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                          setSheet(() {
                                            busy = false;
                                            err =
                                                e.message ?? 'Could not send.';
                                          });
                                        } catch (e) {
                                          setSheet(() {
                                            busy = false;
                                            err = _errText(e);
                                          });
                                        }
                                      },
                                _Tick.medium),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 16),
                            label: Text(busy ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send hello',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ]),
                ),
              )),
    );
    return sent;
  }
