  Widget _teamCardV(String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> team =
        ((vd['team'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m))
            .toList();
    final int sent =
        (vd['referralsSent'] is num) ? (vd['referralsSent'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final int booked = (vd['referralsBooked'] is num)
        ? (vd['referralsBooked'] as num).toInt()
        : 0;
    final int got = (vd['referredBookings'] is num)
        ? (vd['referredBookings'] as num).toInt()
        : 0;
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              _cardIconChip(Icons.group_rounded),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const Text('Your team',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      Text(
                          team.isEmpty
                              ? 'The DJ, florist, planner you\u2019d put your name on. Recommend them inside a booked couple\u2019s thread - they check a date in one tap, and your teammate sees you sent them.'
                              : '${team.length} pro${team.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} \u00b7 $sent recommended \u00b7 $booked booked on your word${got > 0 ? ' \u00b7 $got couple${got == 1 ? '' : 's'} sent to you' : ''}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                    ]),
              ),
              TextButton.icon(
                onPressed: _h(() => _addTeammateSheet(vendorId, vd)),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add_alt_1_rounded,
                    size: 16, color: plum),
                label: const Text('Add',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ]),
            if (team.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ...team
                .asMap()
                .entries
                .map((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) {
              final Map<String, dynamic> t = e.value;
              return Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 8, 6, 8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.7),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                    width: 34,
                    height: 34,
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: plum, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                    child: Text(
                        (t['name'] ?? '?').toString().isEmpty
                            ? '?'
                            : (t['name'] ?? '?').toString()[0].toUpperCase(),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: gold,
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text((t['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: ink,
                                  fontSize: 13.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                          Text(
                              '${(t['category'] ?? '').toString().replaceFirst('wedding-', '').replaceAll('-', ' ')}${(t['weddingsTogether'] is num && (t['weddingsTogether'] as num) > 0) ? ' \u00b7 ${(t['weddingsTogether'] as num).toInt()} weddings together' : ''}${(t['note'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty ? ' \u00b7 ${t['note']}' : ''}',
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5, color: muted)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    onPressed: _h(() => _editTeammate(vendorId, vd, e.key)),
                    icon:
                        const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded, size: 16, color: muted),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    onPressed: _h(() async {
                      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next =
                          List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(team)
                            ..removeAt(e.key);
                      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                          .collection('vendors')
                          .doc(vendorId)
                          .set(<String, dynamic>{'team': next},
                              SetOptions(merge: true));
                    }),
                    icon:
                        const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 16, color: muted),
                  ),
                ]),
              );
            }),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _addTeammateSheet(
      String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd) async {
    final String metro = (vd['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    final TextEditingController qC = TextEditingController();
    List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> pool =
        <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
    bool loading = true;
    String cat = '';
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        Future<void> load() async {
          setSheet(() => loading = true);
          try {
            Query<Map<String, dynamic>> q = FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('vendors')
                .where('metroId', isEqualTo: metro);
            if (cat.isNotEmpty) q = q.where('category', isEqualTo: cat);
            final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> r =
                await q.limit(300).get();
            pool = r.docs
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    d.id != vendorId && d.data()['delisted'] != true)
                .toList();
          } catch (_) {}
          setSheet(() => loading = false);
        }

        if (loading && pool.isEmpty)
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => load());
        final String qq = qC.text.trim().toLowerCase();
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> shown = pool
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                qq.isEmpty ||
                (d.data()['name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase().contains(qq))
            .take(40)
            .toList()
          ..sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
              QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
            final bool ca = (a.data()['claimedBy'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty,
                cb = (b.data()['claimedBy'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty;
            if (ca != cb) return ca ? -1 : 1;
            return (a.data()['name'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .compareTo((b.data()['name'] ?? '').toString());
          });
        return SafeArea(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .86,
            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 14, 8),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text('Add to your team', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                  IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted)),
                ]),
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 0, 18, 8),
                child: TextField(
                  controller: qC,
                  onChanged: (_) => setSheet(() {}),
                  style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText:
                        'Search pros in ${metro.split('-').map((String p) => p.isEmpty ? p : p[0].toUpperCase() + p.substring(1)).join(' ')}',
                    hintStyle:
                        TextStyle(color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 13),
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                        size: 18, color: muted),
                    isDense: true,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 12, vertical: 11),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(
                height: 36,
                child: ListView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                        child: _tagChip('All', cat.isEmpty, () {
                          cat = '';
                          load();
                        })),
                    for (final String c in <String>[
                      'wedding-photographers',
                      'wedding-videographers',
                      'wedding-venues',
                      'wedding-planners',
                      'wedding-djs',
                      'wedding-florists',
                      'wedding-caterers',
                      'wedding-cakes',
                      'hair-and-makeup',
                      'wedding-officiants',
                      'wedding-bands',
                      'day-of-coordination'
                    ])
                      Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                          child: _tagChip(
                              c
                                  .replaceFirst('wedding-', '')
                                  .replaceAll('-', ' '),
                              cat == c, () {
                            cat = c;
                            load();
                          })),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Expanded(
                child: loading
                    ? const Center(
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: plum))
                    : ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 6, 18, 12),
                        itemCount: shown.length,
                        itemBuilder: (BuildContext ic, int i) {
                          final Map<String, dynamic> m = shown[i].data();
                          final bool claimed =
                              (m['claimedBy'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty;
                          return InkWell(
                            onTap: () async {
                              Navigator.pop(ctx);
                              await _editTeammate(vendorId, vd, -1,
                                  candidate: <String, dynamic>{
                                    'vendorId': shown[i].id,
                                    'name': (m['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                    'category':
                                        (m['category'] ?? '').toString(),
                                    'note': '',
                                    'weddingsTogether': 0,
                                  });
                            },
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            child: Container(
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.75),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                  border: Border.all(color: goldLine)),
                              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment:
                                          CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                      children: <Widget>[
                                        Text((m['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                            style: const TextStyle(
                                                color: ink,
                                                fontSize: 13.5,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                        Text(
                                            '${(m['category'] ?? '').toString().replaceFirst('wedding-', '').replaceAll('-', ' ')}${claimed ? ' \u00b7 on Lazo' : ' \u00b7 not claimed yet'}',
                                            style: TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                                color:
                                                    claimed ? vGreen : muted)),
                                      ]),
                                ),
                                const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                                    color: plum, size: 20),
                              ]),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editTeammate(
      String vendorId, Map<String, dynamic> vd, int index,
      {Map<String, dynamic>? candidate}) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> team =
        ((vd['team'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m))
            .toList();
    final Map<String, dynamic> t =
        index >= 0 ? team[index] : (candidate ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    if (index < 0 &&
        team.any((Map<String, dynamic> x) => x['vendorId'] == t['vendorId'])) {
      _toast('${t['name']} is already on your team.');
      return;
    }
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (t['note'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController nC = TextEditingController(
        text:
            (t['weddingsTogether'] is num && (t['weddingsTogether'] as num) > 0)
                ? (t['weddingsTogether'] as num).toInt().toString()
                : '');
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext dctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
        title: Text((t['name'] ?? '').toString(),
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 420,
          child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            TextField(
                controller: nC,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Weddings you\u2019ve done together',
                    isDense: true,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)))),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            TextField(
                controller: noteC,
                maxLength: 160,
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Why you trust them - couples see this',
                    isDense: true,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: goldLine)))),
          ]),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx, false)),
              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx, true)),
              child: const Text('Save', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white))),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> saved = <String, dynamic>{
      'vendorId': t['vendorId'],
      'name': t['name'],
      'category': t['category'],
      'note': noteC.text.trim(),
      'weddingsTogether': int.tryParse(nC.text.trim()) ?? 0,
    };
    if (index >= 0)
      team[index] = saved;
    else
      team.add(saved);
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vendorId).set(
        <String, dynamic>{'team': team.take(12).toList()},
        SetOptions(merge: true));
    _toast(index >= 0 ? 'Saved.' : '${t['name']} added to your team.');
  }

  Future<void> _recommendTeamSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vendorId = (inq['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
        _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> team =
        ((vd['team'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m))
            .toList();
    if (team.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Add your team first - Profile \u203a Your team.');
      await _addTeammateSheet(vendorId, vd);
      return;
    }
    final Set<String> picked = <String>{
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> t in team)
        (t['vendorId'] ?? '').toString()
    };
    final TextEditingController noteC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 600),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) => SafeArea(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                      22, 18, 22, 22 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text('Recommend your team', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                              'To ${(inq['coupleName'] ?? 'this couple').toString()}. They see each pro as a card with a one-tap Check your date; each pro sees you sent them.',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          ...team.map((Map<String, dynamic> t) {
                            final String id = (t['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
                            final bool on = picked.contains(id);
                            return InkWell(
                              onTap: () => setSheet(() {
                                if (!picked.remove(id)) picked.add(id);
                              }),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              child: Container(
                                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: on
                                        ? Colors.white
                                        : Colors.white.withOpacity(.5),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        color: on ? plum : goldLine,
                                        width: on ? 1.5 : 1)),
                                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                                  Icon(
                                      on
                                          ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                                          : Icons
                                              .radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
                                      color: on ? vGreen : muted,
                                      size: 20),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Column(
                                        crossAxisAlignment:
                                            CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                        children: <Widget>[
                                          Text((t['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                  color: ink,
                                                  fontSize: 13.5,
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                          Text(
                                              (t['category'] ?? '')
                                                  .toString()
                                                  .replaceFirst('wedding-', '')
                                                  .replaceAll('-', ' '),
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                                  color: muted)),
                                        ]),
                                  ),
                                ]),
                              ),
                            );
                          }),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          TextField(
                            controller: noteC,
                            minLines: 2,
                            maxLines: 4,
                            maxLength: 400,
                            style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              hintText:
                                  'A line in your words (optional) - "These are the folks I\u2019d hire for my own wedding."',
                              hintStyle: TextStyle(
                                  color: ink.withOpacity(.35), fontSize: 12.5),
                              filled: true,
                              fillColor: Colors.white,
                              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                  borderSide:
                                      const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                  borderSide:
                                      const BorderSide(color: goldLine)),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          SizedBox(
                            width: double.infinity,
                            child: FilledButton.icon(
                              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                  backgroundColor: plum,
                                  foregroundColor: ivory,
                                  elevation: 0,
                                  padding:
                                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                              onPressed: _h(
                                  busy || picked.isEmpty
                                      ? null
                                      : () async {
                                          setSheet(() => busy = true);
                                          try {
                                            await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                                                .httpsCallable('teamRecommend')
                                                .call(<String, dynamic>{
                                              'vendorId': vendorId,
                                              'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                                              'memberIds': picked.toList(),
                                              'note': noteC.text.trim(),
                                            });
                                            if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                            _toast(
                                                'Sent - your team is in their thread.');
                                          } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                            setSheet(() => busy = false);
                                            _toast(
                                                e.message ?? 'Could not send.');
                                          } catch (e) {
                                            setSheet(() => busy = false);
                                            _toast(_errText(e));
                                          }
                                        },
                                  _Tick.medium),
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 16),
                              label: Text(
                                  busy
                                      ? 'Sending\u2026'
                                      : 'Recommend ${picked.length} pro${picked.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ]),
                  ),
                ),
              )),
    );
  }

  Widget _invoicesStrip(String inquiryId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'invoices'),
      stream: _threadQuery(
          inquiryId,
          'invoices',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .doc(inquiryId)
              .collection('invoices')
              .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'void')
                .toList();
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> inv = d.data();
            final String st = (inv['status'] ?? 'sent') as String;
            final bool paid = st == 'paid';
            final num total = (inv['total'] ?? 0) as num;
            final dynamic dd = inv['dueDate'];
            String dueLine = '';
            if (dd is Timestamp) {
              final DateTime dt = dd.toDate();
              dueLine = 'Due ${dt.month}/${dt.day}/${dt.year}';
            }
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(
                    color: paid
                        ? const Color(0xFF2E8B6B).withOpacity(.55)
                        : gold.withOpacity(.6)),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Icon(Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                    color: paid ? const Color(0xFF2E8B6B) : plum, size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(
                            '${inv['title'] ?? 'Invoice'} \u00b7 ${_invMoney(total)}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: ink,
                                fontSize: 13.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        if (inv['installmentCount'] is num)
                          Text(
                              'Payment ${((inv['installmentIndex'] ?? 0) as num).toInt() + 1} of ${(inv['installmentCount'] as num).toInt()}'
                              '${inv['autopay'] == 'required' ? ' \u00b7 autopay' : ''}'
                              '${inv['tipAllowed'] == true ? ' \u00b7 tips on' : ''}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        if (dueLine.isNotEmpty || paid)
                          Text(paid ? 'Paid \u2713' : dueLine,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color: paid ? const Color(0xFF2E8B6B) : muted,
                                  fontWeight: paid
                                      ? FontWeight.w700
                                      : FontWeight.w400)),
                      ]),
                ),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () => _openUrl(
                      '$_kInvoicePdfBase?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=${d.id}'),
                  child: const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(6),
                    child: Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded,
                        color: plum, size: 18),
                  ),
                ),
                if (!paid) ...<Widget>[
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed:
                        _h(() => _markInvoicePaid(inquiryId, d.reference)),
                    child: const Text('Mark paid',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: Color(0xFF2E8B6B),
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  InkWell(
                    onTap: () async {
                      await d.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
                        'status': 'void',
                        'voidedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                          .collection('inquiries')
                          .doc(inquiryId)
                          .set(<String, dynamic>{
                        'invoiceStatus': 'void',
                        'invoiceUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                      _toast('Invoice voided.');
                    },
                    child: const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(6),
                      child: Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                          color: muted, size: 18),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ]),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _proposalStrip(String inquiryId) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'proposals'),
      stream: _threadQuery(
          inquiryId,
          'proposals',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .doc(inquiryId)
              .collection('proposals')),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ps) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            ps.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> p = d.data();
            final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'sent') as String;
            final Color sc = st == 'accepted'
                ? vGreen
                : st == 'declined'
                    ? muted
                    : gold;
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 8),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(color: sc, width: 1.4),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Icon(
                    st == 'accepted'
                        ? Icons.celebration_rounded
                        : Icons.description_rounded,
                    color: sc == muted ? muted : plum,
                    size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text((p['title'] ?? '') as String,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 13.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      Text(
                          '\$${((p['price'] ?? 0) as num).toStringAsFixed(0)} \u00b7 ${st == 'sent' ? 'Awaiting reply' : st == 'accepted' ? 'ACCEPTED' : 'Declined'}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11.5,
                              color: sc == gold ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : sc,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  String _fmtMsgTime(DateTime t) {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime local = t.toLocal();
    final int h12 = local.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : local.hour % 12;
    final String hm =
        '$h12:${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${local.hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'}';
    final DateTime today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final DateTime day = DateTime(local.year, local.month, local.day);
    if (day == today) {
      return hm;
    }
    if (day == today.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))) {
      return 'Yesterday $hm';
    }
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${mo[local.month - 1]} ${local.day}, $hm';
  }

  Future<void> _editMessageDialog(
      String inquiryId, String messageId, String current) async {
    final TextEditingController ec = TextEditingController(text: current);
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Text('Edit message',
            style: TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: TextField(
          controller: ec,
          autofocus: true,
          minLines: 1,
          maxLines: 5,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(border: OutlineInputBorder()),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
            child: const Text('Save'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || ec.text.trim().isEmpty || ec.text.trim() == current) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('messages')
          .doc(messageId)
          .update(<String, dynamic>{
        'text': ec.text.trim(),
        'editedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not edit - try again.');
    }
  }

  void _emojiSheet(TextEditingController target, {VoidCallback? after}) {
    String tab = kEmoji.keys.first;
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setE) => SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 18),
            child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(
                      children: kEmoji.keys.map((String k) {
                    final bool sel = tab == k;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                      child: InkWell(
                        onTap: () => setE(() => tab = k),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 13, vertical: 7),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: sel ? plum : Colors.white,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                          ),
                          child: Text(k,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: sel ? ivory : plum,
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList()),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 6,
                    runSpacing: 6,
                    children: (kEmoji[tab] ?? const <String>[])
                        .map((String e) => InkWell(
                              onTap: () {
                                final TextEditingValue v = target.value;
                                final int pos = v.selection.baseOffset < 0
                                    ? v.text.length
                                    : v.selection.baseOffset;
                                final String next = v.text.substring(0, pos) +
                                    e +
                                    v.text.substring(pos);
                                target.value = TextEditingValue(
                                  text: next,
                                  selection: TextSelection.collapsed(
                                      offset: pos + e.length),
                                );
                                if (after != null) after();
                              },
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                              child: Container(
                                width: 42,
                                height: 42,
                                alignment: Alignment.center,
                                child: Text(e,
                                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 23)),
                              ),
                            ))
                        .toList(),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Center(
                    child: Text('Tap to add \u2014 keep going, then close.',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
                  ),
                ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v137: JUNE SNEAK PEEK - the day-after workflow. Upload the take, June
  // ranks it and writes the words, the vendor edits, the couple gets it in
  // the same thread that holds their contract.
  // v142: delivery tools belong to real clients. Booked is the vendor's own
  // declaration - one tap, under their control. Deliberately NOT gated on a
  // signed contract or a paid invoice: plenty of vendors book outside Lazo,
  // and holding a delivery hostage to an invoice would put us in the middle
  // of their client relationship.
  bool _isBooked(Map<String, dynamic> inq) =>
      (inq['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked';

  Future<void> _needsBooked(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String what) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool? go = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ivory,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text('$what opens once they\u2019re booked',
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        content: Text(
            'Mark ${(inq['coupleName'] ?? 'this couple').toString()} as booked '
            'and these tools unlock for their thread. One tap \u2014 and it\u2019s '
            'what tells Lazo when to ask them for a review.',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child: const Text('Not yet', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: vGreen, foregroundColor: ivory),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), _Tick.medium),
            child: const Text('Mark booked'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (go == true) {
      await _setStatus(inquiryId, 'booked');
      _toast('Booked \u2713 Delivery tools are open for this thread.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _markDelivered(String inquiryId) async {
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'deliveredAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast(_isVideo() && !_isPhoto()
          ? 'Film marked delivered \u2014 we\u2019ll ask for their review in a couple of days.'
          : 'Gallery marked delivered \u2014 we\u2019ll ask for their review in a couple of days.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not update: ' + _errText(e));
    }
  }

  // v139: the videographer's day-after. One film, hosted where they already
  // host it - June writes the caption and the note.
  bool _looksLikeVideoLink(String u) {
    final String s = u.toLowerCase();
    return s.contains('vimeo.com') ||
        s.contains('youtube.com') ||
        s.contains('youtu.be');
  }

    final TextEditingController urlC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController vibeC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController capC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController msgC = TextEditingController();
    bool thinking = false;
    bool sending = false;

    String err = '';

    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setS) => Center(

                color: ivory,

              ),

                child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Center(
                        child: Container(
                            width: 44,
                            height: 4,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: plum.withOpacity(.2),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99))),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 38,
                          height: 38,

                              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                  colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                                'https://vimeo.com/1234567890')
                            .copyWith(
                          suffixIcon: _looksLikeVideoLink(urlC.text)
                              ? const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                  color: vGreen, size: 18)
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      TextField(
                        controller: vibeC,
                        minLines: 2,
                        maxLines: 4,
                        style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                        decoration: _epDeco('What does the film feel like?',
                            'Golden hour, a lot of laughing, her dad crying during the toast'),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      const Text(
                          'A line or two is plenty \u2014 June already knows the couple, the venue and the date.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12)),
                          onPressed: _h(thinking
                              ? null
                              : () async {
                                  if (!_looksLikeVideoLink(urlC.text.trim())) {
                                    setS(() =>
                                        err = 'Paste a Vimeo or YouTube link.');
                                    return;
                                  }
                                  setS(() {
                                    thinking = true;
                                    err = '';
                                  });
                                  try {
                                    final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions
                                        .instance
                                        .httpsCallable('juneTeaser',
                                            options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                                timeout: const Duration(
                                                    seconds: 120)));
                                    final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
                                        await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                                      'vendorId': vendorId,
                                      'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                                      'url': urlC.text.trim(),
                                      'vibe': vibeC.text.trim(),
                                    });
                                    final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                        Map<String, dynamic>.from(
                                            out.data as Map);
                                    setS(() {
                                      capC.text =
                                          (r['caption'] ?? '').toString();
                                      msgC.text =
                                          (r['message'] ?? '').toString();
                                      drafted = true;
                                      thinking = false;
                                    });
                                  } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                                    setS(() {
                                      thinking = false;
                                      err = (e.message ?? '')
                                              .contains('studio-required')
                                          ? 'Teasers are a Pro Studio feature.'
                                          : (e.message ??
                                              'June could not write that one.');
                                    });
                                  } catch (e) {
                                    setS(() {
                                      thinking = false;
                                      err = 'Could not reach June.';
                                    });
                                  }
                                }),
                          icon: thinking
                              ? const SizedBox(
                                  width: 15,
                                  height: 15,
                                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                      strokeWidth: 2, color: plum))
                              : const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                                  size: 16),
                          label: Text(
                              thinking
                                  ? 'June is writing\u2026'
                                  : drafted
                                      ? 'Rewrite it'
                                      : 'June, write the words',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (drafted) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        const Text('NOTE TO THE COUPLE',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: muted,
                                fontSize: 8.5,
                                letterSpacing: 1.4,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 5),
                        TextField(
                          controller: msgC,
                          minLines: 2,
                          maxLines: 5,
                          style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                          decoration: _epDeco('', ''),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        const Text('INSTAGRAM CAPTION',
                            style: TextStyle(

                        const SizedBox(height: 5),

                          style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 13.5),
                          decoration: _epDeco('', ''),

                        Align(

                          child: TextButton.icon(
                            onPressed: _h(() async {
                              await Clipboard.setData(
                                  ClipboardData(text: capC.text));
                              _toast('Caption copied \u2713');
                            }),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded,
                                size: 15, color: plum),
                            label: const Text('Copy caption',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: plum,
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                      if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Container(
                          width: double.infinity,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: const Color(0xFFFBEAEA),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              border:
                                  Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD9A0A0))),
                          child: Text(err,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFF7C2B2B), fontSize: 12)),
                        ),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: FilledButton.icon(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold,
                              foregroundColor: plum,
                              padding:
                                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14)),
                          onPressed: _h(
                              sending
                                  ? null
                                  : () async {
                                      final String u = urlC.text.trim();
                                      if (!_looksLikeVideoLink(u)) {
                                        setS(() => err =
                                            'Paste a Vimeo or YouTube link.');
                                        return;
                                      }
                                      setS(() => sending = true);
                                      try {
                                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                            .collection('inquiries')
                                            .doc(inquiryId)
                                            .collection('messages')
                                            .add(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'senderRole': 'vendor',
                                          'text': msgC.text.trim().isEmpty
                                              ? 'A first look at your film \u2728'
                                              : msgC.text.trim(),
                                          'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                          'teaser': <String, dynamic>{
                                            'url': u,
                                            'host': u
                                                    .toLowerCase()
                                                    .contains('vimeo')
                                                ? 'Vimeo'
                                                : 'YouTube',
                                          },
                                        });
                                        await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                            .collection('inquiries')
                                            .doc(inquiryId)
                                            .set(<String, dynamic>{
                                          'status': 'responded',
                                          'respondedAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                          'teaserSentAt':
                                              FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                        if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                        _toast('Teaser sent \u2713');
                                      } catch (e) {
                                        setS(() {
                                          sending = false;
                                          err =
                                              'Could not send: ' + _errText(e);
                                        });
                                      }
                                    },
                              _Tick.medium),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 17),
                          label: Text(
                              sending ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send to the couple',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
