  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _runSneakPeek(String vendorId, String inquiryId,
      void Function(String note, double pct, bool busy) progress) async {
    FilePickerResult? res;
    try {
      res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'heic'],
        allowMultiple: true,
        withData: true,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not open your files.');
      return null;
    }
    if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) return null;

    final List<PlatformFile> picked = res.files.toList();
    final int over = picked.length > 60 ? picked.length - 60 : 0;
    final List<PlatformFile> files = picked.take(60).toList();
    if (files.length < 4) {
      _toast(files.length == 1
          ? 'Pick at least four frames \u2014 hold Ctrl or Shift to select more.'
          : 'Pick at least four frames (you chose ${files.length}).');
      return null;
    }
    if (over > 0) {
      _toast('Using the first 60 \u2014 $over more than June reads at once.');
    }

    final List<String> paths = <String>[];
    final List<String> tooBig = <String>[];
    final List<String> unreadable = <String>[];
    final String stamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();
    progress('Getting your frames ready\u2026', 0.02, true);

    try {
      for (int i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        final PlatformFile f = files[i];
        final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
        if (bytes == null) {
          unreadable.add(f.name);
          continue;
        }
        progress('Resizing ${i + 1} of ${files.length}\u2026',
            (i + 0.4) / files.length * .55, true);
        // v145: shrink first, THEN judge the size. A 9MB export is fine - it
        // becomes about 300KB before it ever leaves the browser.
        Uint8List slim = bytes;
        try {
          slim = await _downscale(bytes, f.name, maxSide: 1600);
        } catch (_) {
          slim = bytes;
        }
        if (slim.length > 9 * 1024 * 1024) {
          tooBig.add(f.name);
          continue;
        }
        final String safe = f.name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
        final String path =
            'vendors/$vendorId/sneak/$inquiryId/${stamp}_${i}_$safe';
        try {
          await FirebaseStorage.instance
              .ref(path)
              .putData(slim, SettableMetadata(contentType: 'image/jpeg'));
          paths.add(path);
        } catch (e) {
          unreadable.add(f.name);
          debugPrint('LAZO sneak upload: ' + e.toString());
        }
        progress('Uploading ${i + 1} of ${files.length}\u2026',
            (i + 1) / files.length * .55, true);
      }

      if (tooBig.isNotEmpty || unreadable.isNotEmpty) {
        final int bad = tooBig.length + unreadable.length;
        _toast(tooBig.isNotEmpty
            ? '$bad file${bad == 1 ? '' : 's'} skipped \u2014 too large even after resizing (${tooBig.first}).'
            : '$bad file${bad == 1 ? '' : 's'} could not be read (${unreadable.first}).');
      }
      if (paths.length < 4) {
        progress('', 0, false);
        _toast(paths.isEmpty
            ? 'None of those could be uploaded \u2014 try standard JPEGs.'
            : 'Only ${paths.length} made it through \u2014 June needs four.');
        return null;
      }

      progress('June is looking at every frame\u2026', .70, true);
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneSneakPeek',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 540)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vendorId,
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'paths': paths,
        'count': 20,
      });
      progress('Choosing the moments that carry the day\u2026', .92, true);
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      // v147: resolve display URLs on the client. Signed URLs from the
      // function need IAM signBlob on its service account and fail quietly
      // without it - a download URL carries its own token, works for the
      // couple with no auth, and we are already allowed to read this path.
      final List<dynamic> raw = (r['picks'] as List?) ?? <dynamic>[];
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> resolved = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (int i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> p = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw[i] as Map);
        final String u = (p['url'] ?? '').toString();
        final String pth = (p['path'] ?? '').toString();
        if (u.isEmpty && pth.isNotEmpty) {
          try {
            p['url'] = await FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(pth).getDownloadURL();
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint('LAZO sneak url: ' + e.toString());
          }
        }
        resolved.add(p);
        progress('Getting your picks ready\u2026',
            .92 + (i + 1) / raw.length * .08, true);
      }
      r['picks'] = resolved;
      progress('', 1, false);
      return r;
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      progress('', 0, false);
      if ((e.message ?? '').contains('studio-required')) {
        _toast('Sneak Peek is a Pro Studio feature.');
        _upgradeSheet(vendorId);
      } else {
        _toast(e.message ?? 'June could not finish that one.');
      }
      return null;
    } catch (e) {
      progress('', 0, false);
      _toast('Could not finish: ' + _errText(e));
      debugPrint('LAZO sneak: ' + e.toString());
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _sendSneakPeek(
      String inquiryId, List<Map<String, dynamic>> picks, String note) async {
    if (picks.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Keep at least one photo.');
      return false;
    }
    try {
      final CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> msgs = FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('messages');
      await msgs.add(<String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'vendor',
        'text': note.isEmpty ? 'A first look at your day \u2728' : note,
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'sneakPeek': picks
            .map((Map<String, dynamic> p) => <String, dynamic>{
                  'url': p['url'],
                  'moment': p['moment'],
                })
            .toList(),
      });
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': 'responded',
        'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'sneakPeekSentAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Sent \u2014 ${picks.length} frames on their way.');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: ' + _errText(e));
      return false;
    }
  }

  Widget _attachmentTile(Map<String, dynamic> a, bool mine) {
    final String url = (a['url'] ?? '').toString();
    final String name = (a['name'] ?? 'Attachment').toString();
    final String type = (a['type'] ?? '').toString();
    final dynamic rawSize = a['size'];
    final int size =
        rawSize is int ? rawSize : (rawSize is num ? rawSize.toInt() : 0);
    final bool isImage = type.startsWith('image/');
    String sizeLabel = '';
    if (size > 0) {
      sizeLabel = size > 1024 * 1024
          ? '${(size / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} MB'
          : '${(size / 1024).round()} KB';
    }
    if (isImage) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: () => _openUrl(url),
            child: Image.network(url,
                width: 240,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? s) =>
                    const SizedBox.shrink()),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final IconData ic = type.contains('pdf')
        ? Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded
        : type.startsWith('video/')
            ? Icons.movie_rounded
            : Icons.insert_drive_file_rounded;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => _openUrl(url),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.16) : plum.withOpacity(.06),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
                color: mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.4) : gold.withOpacity(.6)),
          ),
          child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            Icon(ic, size: 17, color: mine ? ivory : plum),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Flexible(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(name,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: mine ? ivory : plum,
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    if (sizeLabel.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(sizeLabel,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.7) : muted)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Icon(Icons.download_rounded,
                size: 15, color: mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.8) : muted),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v123: send a pricing sheet, a gallery link, a timeline - without
  // leaving the thread for email.
  static const List<String> kAttachExt = <String>[
    'jpg',
    'jpeg',
    'png',
    'webp',
    'heic',
    'pdf',
    'doc',
    'docx',
    'mp4',
    'mov'
  ];
  static const String kAttachHint =
      'PDF, Word, JPG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 or MOV \u2014 up to 20MB';

  // v128: say what's allowed, then show the upload happening.
  // v141: a photographer picks straight out of their export folder - 6000px,
  // 8MB a frame. We show them at ~500px. Resize in the browser before it ever
  // reaches Storage: same picture, a fortieth of the weight, and their
  // originals are untouched on their own drive.
  static const int kWebMax = 2200;
  static const int kGridMax = 1000;
  static const double kJpegQ = 0.82;

  Future<Uint8List> _downscale(Uint8List bytes, String name,
      {int maxSide = kWebMax}) async {
    final String n = name.toLowerCase();
    if (n.endsWith('.png') || n.endsWith('.webp')) return bytes;
    if (bytes.length < 400 * 1024) return bytes;
    if (!kIsWeb) return bytes; // canvas resize is a browser thing
    try {
      final html.Blob blob = html.Blob(<dynamic>[bytes]);
      final String url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      final html.ImageElement img = html.ImageElement();
      final Completer<void> done = Completer<void>();
      img.onLoad.listen((_) {
        if (!done.isCompleted) done.complete();
      });
      img.onError.listen((_) {
        if (!done.isCompleted) done.completeError('decode');
      });
      img.src = url;
      await done.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
      final int w = img.naturalWidth ?? 0;
      final int h = img.naturalHeight ?? 0;
      if (w == 0 || h == 0) {
        html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
        return bytes;
      }
      if (w <= maxSide && h <= maxSide && bytes.length < 900 * 1024) {
        html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
        return bytes;
      }
      final double scale =
          (w > h ? maxSide / w : maxSide / h).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
      final int nw = (w * scale).round();
      final int nh = (h * scale).round();
      final html.CanvasElement canvas =
          html.CanvasElement(width: nw, height: nh);
      final html.CanvasRenderingContext2D ctx =
          canvas.context2D as html.CanvasRenderingContext2D;
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
      ctx.drawImageScaled(img, 0, 0, nw, nh);
      final String dataUrl = canvas.toDataUrl('image/jpeg', kJpegQ);
      html.Url.revokeObjectUrl(url);
      final int comma = dataUrl.indexOf(',');
      if (comma < 0) return bytes;
      final Uint8List out = base64Decode(dataUrl.substring(comma + 1));
      return out.length < bytes.length ? out : bytes;
    } catch (_) {
      return bytes;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sendAttachment(String inquiryId) async {
    FilePickerResult? res;
    try {
      res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: kAttachExt,
        withData: true,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not open files.');
      return;
    }
    if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) return;
    final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
    final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
    if (bytes == null) {
      _toast('Could not read that file.');
      return;
    }
    if (bytes.length > 20 * 1024 * 1024) {
      _toast(
          'That file is ${(bytes.length / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)}MB \u2014 the limit is 20MB.');
      return;
    }
    final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
        ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase()
        : '';
    if (!kAttachExt.contains(ext)) {
      _toast('$kAttachHint.');
      return;
    }
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _attaching = true;
        _attachName = f.name;
        _attachPct = 0;
      });
    }
    try {
      String ctype = 'application/octet-stream';
      if (<String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'heic'].contains(ext)) {
        ctype = 'image/jpeg';
      } else if (ext == 'png') {
        ctype = 'image/png';
      } else if (ext == 'webp') {
        ctype = 'image/webp';
      } else if (ext == 'pdf') {
        ctype = 'application/pdf';
      } else if (ext == 'mp4') {
        ctype = 'video/mp4';
      } else if (ext == 'mov') {
        ctype = 'video/quicktime';
      } else if (ext == 'doc' || ext == 'docx') {
        ctype = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument'
            '.wordprocessingml.document';
      }
      final String safe = f.name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
      final String path = 'inquiries/$inquiryId/attachments/'
          '${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safe';
      final Uint8List slimAtt =
          ctype.startsWith('image/') ? await _downscale(bytes, f.name) : bytes;
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
      final UploadTask task =
          ref.putData(slimAtt, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
      task.snapshotEvents.listen((TaskSnapshot s) {
        if (!mounted || s.totalBytes <= 0) return;
        setState(() => _attachPct = s.bytesTransferred / s.totalBytes);
      });
      await task;
      final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
      final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> iRef =
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').doc(inquiryId);
      await iRef.collection('messages').add(<String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'vendor',
        'text': '',
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'attachment': <String, dynamic>{
          'url': url,
          'name': f.name,
          'type': ctype,
          'size': bytes.length,
          'path': path,
        },
      });
      await iRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': 'responded',
        'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _attaching = false;
          _attachPct = 1;
        });
      }
      _toast('${f.name} attached \u2713');
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _attaching = false);
      _toast('Could not send that file \u2014 try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO attach: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _uploadStrip() {
    if (!_attaching) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final int pct = (_attachPct * 100).clamp(0, 100).round();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 6),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: gold.withOpacity(.14),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        const SizedBox(
          width: 14,
          height: 14,
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: plum),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text('Attaching $_attachName\u2026',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 4,
                    child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value: _attachPct <= 0 ? null : _attachPct,
                      backgroundColor: plum.withOpacity(.12),
                      valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(gold),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Text('$pct%',
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: plum, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _threadBubble(String text, bool mine,
      {String label = '',
      DateTime? at,
      bool edited = false,
      String? receipt,
      Map<String, dynamic>? attachment,
      VoidCallback? onLongPress}) {
    return Align(
      alignment: mine ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: GestureDetector(
        onLongPress: onLongPress,
        child: Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 290),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: mine
                ? const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum])
                : null,
            color: mine ? null : Colors.white,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: const Radius.circular(16),
              topRight: const Radius.circular(16),
              bottomLeft: Radius.circular(mine ? 16 : 4),
              bottomRight: Radius.circular(mine ? 4 : 16),
            ),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
          ),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              if (attachment != null) _attachmentTile(attachment, mine),
              if (label.isNotEmpty)
                Text(label,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        letterSpacing: .8,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: mine ? gold : muted)),
              if (text.trim().isNotEmpty)
                Text(text,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13.5,
                        height: 1.45,
                        color: mine ? ivory : ink)),
              if (at != null || edited || receipt != null)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(
                      <String>[
                        if (at != null) _fmtMsgTime(at),
                        if (edited) 'edited',
                        if (receipt != null) receipt,
                      ].join(' · '),
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 9.5,
                          color: mine
                              ? ivory.withOpacity(.65)
                              : muted.withOpacity(.9))),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v148: one shared, replaying listener for every card that reads leads -
  // insights, banner, inbox, response speed, the booking and chime watchers.
  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _leadsStream(String vendorId) {
    return _liveQuery(
        'leads:$vendorId',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('inquiries')
            .where('vendorId', isEqualTo: vendorId));
  }

  // ============================================================
  // v118 — THE INBOX. Rail + thread + the couple, side by side.
  // ============================================================

  bool _isUnread(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
    if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') != 'couple') {
      final String st = (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
      return (st == 'new' || st.isEmpty) && m['seenByVendorAt'] == null;
    }
    final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
    final dynamic read = m['vendorLastReadAt'];
    if (last is! Timestamp) return false;
    if (read is! Timestamp) return true;
    return last.compareTo(read) > 0;
  }

  // v140: leads visibly age. "First reply usually wins" is our own pitch -
  // the inbox should enforce it. Quiet under 4h, amber to 24h, red after.
  Widget _ageChip(Map<String, dynamic> m, bool un) {
    final dynamic ts = m['lastMessageAt'] ?? m['createdAt'];
    final bool awaiting = (m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'couple' ||
        ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == '' &&
            (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString() == 'new');
    final String label = _ago(ts);
    if (!awaiting || ts is! Timestamp) {
      return Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 9.5,
              color: un ? plum : muted,
              fontWeight: un ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w500));
    }
    final Duration d = DateTime.now().difference(ts.toDate());
    if (d.inHours < 4) {
      return Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 9.5,
              color: un ? plum : muted,
              fontWeight: un ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w500));
    }
    final bool cold = d.inHours >= 24;
    final Color c = cold ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : const Color(0xFFB07A2E);
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: c.withOpacity(.13),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: c.withOpacity(.45)),
      ),
      child: Text(
          cold ? '$label \u00b7 going cold' : '$label \u00b7 reply soon',
          style:
              TextStyle(fontSize: 8.5, color: c, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
    );
  }

  String _ago(dynamic ts) {
    if (ts is! Timestamp) return '';
    final Duration d = DateTime.now().difference(ts.toDate());
    if (d.inMinutes < 1) return 'now';
    if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
    if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
    if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
    final DateTime t2 = ts.toDate();
    return _shortDate(t2);
  }

  String _weddingDateOf(Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    String raw = '';
    if (inq['structuredIntent'] is Map) {
      final Map i = inq['structuredIntent'] as Map;
      if (i['weddingDate'] != null) raw = i['weddingDate'].toString();
    }
    if (raw.isEmpty) return '';
    final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
    if (d == null) return raw;
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December'
    ];
    return '${mo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';
  }

  DateTime? _weddingDateRaw(Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    if (inq['structuredIntent'] is Map) {
      final Map i = inq['structuredIntent'] as Map;
      if (i['weddingDate'] != null) {
        return DateTime.tryParse(i['weddingDate'].toString());
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  static const String _kChimeUrl =
      'https://meetlazo.com/assets/chime-vendor.mp3';

  void _playChime() {
    if (_chimeMuted) return;
    final int now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    if (now - _chimeLastMs < 3000) return; // debounce
    _chimeLastMs = now;
    if (!kIsWeb) return; // phones get the push notification instead
    try {
      final html.AudioElement a = html.AudioElement()
        ..src = _kChimeUrl
        ..volume = 0.5
        ..autoplay = true;
      a.play().catchError((Object _) {
        // browsers can refuse audio before first interaction - silent is fine
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _setTabBadge(int n) {
    if (!kIsWeb) return;
    try {
      const String base = 'Lazo';
      html.document.title = n > 0 ? '($n) $base' : base;
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // Watches every thread for this vendor: chimes on a NEW couple message
  // (never on load, never for our own), and keeps the tab title honest.
  void _ensureChimeWatch(String vendorId) {
    if (_chimeFor == vendorId) return;
    _chimeFor = vendorId;
    _chimeArmed = false;
    _chimeSub?.cancel();
    _chimeSub = _leadsStream(vendorId)
        .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      int unread = 0;
      bool fresh = false;
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in snap.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        if (_isUnread(m)) unread++;
      }
      if (_chimeArmed) {
        for (final DocumentChange<Map<String, dynamic>> ch in snap.docChanges) {
          if (ch.type == DocumentChangeType.removed) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = ch.doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
          if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') != 'couple') continue;
          // don't chime for the thread we're already reading
          if (ch.doc.id == _inboxOpenId) continue;
          final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
          if (last is! Timestamp) continue;
          if (DateTime.now().difference(last.toDate()).inSeconds > 25) {
            continue; // history, not news
          }
          fresh = true;
        }
      }
      if (fresh) _playChime();
      _chimeArmed = true;
      if (unread != _unreadCount) {
        _setTabBadge(unread);
        if (mounted) setState(() => _unreadCount = unread);
      }
    });
  }

  // v124: a small, movable summary. Tap anything to open the full Inbox.
  // v149: the Inbox is the main event - five threads, each carrying the
  // couple's date, venue and headcount, with an age that turns amber.
  Widget _inboxCompact(String vendorId) {
    _inboxVendorId = vendorId;
    _vendorIdCache = vendorId;
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
      initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> all =
            _leadDocs(snap);
        all.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
            QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
          final dynamic ta = a.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? a.data()['createdAt'];
          final dynamic tb = b.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? b.data()['createdAt'];
          if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) return tb.compareTo(ta);
          return 0;
        });
        final int unread = all
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                _isUnread(d.data()))
            .length;
        bool freshSigned = false;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in all) {
          if ((d.data()['contractStatus'] ?? '') != 'signed') continue;
          final dynamic t = d.data()['contractUpdatedAt'];
          if (t is Timestamp &&
              DateTime.now().difference(t.toDate()).inHours < 48) {
            freshSigned = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> top =
            all.take(5).toList();
        return _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 14),
          borderColor: unread > 0 ? gold : goldLine,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Text('Inbox', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                          if (freshSigned)
                            const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
                              child: _Wiggle(
                                child: Icon(Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                                    color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F), size: 20),
                              ),
                            ),
                        ]),
                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                        Text(
                            unread > 0
                                ? '$unread waiting on you. First reply usually wins.'
                                : 'Every conversation with a verified couple. First reply usually wins.',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: plum,
                        side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                    onPressed: _h(() => setState(() => _showInbox = true)),
                    child: const Text('Open inbox',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  _foldBtn('inbox'),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              if (top.isEmpty)
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  child: Text(
                      'When verified couples reach out, their conversations land here with the date, the venue and the headcount already attached.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted, height: 1.45)),
                ),
              for (int i = 0; i < top.length; i++)
                _inboxCompactRow(top[i], i == 0),
              if (all.length > 5)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                  child: InkWell(
                    onTap: () => setState(() => _showInbox = true),
                    child: Text('View all ${all.length} conversations',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _inboxCompactRow(
      QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d, bool first) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
    final bool un = _isUnread(m);
    final String st = (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
    final String nm = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
        ? 'A verified couple'
        : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
    final String photo = (m['couplePhotoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final String pv = (m['lastMessagePreview'] ?? m['message'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .replaceAll('\n', ' ');
    final Map<String, dynamic> intent = m['structuredIntent'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(m['structuredIntent'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<String> meta = <String>[];
    final String wd = _weddingDateOf(m);
    if (wd.isNotEmpty) {
      meta.add(wd);
    }
    final String venue =
        (intent['venue'] ?? intent['venueName'] ?? '').toString();
    if (venue.isNotEmpty) {
      meta.add(venue);
    }
    final String guests = (intent['guestCount'] ?? '').toString();
    if (guests.isNotEmpty) {
      meta.add('$guests guests');
    }
    final List<Widget> pills = <Widget>[];
    final bool booked = st == 'booked';
    if (booked) {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Booked', vGreen));
    } else if (st == 'new' || st.isEmpty) {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('New', gold));
    } else if (st == 'responded') {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Replied', plum));
    }
    final String cs = (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    final String isx = (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    if (cs == 'sent') {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Contract out', plum));
    }
    if (cs == 'signed' && !booked) {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Signed', vGreen));
    }
    if (isx == 'paid') {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Paid', vGreen));
    } else if (isx == 'sent' || isx == 'due') {
      pills.add(_inboxPill('Invoice out', const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)));
    }
    // v151: lead signals - what the data already knows.
    final Map<String, dynamic> vdNow =
        _liveD['vendor:$_vendorIdCache']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    if (m['demo'] == true) {
      pills.insert(0, _inboxPill('PRACTICE', const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)));
    }
    if (st != 'lost' && !booked && m['demo'] != true) {
      final _Fit fit = _fitOf(m, vdNow);
      pills.insert(0, _inboxPill('${fit.grade.toUpperCase()} FIT', fit.color));
    }
    if (m['referredBy'] is Map &&
        ((m['referredBy'] as Map)['name'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
      pills.insert(
          0,
          _inboxPill(
              'REFERRED BY ${((m['referredBy'] as Map)['name']).toString().toUpperCase()}',
              plum));
    }
    if (st == 'lost') {
      pills.insert(0, _inboxPill('Went another direction', muted));
      final String why = (m['lostReason'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (why.isNotEmpty) {
        meta.add('Reason: $why');
      }
    } else if (!booked) {
      final String iso = _weddingIso(m);
      if (iso.isNotEmpty) {
        final bool blocked = vdNow['unavailableDates'] is List &&
            (vdNow['unavailableDates'] as List).contains(iso);
        pills.add(_inboxPill(blocked ? 'Date blocked' : 'Date open',
            blocked ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : vGreen));
      }
      if (_budgetFits(intent['budget'], vdNow['startingPrice'])) {
        pills.add(_inboxPill('Budget fits', vGreen));
      }
    }
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _setInboxThread(d.id);
          _showInbox = true;
        });
        _markThreadRead(d.id, m);
      },
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(
                top: BorderSide(
                    color:
                        first ? Colors.transparent : const Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Container(
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: booked ? vGreen : plum,
                image: photo.isNotEmpty
                    ? DecorationImage(
                        image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(photo), width: 120),
                        fit: BoxFit.cover)
                    : null,
              ),
              child: photo.isEmpty
                  ? Center(
                      child: Text(_initials(nm),
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: booked ? ivory : gold,
                              fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)))
                  : null,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    runSpacing: 4,
                    crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      if (un)
                        Container(
                            width: 8,
                            height: 8,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                                color: gold, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
                      Text(nm,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ink,
                              fontSize: 14.5,
                              fontWeight:
                                  un ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600)),
                      ...pills.take(3),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (meta.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: Text(meta.join(' \u00b7 '),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
                    ),
                  if (pv.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 3),
                      child: Text(pv,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13,
                              color: ink,
                              fontWeight:
                                  un ? FontWeight.w500 : FontWeight.w400)),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            _ageChip(m, un),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

            tooltip: 'Back to dashboard',

            onPressed: _h(() => setState(() => _showInbox = false)),
          ),
          Text('Inbox', style: _serif(size: 26)),
          if (_unreadCount > 0) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(width: 9),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 3),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(

              ),

            },

                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _chimeMuted ? muted : plum,
                        fontSize: 10.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
      Expanded(

              ? const Center(
                  child: Text('Loading\u2026',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13)))
              : _inboxView(vendorId, fill: true),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _inboxView(String vendorId, {bool fill = false}) {
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext c, BoxConstraints box) {
      final double w = box.maxWidth;
      final bool three = w >= 900;
      final bool two = w >= 660 && !three;
      final double h = fill && box.maxHeight.isFinite
          ? box.maxHeight
          : (three ? 660 : (two ? 620 : 560));
      return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _leadsStream(vendorId),
        initialData: _leadsLatest(vendorId),
        builder: (BuildContext c2,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
          final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> all =
              (snap.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                  .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                      (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'flagged')
                  .toList();
          all.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
              QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
            final dynamic ta =
                a.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? a.data()['createdAt'];
            final dynamic tb =
                b.data()['lastMessageAt'] ?? b.data()['createdAt'];
            if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) return tb.compareTo(ta);
            return 0;
          });
          final String q = _inboxQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
          final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> shown =
              all.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
            final String st = (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
            if (_inboxFilter == 'unread' && !_isUnread(m)) return false;
            if (_inboxFilter == 'new' && !(st == 'new' || st.isEmpty)) {
              return false;
            }
            if (_inboxFilter == 'responded' && st != 'responded') return false;
            if (_inboxFilter == 'booked' && st != 'booked') return false;
            if (q.isNotEmpty) {
              final String hay = ((m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString() +
                      ' ' +
                      (m['message'] ?? '').toString() +
                      ' ' +
                      _weddingDateOf(m))
                  .toLowerCase();
              if (!hay.contains(q)) return false;
            }
            return true;
          }).toList();

          QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? open;
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in shown) {
            if (d.id == _inboxOpenId) open = d;
          }
          if (open == null && shown.isNotEmpty && (three || two)) {
            open = shown.first;
            // v148: the composer must belong to the thread on screen.
            final String autoId = open.id;
            if (autoId != _inboxOpenId) {
              WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                if (mounted && _inboxOpenId != autoId) {
                  setState(() => _setInboxThread(autoId));
                }
              });
            }
          }

          if (all.isEmpty) return _leadsEmptyCard();

          final Widget rail = _inboxRail(shown, open?.id ?? '');
          if (!three && !two) {
            // phone: rail, or the thread full-width with a back arrow.
            // v175: the thread slides in over the rail and leaves the same way.
            final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? sel =
                _inboxOpenId.isEmpty ? null : open;
            return SizedBox(
              height: h,
              child: _viewSwitch(
                sel == null
                    ? KeyedSubtree(
                        key: const ValueKey<String>('rail:root'), child: rail)
                    : KeyedSubtree(
                        key: ValueKey<String>('thread:${sel.id}'),
                        child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                          Row(children: <Widget>[
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded,
                                  color: plum, size: 20),
                              onPressed:
                                  _h(() => setState(() => _setInboxThread(''))),
                            ),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                  (sel.data()['coupleName'] ?? 'Conversation')
                                      .toString(),
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 15,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                          ]),
                          Expanded(
                              child:
                                  _inboxThread(sel.id, sel.data(), vendorId)),
                        ]),
                      ),
              ),
            );
          }
          return SizedBox(
            height: h,
            child: Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  SizedBox(width: 312, child: rail),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: open == null
                        ? _glass(
                            radius: 22,
                            child: const Center(
                                child: Text('Pick a conversation',
                                    style:
                                        TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13))))
                        : _inboxThread(open.id, open.data(), vendorId),
                  ),
                  if (three) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: 306,
                      child: open == null
                          ? const SizedBox.shrink()
                          : _inboxContext(open.id, open.data(), vendorId),
                    ),
                  ],
                ]),
          );
        },
      );
    });
  }

  Widget _inboxRow(QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d, bool active) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
    final bool unread = _isUnread(m);
    final String st = (m['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
    final String name = (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
        ? 'A verified couple'
        : (m['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
    final String photo = (m['couplePhotoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final String preview = (m['lastMessagePreview'] ?? m['message'] ?? '')
        .toString()
        .replaceAll('\n', ' ');
    final String wd = _weddingDateOf(m);
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () {
        setState(() => _setInboxThread(d.id));
        _markThreadRead(d.id, m);
      },
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 5),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(9, 9, 9, 9),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: active
              ? plum.withOpacity(.10)
              : (unread ? gold.withOpacity(.10) : Colors.transparent),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
              color: active
                  ? plum.withOpacity(.45)
                  : (unread ? gold.withOpacity(.55) : Colors.transparent)),
        ),
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                      colors: st == 'booked'
                          ? <Color>[vGreen, const Color(0xFF3AA37E)]
                          : <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                  border: Border.all(
                      color: unread ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.5),
                      width: unread ? 1.6 : 1),
                  image: photo.isNotEmpty
                      ? DecorationImage(
                          image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(photo), width: 110),
                          fit: BoxFit.cover)
                      : null,
                ),
                child: photo.isEmpty
                    ? Icon(
                        st == 'booked'
                            ? Icons.celebration_rounded
                            : Icons.favorite_rounded,
                        size: 15,
                        color: gold)
                    : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 9),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(name,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: plum,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  fontWeight: unread
                                      ? FontWeight.w800
                                      : FontWeight.w600)),
                        ),
                        _ageChip(m, unread),
                      ]),
                      if (wd.isNotEmpty)
                        Text(wd,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 10,
                                color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      if (preview.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                          child: Text(preview,
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  height: 1.3,
                                  color: unread ? ink : muted,
                                  fontWeight: unread
                                      ? FontWeight.w600
                                      : FontWeight.w400)),
                        ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        if (st == 'booked') _inboxPill('BOOKED', vGreen),
                        if (m['unbookReason'] != null && st != 'booked')
                          _inboxPill('DATE RELEASED', muted),
                        if (st == 'new' || st.isEmpty) _inboxPill('NEW', gold),
                        if (st == 'lost') _inboxPill('WENT ELSEWHERE', muted),
                        if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent')
                          _inboxPill('CONTRACT OUT', plum),
                        if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'signed')
                          _inboxPill('SIGNED', vGreen),
                        if ((m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '') == 'due' ||
                            (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent')
                          _inboxPill('INVOICE OUT', const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                        if ((m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '') == 'paid')
                          _inboxPill('PAID', vGreen),
                      ]),
                    ]),
              ),
              if (unread)
                Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, top: 4),
                  width: 8,
                  height: 8,
                  decoration:
                      const BoxDecoration(color: gold, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _inboxPill(String label, Color c) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 2.5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: c.withOpacity(.15),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: c.withOpacity(.5)),
      ),
      // v176: 7.5px was below anything a person is meant to read.
      child: Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              color: c == gold ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : c,
              fontSize: 9,
              letterSpacing: .7,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
    );
  }

  // v148: a draft belongs to a couple, not to the composer. Switching threads
  // parks the half-written reply and brings it back when you return, so a
  // note meant for one couple can never sit under another one's send button.
  void _setInboxThread(String id) {
    if (id == _inboxOpenId) {
      return;
    }
    if (_inboxOpenId.isNotEmpty) {
      final String cur = _inboxMsgC.text;
      if (cur.trim().isEmpty) {
        _inboxDrafts.remove(_inboxOpenId);
      } else {
        _inboxDrafts[_inboxOpenId] = cur;
      }
    }
    _inboxOpenId = id;
    final String next = id.isEmpty ? '' : (_inboxDrafts[id] ?? '');
    _inboxMsgC.value = TextEditingValue(
      text: next,
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: next.length),
    );
  }

  // v148: one send path for the button and the Enter key.
  Future<void> _inboxSend(String inquiryId) async {
    if (_inboxSending) {
      return;
    }
    final String tx = _inboxMsgC.text.trim();
    if (tx.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _inboxSending = true);
    try {
      await _sendVendorMessage(inquiryId, tx, 'responded');
      _inboxMsgC.clear();
      _inboxDrafts.remove(inquiryId);
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: ' + _errText(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _inboxSending = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _markThreadRead(String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    _stampPresence(inquiryId, 'vendorActiveAt');
    final Map<String, dynamic> patch = <String, dynamic>{
      'vendorLastReadAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    };
    final String st = (inq['status'] ?? 'new').toString();
    if ((st == 'new' || st.isEmpty) && inq['seenByVendorAt'] == null) {
      patch['seenByVendorAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
    }
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .doc(inquiryId)
        .set(patch, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  Widget _inboxThread(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) {
    final String coupleName = (inq['coupleName'] ?? '').toString();
    return _glass(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      radius: 22,
      tint: .62,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
      child: Column(children: <Widget>[
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 10, 6),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(coupleName.isEmpty ? 'Conversation' : coupleName,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    _presenceLine(inquiryId, 'couple'),
                    _tagRow(inquiryId, inq, vendorId),
                  ]),
            ),
            if ((inq['status'] ?? '') != 'booked' &&
                (inq['status'] ?? '') != 'lost' &&
                inq['demo'] != true)
              Builder(builder: (BuildContext fc) {
                final _Fit fit = _fitOf(
                    inq,
                    _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest?.data() ??
                        <String, dynamic>{});
                return InkWell(
                  onTap: () => _fitSheet(inq, fit),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: fit.color.withOpacity(.14),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        border: Border.all(color: fit.color.withOpacity(.6))),
                    child:
                        Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                      Icon(Icons.stars_rounded,
                          size: 13,
                          color: fit.color == gold
                              ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
                              : fit.color),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text('${fit.grade} fit',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: fit.color == gold
                                  ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
                                  : fit.color,
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ]),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
              final bool booked = (inq['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked';
              return InkWell(
                onTap: () => _bookingStatusSheet(inquiryId, inq),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: booked
                        ? vGreen.withOpacity(.14)
                        : Colors.white.withOpacity(.75),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    border: Border.all(
                        color: booked
                            ? vGreen.withOpacity(.6)
                            : gold.withOpacity(.65)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(
                        booked
                            ? Icons.celebration_rounded
                            : Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded,
                        color: booked ? vGreen : plum,
                        size: 14),
                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                    Text(booked ? 'Booked' : 'Mark booked',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: booked ? vGreen : plum,
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded,
                        color: booked ? vGreen : muted, size: 14),
                  ]),
                ),
              );
            }),
          ]),
        ),
        Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
        Expanded(
          child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            initialData: _threadLatest(inquiryId, 'messages'),
            stream: _threadQuery(
                inquiryId,
                'messages',
                () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('inquiries')
                    .doc(inquiryId)
                    .collection('messages')
                    .orderBy('at')),
            builder: (BuildContext c3,
                AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ms) {
              final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> mdocs =
                  ms.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
              final List<Widget> bubbles = <Widget>[];
              final String origMsg = (inq['message'] ?? '').toString();
              if (origMsg.isNotEmpty) {
                bubbles.add(_threadBubble(origMsg, false, label: coupleName));
              }
              int lastMine = -1;
              for (int i = 0; i < mdocs.length; i++) {
                if (mdocs[i].data()['senderRole'] == 'vendor') lastMine = i;
              }
              final dynamic otherRead = inq['coupleLastReadAt'];
              for (int i = 0; i < mdocs.length; i++) {
                final Map<String, dynamic> mm = mdocs[i].data();
                final bool mine = mm['senderRole'] == 'vendor';
                final Timestamp? at = mm['at'] as Timestamp?;
                String? receipt;
                if (mine && i == lastMine) {
                  receipt = (otherRead is Timestamp &&
                          at != null &&
                          otherRead.compareTo(at) >= 0)
                      ? 'Read'
                      : 'Delivered';
                }
                bubbles.add(_threadBubble((mm['text'] ?? '').toString(), mine,
                    label: mine ? 'You' : coupleName,
                    at: at?.toDate(),
                    edited: mm['editedAt'] != null,
                    receipt: receipt,
                    attachment: mm['attachment'] is Map
                        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(mm['attachment'] as Map)
                        : null,
                    onLongPress: mine
                        ? () => _editMessageDialog(inquiryId, mdocs[i].id,
                            (mm['text'] ?? '').toString())
                        : null));
              }
              if (bubbles.isEmpty) {
                bubbles.add(const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                  child: Text(
                      'Say hello \u2014 fast, personal replies win bookings.',
                      style: TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 12.5)),
                ));
              }
              return Column(children: <Widget>[
                _practiceStrip(inquiryId, inq, vendorId),
                _leadSourceStrip(inquiryId, inq),
                _consultStrip(inquiryId, inq),
                _tasksStrip(inquiryId, inq, vendorId),
                _fromCoupleStrip(mdocs),
                Expanded(
                  child: ListView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 6),
                    children: bubbles,
                  ),
                ),
              ]);
            },
          ),
        ),
        _proposalStrip(inquiryId),
        _contractsStrip(inquiryId, vendorId),
        _questionnaireStrip(inquiryId),
        _invoicesStrip(inquiryId),
        _uploadStrip(),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 4, 10, 10),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Studio tools',
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_rounded, color: plum, size: 27),
              onPressed:
                  _h(() => _composerToolsSheet(inquiryId, inq, _inboxMsgC)),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Saved replies',
              visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, color: plum, size: 22),
              onPressed: _h(() => _savedRepliesSheet(inquiryId, inq, vendorId)),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Emoji',
              visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.emoji_emotions_outlined,
                  color: plum, size: 21),
              onPressed: _h(() => _emojiSheet(_inboxMsgC, after: () {
                    if (mounted) setState(() {});
                  })),
            ),
            Expanded(
              // v148: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line. Desktop vendors
              // were pressing Enter and getting a newline.
              child: Focus(
                onKeyEvent: (FocusNode node, KeyEvent ev) {
                  if (ev is KeyDownEvent &&
                      (ev.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                          ev.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.numpadEnter) &&
                      !HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed) {
                    _inboxSend(inquiryId);
                    return KeyEventResult.handled;
                  }
                  return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                },
                child: TextField(
                  controller: _inboxMsgC,
                  minLines: 1,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  onChanged: (_) => _stampTyping(inquiryId, 'vendorTypingAt'),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: ink),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Write your reply\u2026 (Enter sends)',
                    hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: muted, fontSize: 13),
                    isDense: true,
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14, vertical: 11),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.7))),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.7))),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            _Press(
              scale: .9,
              tick: _Tick.medium,
              onTap: _inboxSending ? null : () => _inboxSend(inquiryId),
              child: Container(
                width: 42,
                height: 42,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient:
                      const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                ),
                child: _inboxSending
                    ? const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2, color: gold))
                    : const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: gold, size: 18),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v151: SAVED REPLIES ----------------
  // The vendor's own snippets, with {couple} {date} {venue} {vendor} filled
  // in. Stored on the vendor doc so every device has them.
  Future<void> _savedRepliesSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorId) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _vendorDocStream(vendorId),
        initialData: _liveD['vendor:$vendorId']?.latest,
        builder: (BuildContext c2,
            AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> vs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> vd =
              vs.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> replies = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
          if (vd['savedReplies'] is List) {
            for (final dynamic r in vd['savedReplies'] as List) {
              if (r is Map) {
                replies.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(r));
              }
            }
          }
          return SafeArea(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 22),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text('Saved replies', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                    IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: muted),
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                  ]),
                  const Text(
                      'Tap one to drop it into the reply. {couple}, {date}, {venue} and {vendor} fill themselves in.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  if (replies.isEmpty)
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                      child: Text(
                          'No saved replies yet. Write the message you send most and keep it here.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: muted)),
                    ),
                  ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: BoxConstraints(
                        maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .45),
                    child: ListView(
                      shrinkWrap: true,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        for (final Map<String, dynamic> r in replies)
                          ListTile(
                            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                            title: Text((r['title'] ?? 'Reply').toString(),
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: ink,
                                    fontSize: 14,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                            subtitle: Text((r['text'] ?? '').toString(),
                                maxLines: 2,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
                            trailing: IconButton(
                              tooltip: 'Delete',
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                                  color: muted, size: 18),
                              onPressed: _h(() async {
                                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                    .collection('vendors')
                                    .doc(vendorId)
                                    .set(<String, dynamic>{
                                  'savedReplies':
                                      FieldValue.arrayRemove(<dynamic>[r]),
                                }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                              }),
                            ),
                            onTap: () {
                              final String merged = _mergeReply(
                                  (r['text'] ?? '').toString(), inq, vd);
                              final String cur = _inboxMsgC.text.trim();
                              final String next =
                                  cur.isEmpty ? merged : '$cur\n\n$merged';
                              _inboxMsgC.value = TextEditingValue(
                                  text: next,
                                  selection: TextSelection.collapsed(
                                      offset: next.length));
                              Navigator.pop(ctx);
                              if (mounted) setState(() {});
                            },
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          foregroundColor: plum,
                          side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12)),
                      onPressed: _h(() => _savedReplyEditor(vendorId)),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('New saved reply',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _savedReplyEditor(String vendorId) async {

    final TextEditingController textC = TextEditingController();
    await showDialog<void>(

                maxLines: 8,
                style: const TextStyle(color: ink, fontSize: 14),
                decoration: _epDeco('Message',
                    'Hi {couple}! {date} is open on our end. Here is how we work...')),
          ]),
        ),

              child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),

            }),
            child: const Text('Save'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

  Future<void> _redeemInviteDialog() async {
    final TextEditingController codeC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: ivory,
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: const Text('Enter your invite code',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          content: TextField(
            controller: codeC,
            autofocus: true,
            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: ink,
                fontSize: 18,
                letterSpacing: 4,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            decoration: _epDeco('Code', 'ABC123'),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx2)),
                child: const Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: muted))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep),
              onPressed: _h(busy
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final String code =
                          codeC.text.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll(' ', '');
                      if (code.length < 4) {
                        return;
                      }
                      setD(() => busy = true);
                      try {
                        final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance
                            .httpsCallable('redeemVendorInvite',
                                options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                    timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30)));
                        await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'code': code});
                        if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                        _toast('You\u2019re in - the dashboard is loading.');
                      } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
                        setD(() => busy = false);
                        _toast(e.message ?? 'That code did not work.');
                      } catch (_) {
                        setD(() => busy = false);
                        _toast('That code did not work.');
                      }
                    }),
              child: Text(busy ? 'Checking\u2026' : 'Join'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v119: booking is not a one-way door. Weddings get called off, dates move,
  // and sometimes a tap was simply wrong.
  Future<void> _bookingStatusSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final bool booked = (inq['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked';
    final bool signed = (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: ivory,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 22),
          child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text(booked ? 'This couple is booked' : 'Mark as booked',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: plum,
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                    booked
                        ? 'If plans changed, you can release the date \u2014 your thread, contract, and invoices all stay exactly where they are.'
                        : 'This marks the date as yours and starts the celebration.',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (!booked)
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: vGreen,
                          foregroundColor: ivory,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                      onPressed: _h(() {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        _setStatus(inquiryId, 'booked');
                      }, _Tick.medium),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.celebration_rounded, size: 17),
                      label: const Text('Mark booked',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ),
                if (booked) ...<Widget>[
                  ...<List<String>>[
                    <String>[
                      'couple_cancelled',
                      'The couple cancelled',
                      'They called off the wedding or changed vendors.'
                    ],
                    <String>[
                      'date_changed',
                      'The date changed',
                      'Still working together \u2014 new date to confirm.'
                    ],
                    <String>[
                      'vendor_cancelled',
                      'I had to cancel',
                      'You can no longer take this date.'

                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                              color: ink,

                                              fontSize: 11,
