                                  color: muted, size: 18),

                    Padding(

  Future<void> _unbook(String inquiryId, String reason, String label) async {
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': reason == 'mistake' ? 'responded' : 'closed',
        'bookedAt': FieldValue.delete(),
        'unbookedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'unbookReason': reason,
        'unbookLabel': label,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast(reason == 'mistake'
          ? 'Put back \u2014 no longer marked booked.'
          : 'Date released. The thread and every document stay put.');
    } catch (e) {
      final String msg = e.toString();
      _toast(msg.contains('permission')
          ? 'Not allowed to change this booking \u2014 check your rules.'
          : 'Could not update: ' + _errText(e));
      debugPrint('LAZO unbook: ' + msg);
    }
  }

    return Padding(

              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                Text(label.toUpperCase(),

                        color: muted,

                        letterSpacing: 1.3,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                Text(value,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        color: ink, fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.35)),
              ]),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

    final String wd = _weddingDateOf(inq);
    String countdown = '';

      if (days > 0) countdown = '$days days away';
    }
    final String photo = (inq['couplePhotoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final String cs = (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString();
    final String isx = (inq['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString();

    return _glass(

      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),

        Center(

            ),

                ? const Icon(Icons.favorite_rounded, color: gold, size: 24)

          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Center(
          child: Text((inq['coupleName'] ?? 'A verified couple').toString(),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                  color: plum, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ),
        if (countdown.isNotEmpty)
          Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 3),
              child: Text(countdown,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _inboxCtxRow(Icons.event_rounded, 'Wedding date', wd),
        _inboxCtxRow(Icons.place_rounded, 'Venue',
            (intent['venue'] ?? intent['venueName'] ?? '').toString()),
        _inboxCtxRow(Icons.groups_rounded, 'Guests',
            (intent['guestCount'] ?? '').toString()),
        _inboxCtxRow(Icons.savings_rounded, 'Budget',
            (intent['budget'] ?? '').toString()),
        _inboxCtxRow(Icons.mail_outline_rounded, 'Their inquiry',
            (inq['message'] ?? '').toString()),
        if ((inq['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'lost')
          _inboxCtxRow(
              Icons.directions_rounded,
              'Went another direction',
              (inq['lostReason'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
                  ? 'No reason given'
                  : (inq['lostReason'] ?? '').toString()),
        Divider(color: gold.withOpacity(.35), height: 22),
        const Text('WHERE THINGS STAND',
            style: TextStyle(
                color: muted,
                fontSize: 8.5,
                letterSpacing: 1.4,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        _inboxStatusRow(
            Icons.history_edu_rounded,
            'Contract',
            cs == 'signed'
                ? 'Signed'
                : cs == 'sent'
                    ? 'Waiting on signature'
                    : 'Not sent',
            cs == 'signed'
                ? vGreen
                : cs == 'sent'
                    ? plum
                    : muted,
            () => _startContractFlow(inquiryId, inq)),
        _inboxStatusRow(
            Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
            'Invoice',
            isx == 'paid'
                ? 'Paid'
                : (isx == 'due' || isx == 'sent')
                    ? 'Awaiting payment'
                    : 'None yet',
            isx == 'paid'
                ? vGreen
                : (isx == 'due' || isx == 'sent')
                    ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
                    : muted,
            () => _invoiceComposeSheet(inquiryId, inq)),
        _inboxStatusRow(
            Icons.fact_check_outlined,
            'Questionnaire',
            qs == 'completed'
                ? 'Completed'
                : qs == 'sent'
                    ? 'Waiting on them'
                    : 'Not sent',
            qs == 'completed'
                ? vGreen
                : qs == 'sent'
                    ? plum
                    : muted,
            () => _sendQuestionnaireSheet(inquiryId, inq)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _inboxStatusRow(
      IconData ic, String label, String value, Color c, VoidCallback onTap) {
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 9),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.6),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(color: c.withOpacity(.4)),
        ),
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          Icon(ic, size: 15, color: c),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: plum, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ),
          Text(value,
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: c, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: muted, size: 15),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------- v175: MOTION ----------------
// Three rules, from the WWDC "Designing Fluid Interfaces" talk:
//  1. Answer the finger on pointer-DOWN, never only on release.
//  2. Critically damped by default. Overshoot only when something arrives
//     with momentum (a banner dropping in, a card you threw).
//  3. Reduced-motion users get a cross-fade - never a slide, never a bounce.

bool _reducedMotion(BuildContext c) =>
    MediaQuery.maybeOf(c)?.disableAnimations ?? false;

// Haptics, in tiers. Fired on the COMMIT (the tap completing, the drop
// landing) so the pulse and the visual change hit on the same frame. On web
// these are no-ops; on Android and iOS they need no extra permission.
//   select - a choice among peers: tabs, filter chips, toggles.
//   light  - an ordinary button.
//   medium - something left your hands: a send, a signature request, a pickup.
enum _Tick { none, select, light, medium }

void _tick(_Tick t) {
  switch (t) {
    case _Tick.none:
      return;
    case _Tick.select:
      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
      return;
    case _Tick.light:
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
      return;
    case _Tick.medium:
      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
      return;
  }
}

/// Wrap any Material button's onPressed: `onPressed: _h(() => save())`.
/// Null stays null, so `busy ? null : () {...}` keeps its disabled state.
VoidCallback? _h(VoidCallback? f, [_Tick t = _Tick.light]) => f == null
    ? null
    : () {
        _tick(t);
        f();
      };

/// Same for bool callbacks: a chip's onSelected, a Switch's onChanged.
ValueChanged<bool>? _hb(ValueChanged<bool>? f, [_Tick t = _Tick.select]) =>
    f == null
        ? null
        : (bool v) {
            _tick(t);
            f(v);
          };

/// A tappable that answers the instant the finger lands. Use it instead of
/// InkWell wherever the child paints its own opaque background - the ink
/// splash lands on the Material *under* that background and is invisible.
class _Press extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Press({
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.scale = .97,
    this.dim = .88,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.tick = _Tick.light,
  });
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final double scale;
  final double dim;
  final bool enabled;
  final _Tick tick;
  @override
  State<_Press> createState() => _PressState();
}

class _PressState extends State<_Press> {
  bool _down = false;
  void _set(bool v) {
    if (_down != v && mounted) setState(() => _down = v);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bool on = _down && widget.enabled && !_reducedMotion(context);
    final VoidCallback? tap = widget.enabled ? widget.onTap : null;
    return MouseRegion(
      cursor: widget.enabled && widget.onTap != null
          ? SystemMouseCursors.click
          : MouseCursor.defer,
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTapDown: widget.enabled ? (_) => _set(true) : null,
        onTapUp: (_) => _set(false),
        onTapCancel: () => _set(false),
        onTap: tap == null
            ? null
            : () {
                _tick(widget.tick);
                tap();
              },
        onLongPress: widget.enabled ? widget.onLongPress : null,
        child: AnimatedScale(
          // Down is fast (the finger is already there); up is the settle.
          scale: on ? widget.scale : 1,
          duration: Duration(milliseconds: on ? 90 : 240),
          curve: on ? Curves.easeOut : Curves.easeOutCubic,
          child: AnimatedOpacity(
            opacity: on ? widget.dim : 1,
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: on ? 60 : 200),
            child: widget.child,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Wiggle extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Wiggle({required this.child, this.active = true});
  final Widget child;
  final bool active;
  @override
  State<_Wiggle> createState() => _WiggleState();
}

class _WiggleState extends State<_Wiggle> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _c = AnimationController(
      vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 3200))
    ..repeat();
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _c.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!widget.active || _reducedMotion(context)) {
      return widget.child;
    }
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _c,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx, Widget? ch) {
        final double t = _c.value;
        double angle = 0;
        if (t > .82) {
          final double p = (t - .82) / .18;
          angle = math.sin(p * math.pi * 5) * .085 * (1 - p);
        }
        return Transform.rotate(angle: angle, child: ch);
      },
      child: widget.child,
    );
  }
}

class _ArcPainter extends CustomPainter {
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Offset center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final double radius = (size.width / 2) - 4;
    final Paint track = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 5
      ..color = const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(0.18);
    final Paint arc = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 5
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..color = const Color(0xFFD9B77C);
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, track);
    canvas.drawArc(
        Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius), 0.0, 1.9, false, arc);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_ArcPainter oldDelegate) {
    return false;
  }
}

class _ConfettiPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ConfettiPainter({required this.progress});
  final double progress;

  static const List<Color> _colors = <Color>[
    Color(0xFFD9B77C),
    Color(0xFFC9A45C),
    Color(0xFFE8CFA0),
    Color(0xFF52284F),
    Color(0xFF6A3A66),
    Color(0xFFFAF6F0),
    Color(0xFFE8B4B8),
    Color(0xFF2E8B6B),
  ];

  // Proper hash: decorrelated per piece AND per salt, so nothing marches.
  double _rand(int i, int salt) {
    final double x = math.sin(i * 12.9898 + salt * 78.233) * 43758.5453;
    return x - x.floorToDouble();
  }

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint p = Paint()..isAntiAlias = true;
    const int count = 120;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      final double rx = _rand(i, 1);
      final double rSpeed = _rand(i, 2);
      final double rSize = _rand(i, 3);
      final double rDelay = _rand(i, 4);
      final double rSpin = _rand(i, 5);
      final double rDrift = _rand(i, 6);
      final double rPhase = _rand(i, 7);
      final double rColor = _rand(i, 8);

      // Each piece has its own life: staggered entry, its own fall speed.
      final double delay = rDelay * 0.38;
      final double span = 0.55 + rSpeed * 0.45; // how long it falls
      double t = (progress - delay) / span;
      if (t <= 0 || t >= 1.25) {
        continue;
      }
      if (t > 1) {
        t = 1;
      }

      // Gravity with a touch of air resistance - fast, then easing out.
      final double fall = t * t * (1.08 - 0.22 * t);
      final double y = -30 - rDelay * 70 + fall * (size.height + 120);
      if (y > size.height + 30) {
        continue;
      }

      // Independent drift: own amplitude, frequency and phase.
      final double amp = 10 + rDrift * 30;
      final double freq = 1.6 + rDrift * 2.4;
      final double x = rx * size.width +
          amp * math.sin(t * freq * math.pi + rPhase * 6.28318);

      // Tumble: gentler than before, direction varies.
      final double rot =
          (rSpin > .5 ? 1 : -1) * (rPhase * 6.28318 + t * (2.2 + rSpin * 3.4));

      // A ribbon or a chip.
      final bool ribbon = rSize > .62;
      final double w = ribbon ? 4 + rSize * 3 : 6.5 + rSize * 5;
      final double h = ribbon ? 12 + rSize * 8 : 6.5 + rSize * 4;

      // Fade in quickly, fade out over the last third of its own life.
      double alpha = 1.0;
      if (t < .06) {
        alpha = t / .06;
      } else if (t > .68) {
        alpha = 1 - (t - .68) / .32;
      }
      alpha = alpha.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
      if (alpha <= 0.02) {
        continue;
      }

      // Foreshortening as it tumbles - never fully flat, so no flicker.
      final double squash = 0.42 +
          0.58 * math.sin(t * (3.2 + rSpeed * 2.6) + rColor * 6.28318).abs();

      p.color = _colors[(rColor * _colors.length).floor() % _colors.length]
          .withOpacity(alpha);
      canvas.save();
      canvas.translate(x, y);
      canvas.rotate(rot);
      canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
              Rect.fromCenter(
                  center: Offset.zero, width: w * squash, height: h),
              Radius.circular(ribbon ? 1.5 : 2.5)),
          p);
      canvas.restore();
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_ConfettiPainter old) => old.progress != progress;
}

// v148: one Firestore listener per query, shared by every card that shows
// it. Firestore's own snapshot streams are broadcast: a StreamBuilder that
// mounts later than the first one gets nothing until the next write. This
// replays the latest snapshot (or error) to each new listener and is a single
// Stream object, so handing it to a rebuilt StreamBuilder never resubscribes.
class _Live<T> {
  _Live(Stream<T> Function() source,
      {Duration retryAfter = const Duration(seconds: 30)})
      : _source = source,
        _retryAfter = retryAfter {
    stream = Stream<T>.multi((MultiStreamController<T> c) {
      if (_hasLatest) {
        c.add(_latest as T);
      } else if (_err != null) {
        c.addError(_err!, _errSt);
      }
      final StreamSubscription<T> s = _shared.stream.listen(
        (T v) => c.add(v),
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace st) => c.addError(e, st),
      );
      c.onCancel = () => s.cancel();
    }, isBroadcast: true);
    _listen();
  }

  final Stream<T> Function() _source;
  final Duration _retryAfter;
  late final Stream<T> stream;
  T? get latest => _latest;
  final StreamController<T> _shared = StreamController<T>.broadcast();
  StreamSubscription<T>? _sub;
  Timer? _retry;
  bool _disposed = false;
  T? _latest;
  bool _hasLatest = false;
  Object? _err;
  StackTrace? _errSt;

  void _listen() {
    _sub?.cancel();
    _sub = _source().listen((T v) {
      _latest = v;
      _hasLatest = true;
      _err = null;
      _errSt = null;
      _shared.add(v);
    }, onError: (Object e, StackTrace st) {
      _err = e;
      _errSt = st;
      _shared.addError(e, st);
      // Firestore closes a listener on error (an index still building, a
      // rules change). Try again shortly so the card recovers on its own
      // instead of needing a page reload.
      _retry?.cancel();
      _retry = Timer(_retryAfter, () {
        if (!_disposed) {
          _listen();
        }
      });
    });
  }

  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _retry?.cancel();
    _sub?.cancel();
    _sub = null;
    _shared.close();
  }
}

class _SpotlightPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _SpotlightPainter(this.rect, this.tint);
  final Rect? rect;
  final Color tint;
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Path full = Path()..addRect(Offset.zero & size);
    final Path hole = rect == null
        ? Path()
        : (Path()
          ..addRRect(
              RRect.fromRectAndRadius(rect!, const Radius.circular(20))));
    final Path dim = Path.combine(PathOperation.difference, full, hole);
    canvas.drawPath(
        dim, Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF120A14).withOpacity(.72));
    if (rect != null) {
      canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(rect!, const Radius.circular(20)),
          Paint()
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
            ..strokeWidth = 2
            ..color = const Color(0xFFD9B77C));
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_SpotlightPainter old) => old.rect != rect;
}
